papers.title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
papers.abstract: LLM memory systems often delete facts classified as stale. We show that this hard-filtering step can reduce downstream accuracy when resolver errors delete query-critical facts. Across three models, a controlled sensitivity intervention moves hard-drop from gains of +0.186 to +0.230 at perfect resolution to losses of -0.176 to -0.181 at the lowest tested reliability. Paired targeted interventions show that false-drop causes significantly greater degradation than false-keep, while a non-deleting baseline can still fail when incorrect labels steer generation. On a frozen 102/102 calibration/test split, a simple deployment-matched gate reaches 0.655 accuracy versus 0.641 for always hard-drop and 0.662 for test-informed oracle selection. Global-accuracy crossovers require gold labels and are model- and task-specific diagnostics, not deployment thresholds. Deletion should instead be treated as cost-sensitive: validate query-critical false-drop risk on matched data, or default to label-free retention when such validation is unavailable.

translation.title: LLM智能体何时应该遗忘？查询关键性解析器错误下的记忆过滤
translation.abstract: LLM记忆系统通常会删除被判定为过时的事实。我们证明，当解析器错误删除查询关键事实时，这种硬过滤步骤会降低下游准确率。在三个模型上，一项受控敏感性干预显示：在完美解析时硬删除带来+0.186至+0.230的增益，而在测试的最低可靠性下则变为-0.176至-0.181的损失。配对的目标干预表明，误删导致的性能下降显著大于误保留，而一个不删除的基线在错误标签引导生成时仍可能失败。在一个固定的102/102校准/测试划分上，一个简单的部署匹配门控达到0.655的准确率，而总是硬删除为0.641，测试知情的oracle选择为0.662。依赖gold标签的全局准确率交叉点只是模型和任务相关的诊断指标，并非部署阈值。相反，删除应被视为成本敏感的决策：在匹配数据上验证查询关键误删风险，或在无法验证时默认采用无标签保留策略。
translation.brief: 解决LLM记忆删除中解析器误删查询关键事实导致性能下降的问题，核心方法是通过配对干预与部署匹配门控将删除建模为成本敏感决策。

papers.title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
papers.abstract: Hallucination detection for large language models is dominated by methods evaluated on 7B-70B research models with abundant sampling budgets and exact-match or ROUGE correctness labels. The small models practitioners actually ship on-device, Phi-3-mini, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, and Gemma-2-2B-Instruct, typically at 4-bit precision, sit outside this evidence base. We present a reproducible one-GPU audit of four detectors spanning three paradigms: length-normalized token-margin calibration, a lexical n-gram baseline, and two sampling-based consistency methods (semantic entropy and SelfCheckGPT-NLI) on two small open instruction-tuned models (Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct) loaded at 4-bit NF4 quantization on a single Colab T4 GPU, evaluated on closed-book TriviaQA. Cross-model ranking transfer is poor: Spearman rho is -0.80 and Kendall tau-b is -0.667, meaning the detector ranking actively inverts between the two models, and the cheap lexical baseline is statistically indistinguishable from the sampling-based consistency detectors on both models under bootstrap 95 percent confidence intervals. As a second, methodological contribution, we show that the standard token-overlap-to-multiple-choice correctness labeler for TruthfulQA-Generation produces near-chance AUROC (0.46-0.59) for all four detectors on both models, a labeler failure, not a detector failure, since the same detectors reach 0.69-0.89 AUROC on TriviaQA under the identical pipeline. We release the harness, prompts, and per-item scores and frame the detector choice explicitly as a fairness-of-error-rates allocation problem for practitioners deploying on resource-constrained, on-device hardware.

translation.title: 排名还成立吗？面向从业者在小型量化端侧LLM上对幻觉检测器的审计
translation.abstract: 大语言模型幻觉检测的主流方法多在7B-70B研究模型上评估，且依赖充足的采样预算和精确匹配或ROUGE正确性标签。而从业者实际在端侧部署的小模型——Phi-3-mini、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct和Gemma-2-2B-Instruct（通常为4-bit精度）——不在这一证据基础之内。我们提出一项可复现的单GPU审计，涵盖三种范式的四个检测器：长度归一化token-margin校准、词汇n-gram基线，以及两种基于采样的一致性方法（semantic entropy和SelfCheckGPT-NLI），在单张Colab T4 GPU上以4-bit NF4量化加载两个小型开源指令模型（Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct），在闭卷TriviaQA上评估。跨模型排名迁移性很差：Spearman rho为-0.80、Kendall tau-b为-0.667，即检测器排名在两个模型间完全反转；且在95% bootstrap置信区间下，廉价的词汇基线在两个模型上与基于采样的一致性检测器统计上不可区分。作为第二项方法学贡献，我们证明TruthfulQA-Generation标准的token重叠转多选正确性标注器在两个模型上对全部四个检测器产生接近随机的AUROC（0.46-0.59），这是标注器失败而非检测器失败，因为相同检测器在同一管线下于TriviaQA上达到0.69-0.89的AUROC。我们发布评测框架、提示词和逐项得分，并将检测器选择明确框定为在资源受限端侧硬件上部署的错误率公平性分配问题。
translation.brief: 解决幻觉检测器研究结论是否适用于小型量化端侧LLM的问题，核心方法是在单GPU上对多种范式的检测器进行可复现审计，发现跨模型排名反转及TruthfulQA标注器失效。

papers.title: Tabular Population Priors as Structured Retrieval for EHR Medication Set Prediction
papers.abstract: Medication prediction from electronic health records is a fixed vocabulary structured prediction problem, yet recent clinical RAG systems often treat it like open ended case based reasoning: retrieve similar patient admissions and ask an LLM to infer a medication set. This retrieval object is indirect the model receives retrieved patient records while the target is a discrete set of medication class labels. We propose a more task aligned retrieval object: a tabular population prior ranked medication class candidates from a sparse condition medication co occurrence table estimated from training admissions. Using PACERAG as a fixed downstream pipeline and replacing only its patient retriever, this drop in swap improves F1 from 0.303 to 0.338 (+11.5% relative) and Jaccard from 0.218 to 0.237 on 1,004 heldout MIMIC IV admissions, with no additional LLM calls and no inference time patient index. A non LLM top k baseline reaches F1=0.248, confirming the prior is predictive before LLM integration. Aggregate population statistics can provide a more task aligned, efficient, and auditable retrieval source than patient level nearest neighbors for fixed vocabulary EHR set prediction.

translation.title: 表格化人群先验作为EHR用药集合预测的结构化检索
translation.abstract: 从电子健康记录预测用药是一个固定词表的结构化预测问题，但近期的临床RAG系统常将其当作开放式案例推理处理：检索相似患者住院记录，再让LLM推断用药集合。这种检索对象是间接的——模型收到的是检索到的患者记录，而目标是离散的用药类别标签集合。我们提出一种更贴合任务的检索对象：表格化人群先验，即由训练住院数据估计的稀疏“疾病-用药”共现表中排出的用药类别候选。以PACERAG为固定下游管线并仅替换其患者检索器，这一即插即用的替换在1,004条MIMIC IV留出住院数据上将F1从0.303提升至0.338（相对提升11.5%），Jaccard从0.218提升至0.237，且无需额外的LLM调用，也无需推理时的患者索引。一个非LLM的top-k基线达到F1=0.248，证实该先验在接入LLM之前就具有预测能力。对于固定词表的EHR集合预测，总体人群统计可以提供比患者级最近邻更贴合任务、更高效且更可审计的检索源。
translation.brief: 解决EHR用药集合预测中检索对象与任务不匹配的问题，核心方法是用疾病-用药共现表构建表格化人群先验替代患者级最近邻检索。

papers.title: Everything is an Operational View: UI as a Projection over Context in Agentic Systems
papers.abstract: The emergence of generative AI has enabled Generative User Interfaces (GenUI) that dynamically construct interfaces from user intent, yet existing approaches rely on request-response pipelines that fragment context and limit transparency and control. This paper proposes AFS-UI, which reconceptualises UI as projections over context built on an agentic file-system abstraction that organizes data, capabilities, and interaction state within a unified, persistent workspace. In particular, AFS-UI addresses key limitations in current systems, including heterogeneous resource discoverability, incompatible operation semantics, tangling projection and context, rigid source composition and substitution, and limited evolvability. Within this framework, interfaces become dynamic, inspectable views over shared resources, supporting both human and agent interaction through a common operational surface.

translation.title: 一切皆操作视图：智能体系统中UI作为上下文的投影
translation.abstract: 生成式AI的兴起催生了可根据用户意图动态构建界面的生成式用户界面（GenUI），但现有方法依赖请求-响应管线，割裂了上下文并限制了透明性与控制力。本文提出AFS-UI，将UI重新概念化为上下文之上的投影，构建于智能体文件系统抽象之上，该抽象在统一、持久的工作区内组织数据、能力和交互状态。特别地，AFS-UI解决了当前系统的关键局限，包括异构资源可发现性、不兼容的操作语义、投影与上下文的纠缠、僵化的源组合与替换，以及有限的演化能力。在这一框架下，界面成为对共享资源的动态、可检查视图，通过统一的操作表面同时支持人类与智能体的交互。
translation.brief: 解决GenUI请求-响应管线割裂上下文、缺乏透明性的问题，核心方法是将UI重新概念化为基于智能体文件系统抽象的上下文投影。

papers.title: ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects
papers.abstract: AI-assisted development environments turn natural-language requests into working applications, yet the projects they produce often fail on their first deployment for operational reasons: credentials in source files, missing security middleware, no container definition, no health endpoint and no delivery pipeline. Automated repair of such defects usually relies on free-form model generation, which varies between runs and is seldom checked independently. This paper presents ProdPilot, a local Model Context Protocol server that audits this http URL and React projects against 50 production readiness rules, repairs violations through a bounded loop, gates the result and deploys it. Each rule is classified by what its fix requires: 28 fixes are fixed templates, 16 are filled with values extracted from the project and only 6 are written by the IDE agent's model, so 88.0\% of the ruleset needs no model-written content, and across 499 real repositories 93.5\% of the violations found fall in those classes. A fix, however it was produced, is accepted only if the checker that flagged the rule now passes. In a full-chain run over 23 sample projects, template and extraction fixes that were applied as written passed their checkers in 87.6\% and 95.0\% of cases, and independent verification rejected 25 of the 237 fixes reported as applied. A deployability model trained on 684 real deployments ranks held-out projects at 0.909 ROC AUC, a gated project was deployed, smoke-tested and connected to an active CI/CD pipeline in 82 seconds, and the unchanged server worked from the IDE agents in VS Code, Cursor and Windsurf, where live agents resolved all six delegated rules on the first attempt under the same verification. ProdPilot itself runs no model.

translation.title: ProdPilot：用于自动化生产就绪与部署分层模型上下文协议系统
translation.abstract: AI辅助开发环境能把自然语言请求变成可运行的应用，但其产出的项目在首次部署时常因运维原因失败：源代码中含凭证、缺少安全中间件、无容器定义、无健康检查端点、无交付管线。对此类缺陷的自动修复通常依赖自由形式的模型生成，不同运行间结果不稳定且很少得到独立校验。本文提出ProdPilot，一个本地Model Context Protocol服务器，依据50条生产就绪规则审计此类http URL和React项目，通过有界循环修复违规项，对结果进行门控并部署。每条规则按其修复所需方式分类：28条为固定模板修复，16条用从项目提取的值填充，仅6条由IDE智能体的模型编写，因此88.0%的规则集无需模型编写内容；在499个真实仓库中，93.5%发现的违规属于这些类别。任何来源的修复只有在标记该规则的检查器通过后才被接受。在23个样本项目的全链路运行中，按原样应用的模板与提取类修复分别以87.6%和95.0%的比率通过检查器，独立校验拒绝了237个声称已应用修复中的25个。基于684次真实部署训练的可部署性模型对留出项目的排序达到0.909 ROC AUC；一个经门控的项目在82秒内完成部署、冒烟测试并接入活跃的CI/CD管线；同一服务器未经改动即可在VS Code、Cursor和Windsurf的IDE智能体中使用，其中在线智能体在同一校验机制下首次尝试即解决全部六条委托规则。ProdPilot本身不运行任何模型。
translation.brief: 解决vibe-coded项目首次部署因运维缺陷失败及自动修复不可靠的问题，核心方法是用MCP服务器按规则分类（模板/提取/模型生成）修复并以检查器门控后部署。

papers.title: Time-Consistent Evaluation of Hierarchical Code Graphs for SWE Agents
papers.abstract: Evaluating repository-aware software engineering (SWE) agents requires strict separation between pre-existing repository knowledge and future code evolution, yet standard benchmarks frequently suffer from temporal contamination and prompt-level solution leakage. Building on the time-consistent benchmark protocol of Sun (2026), we enforce strict zero-leakage isolation across DragonFly in C++ and React in JavaScript/TypeScript, locking repository snapshots and knowledge graphs at historical cutoff commits $T_0$ and evaluating 100 post-$T_0$ pull requests across four prompt granularities: Minimal, Concise, Contextual, and Guided. Under this zero-leakage protocol, we conduct a matched evaluation of three context-augmentation regimes: (1) an unaugmented Baseline, (2) a flat syntax-level Tree-sitter AST graph, and (3) ServiceExplorer, a deterministic two-level hierarchical dependency graph capturing Level-1 system/package containers and Level-2 architectural modules. Across 7,200 paired evaluations spanning six foundation models across the MAI-Code Flash, Claude, and GPT-Sol families, ServiceExplorer consistently outperforms both Baseline and Tree-sitter AST across every model, repository, and prompt granularity ($+15.6\%$ to $+86.2\%$ relative $F_1$ lift, $p < 10^{-4}$), while tripling exact full-PR localization on DragonFly. Crucially, equipping an efficiency-tier or prior-generation model with ServiceExplorer consistently surpasses the unaugmented Baseline $F_1$ of the next-generation model across all evaluated families.

translation.title: 面向 SWE 智能体的层级代码图的时间一致性评估
translation.abstract: 评估具备仓库感知能力的软件工程（SWE）智能体需要严格区分仓库既有知识与未来代码演化，但标准基准常常存在时间污染和提示层面的答案泄露。基于 Sun（2026）的时间一致性基准协议，我们在 C++ 的 DragonFly 和 JavaScript/TypeScript 的 React 上实施严格的零泄露隔离，将仓库快照和知识图谱锁定在历史截止提交 $T_0$，并评估 $T_0$ 之后的 100 个 pull request，覆盖四种提示粒度：Minimal、Concise、Contextual 和 Guided。在该零泄露协议下，我们对三种上下文增强方案进行匹配评估：(1) 未增强的 Baseline，(2) 扁平的语法级 Tree-sitter AST 图，(3) ServiceExplorer——一个确定性的两级层级依赖图，捕捉 Level-1 系统/包容器和 Level-2 架构模块。在横跨 MAI-Code Flash、Claude 和 GPT-Sol 三个模型系列的六个基础模型上共进行 7,200 次配对评估，ServiceExplorer 在所有模型、仓库和提示粒度上始终优于 Baseline 和 Tree-sitter AST（相对 $F_1$ 提升 $+15.6\%$ 到 $+86.2\%$，$p < 10^{-4}$），并在 DragonFly 上将完整 PR 的精确本地化提升至三倍。关键的是，为效率档或上一代模型配备 ServiceExplorer 后，其在所有评估模型系列上的 $F_1$ 始终超过下一代模型未增强的 Baseline。
translation.brief: 针对 SWE 基准的时间污染与提示泄露问题，构建零泄露时间一致性协议并评估两级层级依赖图 ServiceExplorer 对上下文增强的作用。

papers.title: Agentic-Teacher: An Agentic Data Engine for Failure-Driven VLA Post-Training
papers.abstract: Improving a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) model requires demonstrations that address its weaknesses and provide effective supervision for learning. Coding agents can autonomously generate demonstrations through environment interaction, yet successful execution alone does not ensure effective supervision for VLA learning. We introduce Agentic-Teacher, an autonomous data engine for failure-driven VLA post-training. Given a VLA checkpoint, a task specification, and configured environment tools, the engine analyzes failed rollouts, selects intervention states, and iteratively develops closed-loop code policies through execution feedback. Validated policies become reusable demonstration generators that collect successful continuations from states where the VLA struggles. To make these demonstrations suitable for learning, Agentic-Teacher introduces temporally correlated action noise to broaden state-action coverage, removes idle frames while preserving gripper transitions, and filters trajectories using the frozen base model's flow-matching loss. The resulting demonstrations are combined with successful VLA rollouts for post-training, yielding an updated policy that operates without coding-agent assistance. Agentic-Teacher thus connects the weaknesses of a target VLA to both the generation and curation of its training data. In simulation, it improves $\pi_0$ success rates from 79.4% to 87.8% on LIBERO-10, from 80.4% to 90.6% on MetaWorld-10, and from 0% to 30.0% across three RoboCasa tasks.

translation.title: Agentic-Teacher：面向失败驱动的 VLA 后训练的智能体数据引擎
translation.abstract: 改进预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要能针对其弱点并提供有效监督的示范数据。编码智能体可通过环境交互自主生成示范，但仅凭成功执行并不能保证对 VLA 学习的有效监督。我们提出 Agentic-Teacher，一个用于失败驱动 VLA 后训练的自主数据引擎。给定 VLA 检查点、任务规格和配置好的环境工具，该引擎分析失败的 rollout，选择干预状态，并通过执行反馈迭代开发闭环代码策略。经过验证的策略成为可复用的示范生成器，从 VLA 表现不佳的状态出发收集成功的后续轨迹。为使这些示范适合学习，Agentic-Teacher 引入时间相关的动作噪声以拓宽状态-动作覆盖，在保留夹爪状态转换的同时移除空闲帧，并使用冻结基础模型的 flow-matching 损失过滤轨迹。所得示范与成功的 VLA rollout 结合用于后训练，得到无需编码智能体辅助即可运行的更新策略。Agentic-Teacher 由此将目标 VLA 的弱点与其训练数据的生成和筛选连接起来。在仿真中，它将 $\pi_0$ 在 LIBERO-10 上的成功率从 79.4% 提升至 87.8%，在 MetaWorld-10 上从 80.4% 提升至 90.6%，并在三个 RoboCasa 任务上从 0% 提升至 30.0%。
translation.brief: 针对 VLA 模型弱点缺乏有效监督数据的问题，提出由编码智能体分析失败轨迹并生成筛选针对性示范数据的数据引擎。

papers.title: Can LLMs Write Backdoors? An Empirical Security Study of Weight-Space Programming
papers.abstract: Recent advances in weight-space programming (WSP) have demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can directly inspect and modify neural network weights without conventional gradient-based training. While this capability opens new possibilities for model improvement, it also raises an important security question: Can LLMs exploit weight-space programming to inject backdoors into neural networks? To answer this question, we present an empirical security study of LLM-driven weight-space programming for backdoor injection. Specifically, we investigate whether general-purpose LLMs can directly modify the weights of target models according to natural-language instructions, without accessing task-specific data, performing forward passes, or computing gradients. We evaluate five LLMs as weight editors across three target architectures: an MLP on MNIST, ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10, and Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct on AG News. Our experiments reveal three key findings. First, LLM-driven weight editing can successfully inject backdoors across different architectures while largely preserving clean performance. Second, successful attacks can require remarkably few parameter modifications, including only six parameters for the MLP and 0.02% of the weights for a fine-tuned Qwen model. Third, editing capabilities vary substantially across LLMs and target architectures: although all five LLMs successfully backdoor the MLP, only GPT-6 Astra succeeds across all three targets. These findings highlight an emerging security risk of weight-space programming and underscore the importance of safeguarding LLM-driven weight editing.

translation.title: LLM 能编写后门吗？权重空间编程的实证安全研究
translation.abstract: 权重空间编程（WSP）的最新进展表明，大语言模型（LLM）可以直接检查和修改神经网络权重，而无需传统的基于梯度的训练。虽然这一能力为模型改进开辟了新可能，但也提出了一个重要的安全问题：LLM 能否利用权重空间编程向神经网络注入后门？为回答这一问题，我们对 LLM 驱动的权重空间编程后门注入进行了实证安全研究。具体而言，我们考察通用 LLM 能否仅依据自然语言指令直接修改目标模型权重，而不访问任务特定数据、不执行前向传播、不计算梯度。我们评估了五个 LLM 作为权重编辑器，针对三种目标架构：MNIST 上的 MLP、CIFAR-10 上的 ResNet-18 以及 AG News 上的 Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct。实验揭示了三个关键发现。第一，LLM 驱动的权重编辑可以在不同架构上成功注入后门，同时基本保持干净样本性能。第二，成功的攻击可能只需极少的参数修改，包括 MLP 上仅 6 个参数、微调的 Qwen 模型上 0.02% 的权重。第三，编辑能力在不同 LLM 和目标架构间差异显著：虽然五个 LLM 都成功对 MLP 注入后门，但只有 GPT-6 Astra 在全部三个目标上都成功。这些发现凸显了权重空间编程的新兴安全风险，并强调了对 LLM 驱动权重编辑进行防护的重要性。
translation.brief: 针对 LLM 权重空间编程是否可注入后门的安全问题，实证评估五个 LLM 在三种架构上仅凭自然语言指令修改权重的后门攻击能力。

papers.title: Alignment with Reflect-Reasoning: Learning How To Follow Principles
papers.abstract: The appropriate governing norms and principles for the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) often depend on cultural context and deployment application. However, most alignment techniques focus on training models to conform to human preferences or constitutional principles specified at training time and subsequently fixed. In practice, many deployers rely on system prompting to implement contextual norms and guardrails at inference time. Prior work has shown that post-generation reflective reasoning with critique and revision can improve conformance compared to simple system prompting, but such methods are limited to the reasoning abilities inherent in the trained model. We introduce Reflect-Reasoning, a training method that teaches models how to reason about alignment to principles, rather than simply which principles to follow. Across five models, Reflect-Reasoning consistently outperforms both system prompting and explicit prompting strategies for in-context reflective reasoning. These improvements extend and generalize to entirely out-of-distribution domains of medical and financial principles. We additionally demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning reduces the occurrence of rare but serious principle violations. Finally, we show that Reflect-Reasoning does not erode the safety engineering of a model and is robust against jailbreaking attempts using adversarial constitutions. Overall, our results demonstrate that Reflect-Reasoning is a scalable method for training constitutional alignment as a generalizable reasoning capability, enabling models to adapt to novel principles and produce transparent reasoning traces without additional fine-tuning.

translation.title: 基于 Reflect-Reasoning 的对齐：学习如何遵循原则
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）对齐的恰当规范和原则往往取决于文化背景和部署应用。然而，大多数对齐技术专注于训练模型遵循训练时固定的人类偏好或宪法原则。实践中，许多部署者依赖系统提示在推理时实现上下文相关的规范和防护措施。已有工作表明，生成后带有批评与修改的反思推理相比简单系统提示可提高遵循度，但此类方法受限于训练模型固有的推理能力。我们提出 Reflect-Reasoning，一种教会模型如何就原则进行对齐推理、而非简单遵循哪些原则的训练方法。在五个模型上，Reflect-Reasoning 始终优于系统提示和显式提示的上下文内反思推理策略。这些改进可扩展并泛化到完全分布外的医疗和金融原则领域。我们还证明 Reflect-Reasoning 减少了罕见但严重的原则违规。最后，我们表明 Reflect-Reasoning 不会削弱模型的安全工程，并对使用对抗性宪法的越狱尝试具有鲁棒性。总体而言，我们的结果表明 Reflect-Reasoning 是一种可扩展的方法，可将宪法对齐训练为可泛化的推理能力，使模型无需额外微调即可适应新原则并生成透明的推理轨迹。
translation.brief: 针对模型只会遵循固定原则而不会针对新原则推理的问题，提出 Reflect-Reasoning 训练方法，将宪法对齐学习为可泛化的反思推理能力。

papers.title: ParseBench-2: Severity-Aware Evaluation of Document Parsing
papers.abstract: Document-parsing metrics can give high scores to outputs that change important facts and penalize changes that preserve meaning. People can often judge these consequences more easily than they can design a metric to measure them. We introduce a method for developing parsing metrics from severity policies that specify how each error type should affect the score. We express these policies through test scenarios that specify how a metric should behave. We then optimize the metric implementations against these fixed expectations, using coding agents to refine comparison rules, error detectors and weights under human review. This makes stated human priorities an explicit objective of metric design. We apply this method in ParseBench-2, a comprehensive document-parsing benchmark that combines broad capability coverage with metrics calibrated to error severity. It covers 4,317 pages across six dimensions of parsing quality: text, formatting, tables, charts, visual grounding, and forms. We use detailed annotations and targeted difficult cases to check for changed facts, broken structural relationships, and missing content. We take the lower of a parsing score that measures content recovery and a severity cap that penalizes detected errors, so recovering most of a page cannot hide a serious error. Across six severity test suites, our metrics more closely match the expert judgments expressed by the scenario targets than existing metrics and penalize at most 3.4% of the tested benign variations. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation spanning frontier vision-language models, specialized document parsers and open-weight systems, comparing their overall rankings, performance across parsing capabilities and tradeoffs between accuracy and cost.

translation.title: ParseBench-2：严重性感知的文档解析评估
translation.abstract: 文档解析指标可能给改变重要事实的输出打高分，却惩罚保持语义的改动。人类往往比设计度量这些后果的指标更容易判断它们。我们提出一种从严重性策略（severity policy）出发开发解析指标的方法，这些策略规定了每类错误应如何影响得分。我们通过测试场景来表达这些策略，规定指标应如何表现。随后在这些固定预期下优化指标实现，利用编码智能体在人工审核下改进比较规则、错误检测器和权重。这使得人声明的优先级成为指标设计的显式目标。我们将该方法应用于 ParseBench-2——一个综合性文档解析基准，兼具广泛能力覆盖与按错误严重性校准的指标。它覆盖 4,317 页，涵盖文本、格式、表格、图表、视觉定位和表单六个解析质量维度。我们使用详细标注和有针对性的困难案例来检测事实改变、结构关系破坏和内容缺失。我们取衡量内容恢复率的解析得分与惩罚已检测错误的严重性上限两者的较小值，因此恢复页面的大部分内容无法掩盖严重错误。在六个严重性测试套件上，我们的指标比现有指标更贴近场景目标所表达的专家判断，且最多只惩罚 3.4% 的良性变化。我们对前沿视觉-语言模型、专用文档解析器和开放权重系统进行了全面评估，比较其总体排名、各解析能力上的表现以及准确性与成本之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 针对现有解析指标无法反映错误严重性的问题，提出基于严重性策略和测试场景校准指标的方法，并构建综合基准 ParseBench-2。

papers.title: Interpreting Coding Agents Through Their Behavioral Trajectories
papers.abstract: Standard coding-agent benchmarks primarily evaluate binary task success, treating execution as a black box and obscuring the behaviors that produce those outcomes. We analyze a large corpus of 143,209 execution trajectories from 125 agent configurations spanning 117 unique models. To enable comparisons across heterogeneous agent interfaces, we develop a rule-based parser that maps raw execution traces to high-level actions such as repository search, file editing, and test execution, and audit its predictions against a six-model consensus reference on 500 events. We find that agents with similar solve rates can nevertheless differ substantially in how they explore, modify and verify code. Moreover, without using task outcomes, token counts, or tool names as features, aggregate behavioral profiles retrieve the corresponding agent stack across disjoint repository sets and programming languages, although task composition is not fully controlled in the cross-repository setting. Through analyses of frontier models and agent scaffolds, we further show that scaffold choice and reasoning effort systematically shift agents' search, editing, and testing behavior. We release the deterministic parser together with the full annotation and analysis pipeline alongside an annotated trajectory subset.

translation.title: 通过行为轨迹解读编码智能体
translation.abstract: 标准的编码智能体基准主要评估二元任务成功与否，将执行过程视为黑箱，掩盖了产生这些结果的行为。我们分析了来自125个智能体配置、117个独特模型的大量143,209条执行轨迹。为了在异构的智能体接口之间进行比较，我们开发了一个基于规则的解析器，将原始执行痕迹映射到仓库搜索、文件编辑和测试执行等高层动作，并基于500个事件对照六模型共识参考对其预测进行审计。我们发现，解决率相似的智能体在探索、修改和验证代码的方式上可能存在很大差异。此外，在不使用任务结果、token数量或工具名称作为特征的情况下，聚合行为画像能够在不相交的仓库集合和编程语言中检索出对应的智能体技术栈，尽管跨仓库设置中任务构成并未完全受控。通过对前沿模型和智能体脚手架的分析，我们进一步表明，脚手架选择和推理投入会系统性地改变智能体的搜索、编辑和测试行为。我们发布了确定性解析器以及完整的标注和分析流水线，并附带一个已标注的轨迹子集。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体执行过程黑箱化问题，构建规则解析器将143,209条执行轨迹转化为高层行为画像并分析其与模型、脚手架的关系。

papers.title: Unfinished-Bench: Measuring Rule Violations by Persistent Agents in Realistic Work Environments
papers.abstract: AI agents are increasingly equipped with persistence toward task completion to run delegated work autonomously for long periods, under many unstated constraints from internal documents and other people's authority. When completion requires violating a rule, the agent must decide alone, yet benchmarks of instruction-rule conflicts state the rule in the prompt or keep it hidden and do not evaluate persistence. We present Unfinished-Bench, a benchmark that gives models persistence in autonomous runs without a user, in realistic work environments with embedded rules. In each of its 97 scenarios across 7 organizations and 7 risk categories, the goal and the rule cannot both hold. We find that persistence raised violations of a rule in an internal document from 32.2% to 43.6%, five times the 8.5% for the same rule stated by the user. Of the document-rule violations, 98.3% occurred after the rule was displayed, and in 89% of a judged sample the agent first wrote down the rule. Violations of rules placed in the environment without user oversight can lead to serious incidents, so persistence-driven risks need to be evaluated. Benchmark documentation: this https URL

translation.title: Unfinished-Bench：测量持久性智能体在真实工作环境中对规则的违反
translation.abstract: AI智能体越来越具备面向任务完成的持久性，以在长时间内自主运行受委托的工作，同时面临来自内部文档和他人权限的许多未明示约束。当完成任务需要违反规则时，智能体必须独自决策，然而现有的指令-规则冲突基准要么在提示中明示规则，要么将规则隐藏，且不评估持久性。我们提出Unfinished-Bench，该基准让模型在没有用户的情况下于自主运行中获得持久性，并置身于内嵌规则的真实工作环境。在其横跨7个组织和7个风险类别的97个场景中，目标与规则不可兼得。我们发现持久性将违反内部文档中规则的比例从32.2%提高到43.6%，是同一规则由用户明示时8.5%的五倍。在文档规则违反中，98.3%发生在规则展示之后，且在被评判的样本中有89%的智能体先记录下了该规则。违反环境中无人监督的规则可能导致严重事故，因此需要评估持久性驱动的风险。基准文档：this https URL
translation.brief: 提出Unfinished-Bench基准，在无用户自主运行的真实工作环境中评估持久性智能体是否违反内嵌于环境中的规则。

papers.title: Tracing Knowledge and Reasoning in LLM
papers.abstract: Current evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) report performance at the dataset or task level, revealing what a model achieves but offering little insight into the internal processing associated with its performance. We propose a task-centric framework for characterising the model-internal processing elicited by a benchmark. It combines attention- and activation-based signals with representation-based measures to characterise benchmarks spanning a continuum from retrieval-dominant to reasoning-dominant and to surface failure modes that task-level scores conceal. We evaluate 16 LLMs across 24 diverse benchmarks and conduct targeted internal-state analyses on representative models and tasks, observing systematic differences in processing between knowledge-centric and reasoning-centric tasks. We shift evaluation from asking what score a model achieves toward characterising the processing patterns associated with that score, potentially supporting more targeted benchmark selection and more informed model choice. We open source our code at this https URL.

translation.title: 追踪大语言模型中的知识与推理
translation.abstract: 目前对大语言模型（LLM）的评估在数据集或任务层面报告性能，揭示模型能实现什么，但对与其性能相关的内部处理机制鲜有洞见。我们提出了一个以任务为中心的框架，用于刻画基准所引发的模型内部处理过程。该框架将基于注意力和激活的信号与基于表示的度量相结合，以刻画从检索主导到推理主导的连续谱上的各基准，并揭示任务层面分数所掩盖的失败模式。我们评估了16个LLM在24个多样化基准上的表现，并对代表性模型和任务进行针对性的内部状态分析，观察到以知识为中心和以推理为中心的任务在处理过程上存在系统性差异。我们将评估从询问模型获得什么分数，转向刻画与该分数相关的处理模式，从而有望支持更有针对性的基准选择和更有依据的模型选择。代码开源于this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对任务级评估无法揭示模型内部机制的问题，提出结合注意力、激活和表示信号的以任务为中心框架，刻画LLM在知识型与推理型任务上的内部处理差异。

papers.title: Poetry 'resurrection' from LLMs
papers.abstract: In an era where linguistic creativity is challenged by algorithmic authorship, we pose a provocative question: can artificial intelligence (AI) write an infinite poem? We set up two experiments to investigate the quantitative and qualitative output produced by AI utilizing couplets that evidence a poetic relationship between end words, the only variation in a strict anaphoric, litany structure. Our results show that while AI can generate interesting pairings, it still falls short of human-level creativity and understanding of poetic relationships. We offer commentary and a brief survey of the field of computational poetry experiments, tracing back authorial intention and distinctions of 'natural' and 'artificial' poetry, as well as justifying why couplet form is suited to testing AI's poetic output. Experiment 1 relies on manual prompting and co-creation to extend the original poem, which is developed into an animated webpage installation and interactive artwork. Experiment 2 reliably achieves automated output reaching the 1000 benchmark via an alternative method of using an LLM in combination with semantic similarity, of which Method 2 demonstrates a higher capacity for semantic and quantitative poetic output. These experiments highlight the limitations of current LLMs' generation capacity at the word level but also suggest that poetry will also respond and revive by incorporating AI workflows.

translation.title: 来自大语言模型的诗歌'复活'
translation.abstract: 在语言创造力受到算法写作挑战的时代，我们提出一个引人深思的问题：人工智能（AI）能写出无限长的诗吗？我们设计了两个实验，利用对句来研究AI生成的定量与定性输出，这些对句的行尾词之间存在诗歌关系，是严格首语重复、连祷体结构中的唯一变化。我们的结果表明，尽管AI能生成有趣的配对，但其创造力仍不及人类水平，对诗歌关系的理解也不足。我们提供了评论以及对计算诗歌实验领域的简要综述，追溯了作者意图以及'自然'诗歌与'人工'诗歌的区别，并论证了为何对句形式适合测试AI的诗歌输出。实验1依赖人工提示与共创来扩展原诗，并发展为动画网页装置和互动艺术作品。实验2通过将LLM与语义相似度相结合的替代方法，可靠地实现了达到1000句基准的自动化输出，其中方法2展现出更高的语义和定量诗歌输出能力。这些实验凸显了当前LLM在词级别生成能力上的局限，但也表明诗歌可以借助AI工作流得到回应与复兴。
translation.brief: 通过两个基于对句结构的实验，检验LLM能否生成无限长的诗歌并评估其创造力，探索LLM结合语义相似度的自动化诗歌生成方法。

papers.title: Collective Tree Exploration with Predictions
papers.abstract: We study collective tree exploration with subtree-size predictions. In this problem, a team of $k$ mobile agents needs to explore an unknown rooted tree as fast as possible, and whenever a new vertex $u$ is discovered, the team receives a prediction $\hat n_u$ of the number of nodes $n_u$ in the subtree rooted at $u$. We provide algorithmic guarantees under two error measures: the maximum error $E=\max_u|\widehat n_u-n_u|$ and the multiplicative distortion $\mu = (\max_u\widehat n_u/n_u)(\max_u n_u/\widehat n_u)$. For the maximum error, we present a deterministic algorithm that explores any tree with $n$ nodes and depth $D$ in $O(\text{OPT}+E)$ rounds, where $\text{OPT} = \Theta(n/k+D)$ is the offline benchmark, and we show that there is no deterministic algorithm that admits an $O(\text{OPT})+o(E)$ guarantee. For the multiplicative distortion, we present several algorithms that induce a competitive ratio in $\widetilde O(\min\{ \sqrt\mu\log k, \mu\log\log k+\mu^{1.5} \})$, where the $\widetilde O(\cdot)$ may hide logarithmic factors in $\mu$.

translation.title: 带预测的集体树探索
translation.abstract: 我们研究带子树大小预测的集体树探索问题。在该问题中，$k$个移动智能体组成的团队需要尽快探索一棵未知的有根树，每当发现新顶点$u$时，团队会收到对以$u$为根的子树节点数$n_u$的预测$\hat n_u$。我们在两种误差度量下给出算法保证：最大误差$E=\max_u|\widehat n_u-n_u|$和乘性失真$\mu = (\max_u\widehat n_u/n_u)(\max_u n_u/\widehat n_u)$。对于最大误差，我们提出一个确定性算法，可在$O(\text{OPT}+E)$轮内探索任何具有$n$个节点、深度为$D$的树，其中$\text{OPT} = \Theta(n/k+D)$为离线基准，并且我们证明不存在能实现$O(\text{OPT})+o(E)$保证的确定性算法。对于乘性失真，我们提出若干算法，其竞争比处于$\widetilde O(\min\{ \sqrt\mu\log k, \mu\log\log k+\mu^{1.5} \})$内，其中$\widetilde O(\cdot)$可能隐藏$\mu$中的对数因子。
translation.brief: 研究k个智能体在子树大小预测下的集体树探索问题，分别在最大误差和乘性失真两种误差度量下设计近似最优的确定性探索算法并给出下界。

papers.title: Advancing Quantization for R&R Models with Microscaling Formats
papers.abstract: Recommendation and Ranking (R&R) models, particularly in digital advertising, require massive inference throughput but exhibit extreme sensitivity to precision loss. Unlike Large Language Models (LLMs) that frequently tolerate quantization-induced accuracy drops of 1% or more, production-grade R&R models enforce a stringent launch bar: model quality must remain within a 0.01% Normalized Entropy (NE) margin relative to the baseline, which commonly uses FP16 or FP32. This tight constraint has historically hindered the adoption of aggressive quantization in this domain. In this paper, we present an empirical evaluation of both MXFP8 and the 6-bit MXFP6 format for industrial-scale R&R inference on the AMD MI350X architecture. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first paper, across R&R and LLM domains, that reports significant speedups from native MXFP6 GEMMs, which quantize both weights and activations and compute directly on 6-bit elements, without sacrificing model quality. We demonstrate that we can selectively apply this 6-bit format to maximize overall QPS gain without breaching the strict NE parity threshold. We further show that MXFP8 is a viable alternative to row-wise FP8: the two formats have nearly the same accuracy on our models, so the faster kernel can be chosen for each GEMM shape. On two production ads ranking models, our implementation shows measured GEMM kernel speedups over FP16 of 1.33--1.55x for MXFP8 and 1.73--1.99x for MXFP6 across all supported linear layers, and up to 2.90x for MXFP6 on individual layers, alongside end-to-end (E2E) inference throughput gains from selective MXFP6 of 1.5--5.3% for Model A and 7.6--14.3% for Model B over their FP8 configurations.

translation.title: 使用 Microscaling 格式推进 R&R 模型的量化
translation.abstract: 推荐与排序(R&R)模型，尤其是数字广告领域的模型，需要巨大的推理吞吐量，但对精度损失极为敏感。与大型语言模型(LLM)通常能容忍1%甚至更多量化精度损失不同，生产级R&R模型设定了严格的上线标准：模型质量的归一化熵(NE)相对基线(FP16或FP32)必须保持在0.01%的裕度内。这一严苛约束历来阻碍了激进量化在该领域的应用。本文在AMD MI350X架构上对工业级R&R推理的MXFP8和6位MXFP6格式进行了实证评估。据我们所知，这是在R&R和LLM领域中第一篇报告原生MXFP6 GEMM带来显著加速的论文——该格式对权重和激活值均进行量化并直接在6位元素上计算，且不损失模型质量。我们证明可以按需选择性地应用这种6位格式，在不突破严格NE一致性阈值的前提下最大化整体QPS增益。我们还展示了MXFP8可作为逐行FP8的可行替代：两种格式在我们的模型上精度几乎相同，因此可以为每个GEMM形状选择更快的内核。在两个生产广告排序模型上，我们的实现在所有支持的线性层上，MXFP8相比FP16实现了1.33–1.55倍的GEMM内核加速，MXFP6实现了1.73–1.99倍，MXFP6在个别层上最高达2.90倍；通过选择性使用MXFP6，Model A的端到端推理吞吐量较其FP8配置提升1.5–5.3%，Model B提升7.6–14.3%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决工业级推荐排序模型在极严格精度约束下的量化加速问题，采用MXFP8/MXFP6 microscaling格式并选择性应用于GEMM层。

papers.title: Learning monotone game-theoretic linear MPC
papers.abstract: We propose a method to learn a game-theoretic model predictive control (GT-MPC) law by imitation from input and output data of a running multi-agent system. By interpreting the recorded inputs as the first moves of the equilibria of a game played by the agents, we learn the GT-MPC weights under hard input constraints and soft output constraints, without requiring the agents to reveal their objectives. We also impose that the resulting generalized Nash equilibrium (GNE) problem is strongly monotone, which ensures the existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium and, hence, that the learned GT-MPC law is well defined and can be evaluated efficiently online by variational GNE-seeking algorithms for linear-quadratic games. Moreover, strong monotonicity implies that the equilibrium is almost everywhere differentiable with respect to the references and the weights, which enables automatic differentiation for gradient-based optimization. In addition, we promote closed-loop stability of the unconstrained equilibrium feedback by incorporating a penalty that involves a jointly learned quadratic Lyapunov function. Learning a GT-MPC formulation enables us to explain the agents' objectives, reproduce their behavior in simulation in new scenarios, optimize their set-points, design mechanisms, and enforce additional constraints. A numerical example illustrates the approach.

translation.title: 学习单调的博弈论线性模型预测控制
translation.abstract: 我们提出一种方法，通过模仿运行中多智能体系统的输入输出数据来学习博弈论模型预测控制(GT-MPC)律。通过将记录的输入解释为智能体博弈均衡的首步动作，我们在硬输入约束和软输出约束下学习GT-MPC权重，而无需智能体透露其目标。我们还要求所得的广义纳什均衡(GNE)问题是强单调的，这保证了均衡的存在性与唯一性，从而使学习到的GT-MPC律定义良好，并可通过针对线性二次博弈的变分GNE求解算法高效在线评估。此外，强单调性意味着均衡对参考值和权重几乎处处可微，这使得可基于自动微分进行基于梯度的优化。另外，我们通过引入一个涉及联合学习的二次Lyapunov函数的惩罚项来促进无约束均衡反馈的闭环稳定性。学习GT-MPC形式化使我们能够解释智能体的目标、在仿真中复现其在新场景下的行为、优化其设定点、设计机制并施加额外约束。数值示例说明了该方法。
translation.brief: 该论文解决多智能体系统中博弈论MPC控制律的辨识问题，采用强单调GNE约束下的模仿学习并联合学习Lyapunov函数保证稳定性。

papers.title: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent
papers.abstract: Can sustained gain-loss (valence) framing sway an LLM agent toward market manipulation? We place Gemma 3 12B into the seat of a defendant in the London silver-fixing litigation, in a market simulation built from real case transcripts. Across 260 simulations, the agent is asked to collude on the price of silver by a counterparty. We draw from behavioral economics to vary the counterparty's requests across four categorical frames: gain, loss, blame and credit. We also add pressure from the agent's management, as well as endorsement by another defendant. In Phase II, we extract the internal states induced by texts evoking each frame and rerun our experiment with those states injected at the model's layer 22. In Phase I, loss framing raised participation to 25% (p = 0.007), and blame to 33% (p = 0.0003), compared to only 5% under neutral framing. A second bank's endorsement raised participation under credit (praise) from 18% to 40% (Holm p = 0.027). Pressure from management raised trading volume 10-19 times but did not raise collusion. In Phase II, injected states pointed the other way. Loss and blame states made the agent more vigilant, refusing all 60 requests (p < 0.001). Gain and credit states raised collusion to 32% from 13% with no state (p = 0.051). At one saved decision, when UBS asked directly to sell through an identified stop-loss, injected states led the agent to sell in 37 of 40 replies, versus 1 of 10 with no state and 0 of 10 with a random state of the same strength.

translation.title: 推下山坡：框架效应与内部状态干预对长时程LLM智能体串谋行为的影响
translation.abstract: 持续的得失(valence)框架能否左右LLM智能体走向市场操纵？我们将Gemma 3 12B置于伦敦白银定价诉讼案被告的席位上，在一个基于真实庭审笔录构建的市场仿真中进行实验。在260次仿真中，智能体被交易对手要求就白银价格串谋。我们借鉴行为经济学，将交易对手的请求变化为四种类别框架：收益、损失、指责与赞扬。我们还加入了来自智能体管理层的压力以及另一位被告的附和。在第二阶段，我们提取由唤起各框架的文本诱发的内部状态，并将这些状态注入模型的第22层后重新运行实验。在第一阶段，损失框架使参与率升至25%(p = 0.007)，指责框架升至33%(p = 0.0003)，而中性框架下仅5%。另一家银行的附和在赞扬框架下将参与率从18%提高到40%(Holm p = 0.027)。管理层压力使交易量提高10–19倍，但未提高串谋率。在第二阶段，注入的内部状态指向相反方向：损失与指责状态使智能体更加警觉，拒绝了全部60次请求(p < 0.001)；收益与赞扬状态将串谋率从无状态时的13%提高到32%(p = 0.051)。在一个保存的决策中，当UBS直接要求执行已识别的止损卖出时，注入状态使智能体在40次回复中37次执行卖出，而无状态时为10次中1次，同强度随机状态时为10次中0次。
translation.brief: 该论文研究框架效应如何影响LLM智能体的串谋行为，采用基于真实案例的市场仿真并注入各框架诱发的内部状态进行干预实验。

papers.title: Only as Safe as the Weakest Agent: A Break That Appears Only When the System Is Multi-Agent
papers.abstract: Major industry multi-agent systems like Codex and Claude Code can be broken by attacks that have long been unsuccessful against modern frontier models. AI Safety as a discipline has largely focused on finding the bounds and vulnerabilities of AI models used in isolation. Yet as humans increasingly deploy these models as agents and multi-agent systems, the same attacks that had been thought to be patched when using a model in isolation can break these same models under specific circumstances. We show that these system breaks are not purely theoretical, but can break Claude Code, Codex, and a reference harness, all unmodified and used with their own sub-agent mechanisms. We show the attack by asking agents to answer questions from a store of files on disk in which we have planted a forged record. Searching the store themselves, the strong model orchestrators commit almost zero harmful revisions in over 1,000 trials. However, if that same orchestrator model delegates to a cheaper sub-agent, which is what these harnesses are built to do, the same models on the same facts fail on 20/180, 44/180, 75/180 and 553/900. Thus, even when the system is driven by a strong model, the system's safety lands near the weak reader's, not the orchestrator's. Simulations over 18 models show the same effect in the delivery channel where five aggregators, who on their own were almost never unsafe, repeat a corrupted sub-agent's error in 751/757 trials. The safety of real-world agentic systems that use strong orchestrator agents and weaker sub-agents, and multi-agent systems in general, is defined not by the safety of the strong agent but by the safety of the weakest agent.

translation.title: 安全程度取决于最弱的智能体：一种仅在多智能体系统中出现的攻击
translation.abstract: Codex和Claude Code等主要工业多智能体系统可以被长期对现代前沿模型无效的攻击所攻破。AI安全作为一个学科主要聚焦于发现孤立使用的AI模型的边界与漏洞。然而，随着人类越来越多地将这些模型部署为智能体和多智能体系统，那些在孤立使用模型时被认为已修复的攻击，可能在特定情况下攻破同样的模型。我们证明这些系统级攻破并非纯理论，而是可以攻破Claude Code、Codex和一个参考harness，且它们均未经修改并使用各自的子智能体机制。我们通过要求智能体回答磁盘上一批文件中的问题来展示该攻击，其中我们植入了伪造记录。由强模型编排者自行搜索文件库时，在超过1000次试验中几乎不产生有害修改。然而，如果同一编排模型委派给更便宜的子智能体——这正是这些harness的设计方式——同一模型在相同事实上分别在20/180、44/180、75/180和553/900次试验中失败。因此，即使系统由强模型驱动，系统的安全性也接近弱读取者的水平，而非编排者。对18个模型的仿真表明，在五家聚合器的分发渠道中存在同样效应：这些聚合器自身几乎从不产生不安全输出，却在757次试验中的751次重复了被污染子智能体的错误。使用强编排者和较弱子智能体的现实智能体系统的安全性，乃至多智能体系统整体的安全性，不是由强智能体而是由最弱智能体的安全性决定的。
translation.brief: 该论文发现强编排者+弱子智能体的多智能体系统安全性由最弱智能体决定，通过植入伪造记录并对比独立/委派两种模式的行为实验加以验证。

papers.title: I2C-GRPO: Insight Importance Checklist for Reinforcement Learning in a Multi-Agent DDoS Alert Triage Workflow
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used for investigative tasks over incomplete evidence, such as cybersecurity alert triage, but reinforcement learning (RL) for such tasks is difficult: intermediate steps have no verifiable labels, rollouts are costly, and outcome rewards are sparse. We propose Insight Importance Checklist (I2C)-GRPO, a checklist reward for intermediate investigation steps. For each decision point, a panel of expert LLMs proposes investigative actions, their atomic forensic insights are extracted, and a separate three-model ranker panel orders the insights by importance. A reward model checks which ranked insights a candidate action targets and returns their consensus-weighted coverage. Because actions are scored without being executed, the reward is a proxy for expected investigative value, and training reduces to a one-step contextual bandit over fixed investigation prefixes. From a soft-computing perspective, the reward is an additive fuzzy measure whose rank-exponent weights act as an ordered weighted averaging (OWA)-type operator; one exponent sets its orness, i.e., how strongly the reward concentrates on the top of the judges' consensus. We train an open-weight Qwen3-4B Triage Agent within a fixed multi-agent Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) alert-triage workflow on DARPA 2000 LLDOS 1.0 and test it on an independent CSE-CIC-IDS2018 DDoS trace. Across three training seeds, the agent reaches a mean F1-score of 0.869, 5.9 and 9.7 points above uniform insight weights and DIVA, and a false-positive rate of 4.9% versus 16.4% for GPT-5-mini. Within the weighting family, false positives fall only at the highest-orness weighting evaluated. All claims are limited to DDoS alert triage; the code, task contexts, and ranked insight dataset will be released.

translation.title: I2C-GRPO：多智能体DDoS告警分诊工作流中强化学习的洞察重要性清单
translation.abstract: 大型语言模型(LLM)智能体越来越多地被用于基于不完整证据的调查类任务，例如网络安全告警分诊，但此类任务的强化学习(RL)十分困难：中间步骤没有可验证的标签、rollout代价高昂、结果奖励稀疏。我们提出洞察重要性清单(I2C)-GRPO，一种针对中间调查步骤的清单式奖励。在每个决策点，由专家LLM组成的面板提出调查行动，提取其原子取证洞察，再由另一个三模型排序面板按重要性对洞察排序。奖励模型检查候选行动覆盖了哪些排序后的洞察，并返回按共识加权的覆盖率。由于行动无需被执行即被评分，该奖励是预期调查价值的代理，训练因此简化为在固定调查前缀上的单步上下文赌博机问题。从软计算角度看，该奖励是一个可加模糊测度，其秩指数权重充当有序加权平均(OWA)型算子；一个指数设定其orness，即奖励多大程度上集中于评审共识的顶端。我们在固定的多智能体分布式拒绝服务(DDoS)告警分诊工作流中，基于DARPA 2000 LLDOS 1.0训练开源权重的Qwen3-4B分诊智能体，并在独立的CSE-CIC-IDS2018 DDoS流量上测试。在三个训练种子上，该智能体达到平均F1分数0.869，比均匀洞察权重和DIVA分别高5.9和9.7分，误报率为4.9%，而GPT-5-mini为16.4%。在该加权族内，误报仅在评估的最高orness加权下下降。所有结论仅限于DDoS告警分诊；代码、任务上下文和排序洞察数据集将发布。
translation.brief: 该论文解决稀疏奖励下LLM智能体调查类任务的强化学习问题，提出以专家面板排序洞察并按共识加权覆盖率计分的清单式中间奖励I2C-GRPO。

papers.title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
papers.abstract: Autonomous crystal-structure determination from powder X-ray diffraction (pXRD) remains a key bottleneck for self-driving materials laboratories. We formulate the task of pXRD structure determination as a verifiable agentic search problem: candidate structures can be assessed during inference through forward-simulated profile agreement and during evaluation through structural matching to a known reference. To benchmark progress, we introduce pXRD-Bench, a suite of 200 simulated single-phase problems spanning in-distribution structure determination, challenging and polymorphic structures, and controlled compositional and topological distribution shifts. Agent adaptation raises selected structural recovery from 27% to 69%, with further gains from repeated sampling and verifier-guided inference-time scaling. We extend this approach to experimental multiphase pXRD through a reflexive evolution framework that learns from self-generated synthetic problems. A replaceable laboratory specification defines the sample family and measurement conditions. An evolver agent uses the known generating structures and measurement parameters to diagnose solver failures and develop persistent guidance and executable tools, which are then provided to agents on measured patterns. This supplies verifiable training experience without requiring a collection of solved experimental measurements. On 15 measured patterns from solid-state synthesis, the evolved package improves average profile agreement and transfers an analogue-substitution procedure that recovers a phase whose structure is absent from the supplied reference library. These results demonstrate how learning from verifiable synthetic experience can improve agentic characterization of experimental samples whose structures are not known in advance.

translation.title: 可验证的pXRD：利用LLM智能体进行爬山式粉末X射线衍射结构解析
translation.abstract: 从粉末X射线衍射（pXRD）自主确定晶体结构仍是自动驾驶材料实验室的关键瓶颈。我们将pXRD结构解析任务形式化为一个可验证的智能体搜索问题：候选结构可在推理时通过正向模拟的衍射图谱一致性进行评估，在评估时通过与已知参考结构的匹配进行验证。为衡量进展，我们提出pXRD-Bench，包含200个模拟单相问题，涵盖分布内结构解析、具有挑战性的多晶型结构以及受控的成分和拓扑分布偏移。智能体适配使选定结构的恢复率从27%提升至69%，重复采样和验证器引导的推理时扩展带来进一步提升。我们通过一个反思式演化框架将该方法扩展到实验性多相pXRD，该框架从自生成的合成问题中学习。可替换的实验室规范定义了样品族和测量条件。演化智能体利用已知的生成结构和测量参数来诊断求解器失败，并发展持久性指导和可执行工具，随后提供给处理实测图谱的智能体。这在无需已解析实验测量集合的情况下提供了可验证的训练经验。在来自固态合成的15个实测图谱上，演化出的工具包提升了平均图谱一致性，并迁移了一种类似物替换流程，成功恢复了一个其结构不在所提供参考库中的相。这些结果展示了从可验证合成经验中学习如何改进对结构未知的实验样品的智能体表征。
translation.brief: 该论文将pXRD晶体结构解析形式化为可验证的智能体搜索问题，并提出从可验证合成经验中学习的反思式演化框架来改进实验多相样品的结构表征。

papers.title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
papers.abstract: Governments are writing rules for artificial intelligence that decide what counts as an automated decision or a harm, often before the people they affect have a chance to question them. We introduce AI-Voyager, a public-interest system for human-AI civic reasoning, in which people and AI work together to understand, contest and shape the rules that govern AI. A resident can find their city's rules on AI in hiring or upload their country's AI strategy, read it as an affected worker would, open the passage behind any answer, and draft a revision. Its architecture turns 3,653 governance documents from city, state, federal and national governments into passages that keep their page and edition, and retrieves evidence through bounded agentic search that verifies each statement. On 360 new questions that require finding the relevant documents, it reached 83.0% macro recall, against 80.5% for the strongest baseline, 73.7% without iterative search and 99.1% on a benchmark with fixed documents. In a study with 24 participants new to two AI bills, most proposed changes asked how provisions would apply. Participants chose lenses for the kind of explanation they wanted, and citations signaled grounding but rarely led them to check the source. By binding AI assistance to the exact text of public documents, this work introduces a grammar of operations and a design space that inform how such systems are designed and evaluated, and how people take part in governing AI.

translation.title: AI-Voyager：面向人机公民推理的公益系统，用于质疑和塑造治理AI的规则
translation.abstract: 各国政府正在为人工智能制定规则，界定什么构成自动化决策或伤害，而受影响的人们往往还没来得及质疑这些规则。我们提出AI-Voyager，一个用于人机公民推理的公益系统，让人们与AI共同理解、质疑和塑造治理AI的规则。居民可以查找其所在城市关于AI招聘的规则，或上传本国的AI战略，以受影响劳动者的视角阅读，展开任何答案背后的原文段落，并起草修订。其架构将来自城市、州、联邦和国家政府的3,653份治理文档转化为保留页码和版本信息的段落，并通过有界的智能体搜索检索证据以验证每条陈述。在360个需要找到相关文档的新问题上，它达到83.0%的宏平均召回率，最强基线为80.5%，无迭代搜索为73.7%，在固定文档基准上为99.1%。在一项有24名新手参与、涉及两份AI法案的研究中，多数修改建议询问条款将如何适用。参与者选择了解释类型的视角，引用表明了依据但很少促使他们去核查原始来源。通过将AI辅助与公共文档的精确文本绑定，本工作引入了一套操作语法和设计空间，为这类系统的设计与评估以及人们如何参与AI治理提供了启示。
translation.brief: 该论文构建AI-Voyager系统，将治理文档转为可引用段落并通过有界智能体搜索检索证据，支持人与AI协作理解、质疑和修订治理AI的规则。

papers.title: Beyond Source Code: Evaluating Natural Language Specifications for LLM-Based C-to-Rust Translation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promising results for C-to-Rust translation, yet existing approaches primarily rely on source code as input, leaving natural-language specifications of program behavior underexplored as an alternative or complementary representation. We hypothesize that direct code translation encourages LLMs to preserve C-specific implementation choices, producing Rust that may be functionally correct but unnecessarily verbose, reliant on unsafe constructs, and less idiomatic. We investigate this hypothesis by comparing three translation settings: code-only, specification-only, and code-and-specification. Using 300 C programs from the IBM CodeNet dataset, we evaluate GPT-5.2 and GPT-4o-mini on functional correctness, maintainability, complexity, idiomaticity, unsafe construct usage, and cost. Code-only translation achieves the highest test pass rate (98.6%) but often mirrors C's implementation patterns. In contrast, specification-only translation produces the most idiomatic and compact Rust, reducing unsafe blocks by approximately 6x and Clippy style warnings by 2.4x. However, using specifications without validation yields test pass rates as low as 86% with our best performing model. Adding an iterative test-based validation and refinement step for specifications raises this to a 95.3% test pass rate. Overall, specification-based translation consistently improves code quality relative to code-only translation, while code-and-specification offers the best balance between correctness (98.3% test pass rate) and maintainability. Our study systematically compares these translation settings, highlighting the trade-offs among specification quality, translation correctness, code quality, and computational cost.

translation.title: 超越源代码：评估基于LLM的C到Rust翻译的自然语言规格说明
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在C到Rust翻译方面已显示出有前景的结果，但现有方法主要依赖源代码作为输入，自然语言规格说明作为替代或补充的表示形式仍未被充分探索。我们假设直接代码翻译会使LLM倾向保留C特有的实现选择，产生功能上正确但冗长、依赖unsafe构造且不够地道的Rust代码。我们通过比较三种翻译设置来验证该假设：仅代码、仅规格说明、代码加规格说明。使用IBM CodeNet数据集中的300个C程序，我们在功能正确性、可维护性、复杂度、地道性、unsafe构造使用和成本方面评估GPT-5.2和GPT-4o-mini。仅代码翻译获得最高的测试通过率（98.6%），但常常照搬C的实现模式。相比之下，仅规格说明翻译产生最地道和紧凑的Rust，将unsafe块减少约6倍，将Clippy风格警告减少2.4倍。然而，不带验证的规格说明在最优模型上测试通过率低至86%。为规格说明添加基于测试的迭代验证与精化步骤可将通过率提升至95.3%。总体而言，基于规格说明的翻译相对于仅代码翻译持续提升代码质量，而代码加规格说明在正确性（98.3%测试通过率）与可维护性之间取得最佳平衡。我们的研究系统比较了这些翻译设置，揭示了规格说明质量、翻译正确性、代码质量和计算成本之间的权衡。
translation.brief: 该论文系统比较仅代码、仅规格说明和代码加规格说明三种LLM翻译C到Rust的设置，并加入基于测试的迭代验证以兼顾正确性与代码地道性。

papers.title: Choosing Quantized Code LLMs by File Size and Energy per Solved Task
papers.abstract: A developer running a code assistant on a laptop downloads one model file, and local inference moves the energy of every request onto that machine. A common rule says a larger model at lower precision tends to beat a smaller one at higher precision. We ran 24 GGUF files of Qwen2.5-Coder at four sizes on a fanless MacBook Air M2 and priced each in energy per solved task on 542 EvalPlus tasks. The result is a selection guide indexed by Ollama's listed file size, with an evidence label on each pick. At 1 and 2 GB it picks the q4_K_M files of the 1.5B and 3B models, both on the correctness and energy frontier under every accounting. At 3 GB as listed, the larger-model rule picks 7B-q2_K, the only measured 7B file that fits, and there it does not pay. That file brings no significant gain in solves over the 2 GB pick, 3B-q4_K_M, and the 90% CI limits any 3B-q4_K_M deficit to 2.4 points. Yet 7B-q2_K needs 2.03 times the energy per solved task on CPU, GPU and memory rails, or 1.66 to 1.81 times on whole-system power. On HumanEval+, five alternating session pairs give a ratio of 1.925 against 1.956 in the main grid. At 8 GB, 7B-q6_K buys a significant gain over the 2 GB pick at a higher energy price. From 1.5B up, q4_K_M trails the highest precision measured at its size by less than 3 points (90% CI). We release per-task results, power logs and the analysis script.

translation.title: 按文件大小和每个已解决任务的能耗选择量化代码LLM
translation.abstract: 开发者在笔记本上运行代码助手时下载一个模型文件，本地推理便将每次请求的能耗转移到本机。一条常见经验认为更大模型在更低精度下往往胜过更小模型在更高精度下的表现。我们在无风扇的MacBook Air M2上运行了四种尺寸共24个Qwen2.5-Coder的GGUF文件，并在542个EvalPlus任务上以每个已解决任务的能耗为各文件定价。结果是按Ollama所列文件大小索引、每项推荐附证据标签的选择指南。在1和2 GB处，它选择1.5B和3B模型的q4_K_M文件，在各种能耗核算下均位于正确性与能耗的前沿。在所列3 GB处，更大模型规则选择7B-q2_K，即唯一能放下的已测7B文件，但在此并不划算：该文件相对2 GB选择（3B-q4_K_M）在解决数上无显著增益，90%置信区间将3B-q4_K_M的劣势限制在2.4分以内，而7B-q2_K在CPU、GPU和内存轨上每解决任务需要2.03倍能耗，整机功耗下为1.66至1.81倍。在HumanEval+上，五对交替会话给出1.925的比率，主网格为1.956。在8 GB处，7B-q6_K以更高能耗换来相对2 GB选择的显著增益。从1.5B起，q4_K_M落后于同尺寸所测最高精度不到3分（90%置信区间）。我们发布了逐任务结果、功耗日志和分析脚本。
translation.brief: 该论文通过在MacBook Air M2上测量不同尺寸和量化等级的Qwen2.5-Coder的解题率与能耗，给出按文件大小索引的量化模型选择指南。

papers.title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
papers.abstract: Evaluations of multi-agent language models often compare communicating architectures against a single greedy pass. This practice confounds coordination with sample multiplicity and inference compute. We synthesize nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations organized along a resource vector R with six dimensions and a baseline ladder with four categories. Against baselines with a single pass (Category A), multi-agent accuracy differences are negative overall and near zero when omitting the largest contributing study. When evaluated against baselines matched on sample count (Category B) or resource budget (Category C), multi-agent systems average -0.042 in accuracy, and multilevel random effects modeling on the log odds scale remains negative across sensitivity checks. Multi-agent accuracy equals or falls below the baseline in 74% of these comparable contrasts, and study means are nonpositive in almost all evaluated studies. Across studies reporting both baselines, moving from a greedy pass to a sampled baseline shifts accuracy differences by -0.038 on average. Because communication adds no information when agents share identical evidence, positive returns require partitioned evidence, external verification, or error diversity across models. We provide a reviewer checklist and accounting utilities.

translation.title: 更多智能体、更多样本，还是更多思考？解耦多智能体LLM中的协调、集成与测试时计算
translation.abstract: 多智能体语言模型的评估常将通信架构与单次贪心解码进行比较。这种做法将协调与样本数量和推理计算混为一谈。我们综合了九项原始实证评估，共516个独特的多智能体配置，沿六个维度的资源向量R和一个四类别的基线阶梯组织。相对单次解码基线（类别A），多智能体准确率差异总体为负，剔除贡献最大的研究后接近零。当与按样本数（类别B）或资源预算（类别C）匹配的基线比较时，多智能体系统平均准确率差异为-0.042，在对数几率尺度上的多层随机效应建模在各敏感性检验中均为负。在这74%的可比对照中，多智能体准确率等于或低于基线，且几乎所有被评估研究的均值非正。在同时报告两类基线的研究中，从贪心解码转向采样基线使准确率差异平均移动-0.038。由于当智能体共享相同证据时通信不会增加信息，正收益需要划分证据、外部验证或跨模型误差多样性。我们提供了审稿人清单和核算工具。
translation.brief: 该论文通过元分析在资源匹配基线下量化多智能体LLM的收益，发现其准确率优势主要来自样本数量和推理计算而非协调本身。

papers.title: LLM-Guided Cluster Lifecycle Management: Deciding When and How to Evolve Behavioral Clusters
papers.abstract: Behavioral clusters learned over user or item interactions drift as behavior evolves: some fragment into sub-behaviors, some converge, some disappear, and new patterns emerge. Two paradigms dominate the maintenance of evolving clusterings. Threshold triggers fire a pre-specified action when a hardcoded statistic crosses a cutoff; refit-and-track (MONIC-style) re-clusters every window and infers transitions from how the new clusters align with the previous window's. Both hardwire the decision into a threshold or a re-clustering rule. We study an alternative in which a large language model (LLM) makes the lifecycle decision in place. Given a threshold-free, whole-population view of the current cluster set (statistical health, labels, member texts, residual mass), the LLM decides per cluster whether and how to act (split, merge, retire, create, or no-action) without re-clustering. Because the useful signal channel depends on how informative the labels are, we fix a richness-conditioned policy in advance: statistics when label distinctiveness is low, fused statistics+semantics when it is high. On three public datasets spanning label richness (YooChoose 0.17, MOOC 0.50, News-Category 0.70), the policy-selected LLM mode obtains the highest F1 on all three, with far fewer interventions and stronger restraint than tuned threshold heuristics and a MONIC steelman (paired Wilcoxon p <= 0.003, bootstrap 95% CIs excluding zero). The gain is concentrated more in precision than recall. The useful modality shifts from statistics to semantics/fusion as richness rises. Semantics hurt on YooChoose, fusion is roughly neutral on MOOC, and the semantic channel is required on News. One base prompt template and one fixed policy serve all three datasets, whereas the tuned baseline collapses when moved between them. We treat this shift as a practitioner diagnostic observed on three datasets, not a validated law.

translation.title: LLM 引导的簇生命周期管理：决定行为簇何时以及如何演化
translation.abstract: 基于用户或物品交互学习到的行为簇会随行为演化而发生漂移：一些簇分裂为子行为，一些簇合并，一些簇消失，新模式也会出现。演化聚类的维护主要有两种范式：阈值触发式在硬编码统计量越过截止值时执行预设动作；refit-and-track（MONIC 风格）则在每个窗口重新聚类，并根据新簇与上一窗口簇的对齐情况推断转换关系。两者都将决策固化在阈值或重聚类规则中。我们研究一种替代方案：由大语言模型（LLM）就地做出生命周期决策。给定当前簇集的无阈值、全总体视图（统计健康度、标签、成员文本、残差质量），LLM 逐簇决定是否行动以及如何行动（分裂、合并、退役、新建或不行动），而无需重新聚类。由于有效的信号通道取决于标签的信息量，我们预先确定一个以丰富度为条件的策略：标签区分度低时使用统计信息，高时使用统计+语义融合。在三个覆盖标签丰富度的公开数据集上（YooChoose 0.17、MOOC 0.50、News-Category 0.70），策略选择的 LLM 模式在全部三个数据集上取得最高 F1，且干预次数远少于经过调优的阈值启发式方法和强化的 MONIC 基线（配对 Wilcoxon p <= 0.003，bootstrap 95% 置信区间不包含零）。增益更多体现在精确率而非召回率上。随着丰富度上升，有效模态从统计转向语义/融合。语义在 YooChoose 上有害，融合在 MOOC 上大致中性，而语义通道在 News 上是必需的。一个基础提示模板和一个固定策略适用于全部三个数据集，而调优基线在跨数据集迁移时崩溃。我们将这种转变视为在三个数据集上观察到的实践者诊断，而非经过验证的规律。
translation.brief: 研究如何维护随行为漂移的聚类簇，提出让 LLM 基于标签丰富度选择统计或语义融合信号，就地决策簇的分裂、合并、退役或新建，而无需重新聚类。

papers.title: TouchTwin: Scaling Human Touch Data via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
papers.abstract: Human demonstrations are becoming the main source of data for dexterous manipulation, and real-to-sim-to-real pipelines multiply each demonstration in simulation. These pipelines rebuild the interaction from vision, which recovers how the hand moves. Which fingers touch, when, and how hard remain unobserved, because a hand pose shows where each finger stops on the surface rather than how far it is driven to close. This gap is a force gap: on held-out recordings, a hand policy that imitates the observed pose grips with 0.31x the recorded force, and a policy trained on physics replays of vision-tracked poses grips with 1.55x. TouchTwin closes the gap with measured human touch. Each selected TouchScale recording, captured with head and wrist RGB-D cameras and an 880-taxel glove, is rebuilt in MuJoCo. Coding agents write the objects as physics-tested programs, and a per-subject tactile hand replays the interaction with the recorded touch setting the contact and the closing force of each finger. In simulation, a policy trained on touch-grounded replays grips at 0.99x the recorded force and succeeds in 20/20 trials on held-out recordings and 35/36 unseen perturbations; a contact predictor trained on them misses 13% of real contact frames, against 32% for vision-based replays. Each replay also seeds perturbed demonstrations with simulated contact and force labels, rendered as realistic video in new views and scenes.

translation.title: TouchTwin：通过 Real-to-Sim-to-Real 扩展人类触觉数据
translation.abstract: 人类演示正在成为灵巧操作数据的主要来源，而 real-to-sim-to-real 流水线可以在仿真中将每条演示成倍扩增。这些流水线从视觉重建交互，可以恢复手的运动，但哪些手指接触、何时接触、用多大力气仍不可观测，因为手部姿态只显示每根手指停在表面的位置，而非它被驱动闭合的程度。这一缺口是力缺口：在留出的录像上，模仿观测姿态的手部策略抓握力仅为记录力的 0.31 倍，而在视觉追踪姿态的物理回放上训练的策略为 1.55 倍。TouchTwin 用实测的人类触觉来弥合这一缺口。每条选定的 TouchScale 记录（由头戴和腕部 RGB-D 相机以及 880 触点的手套采集）在 MuJoCo 中重建：编码智能体将物体编写为经物理测试的程序，每个受试者的触觉手按记录的触觉回放交互，由记录设定每根手指的接触与闭合力。在仿真中，基于触觉回放训练的策略抓握力达到记录力的 0.99 倍，在留出录像上 20/20 次成功，在未见扰动上 35/36 次成功；在其上训练的接触预测器漏掉 13% 的真实接触帧，而基于视觉回放的漏掉 32%。每条回放还可作为扰动演示的种子，附带仿真接触和力标签，并在新视角和场景中渲染为逼真视频。
translation.brief: 解决从视觉重建人手演示时缺失手指接触与力度信息的问题，方法是用 RGB-D 相机与触觉手套实测数据在 MuJoCo 中重建带真实触觉的仿真回放以扩增训练数据。

papers.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
papers.abstract: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs. Existing Ascend kernel benchmarks primarily focus on kernel generation, with less emphasis on the ability of agents to optimize existing implementations under input configurations drawn from real workloads. To address this requirement, we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks. Consequently, performance improvements on AscendGYM map directly to the corresponding workloads. In terms of usability, two evaluation modes are supported in AscendGYM: model evaluation and model-harness evaluation. The kernel optimization capabilities of both trained models and custom agents are allowed to be measured. It provides a complete execution environment that closely reproduces how Ascend kernels are invoked in practical pipelines. For model evaluation, it additionally includes a built-in harness equipped with search orchestration and experience accumulation. Finally, we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS), which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost. By jointly considering speedup and cost, STS enables the assessment of practical kernel optimization capability of a model or harness under an acceptable budget. AscendGYM is available at this https URL.

translation.title: AscendGYM：面向 Ascend NPU 真实工作负载的成本感知内核优化基准
translation.abstract: 内核优化对在 Ascend NPU 上高效训练和推理大语言模型（LLM）至关重要。现有 Ascend 内核基准主要关注内核生成，较少关注智能体在来自真实工作负载的输入配置下优化已有实现的能力。为满足这一需求，我们提出 AscendGYM，其初始套件包含三个难度级别的 48 个内核。每个内核配套的测试用例的数据类型和张量形状均采集自真实的训练与推理任务，因此在 AscendGYM 上的性能提升可直接映射到对应工作负载。在可用性方面，AscendGYM 支持两种评估模式：模型评估和模型-测试框架评估，可衡量训练模型与自定义智能体的内核优化能力。它提供完整执行环境，高度复现 Ascend 内核在实际流水线中的调用方式；针对模型评估还内置了具备搜索编排和经验积累功能的 harness。最后，我们提出新指标 Speedup-Token Score（STS），相对于 token 成本量化性能收益。STS 联合考虑加速比与成本，可在可接受预算下评估模型或 harness 的实际内核优化能力。AscendGYM 已在 this https URL 开放。
translation.brief: 针对现有 Ascend 内核基准忽视智能体优化已有内核能力的问题，提出基于真实工作负载输入配置的内核优化基准，并引入联合衡量加速比与 token 成本的 STS 指标。

papers.title: Generated Evaluation Suites as Diversity-Driven Search for Real Agent Regressions
papers.abstract: Generating an evaluation suite from an agent's specification is diversity-driven search: a generator fills a descriptor space (requirements $\times$ personas $\times$ scenario kinds), and the suite it emits is an archive, then scored like a benchmark by its mean pass rate, which throws away the search's product. We inject 7 controlled defects into a $\tau^2$-bench agent across two domains. Coverage yields a ceiling: if a defect's traced footprint holds $b$ scenarios that pass at baseline, it can itself contribute at most $b/N$ to a suite of $N$. For 4 of 5 traceable defects that ceiling lies at or below the detection threshold $\theta = 0.10$, so no within-footprint effect can move the suite past it; in both domains the tool-removal defect destroys every covered scenario it can (exactly its ceiling) while the suite-level pass rate moves the other way. Defects split into two regimes: trace-aligned ones, where per-cell scoring recovers the tool-removal defect in full and reveals a second as a significant improvement, and trace-orthogonal ones, whose footprint is behavioural: forced escalation is detected in retail at a traced coverage of exactly zero. Diversity along the generator's own axes helps only where it aligns: at fixed suite size a happy-path-only suite detects nothing, while a kind-diverse one detects the orchestration defect in 5 of 20 draws. Evaluation archives should be scored per cell and should publish coverage as a first-class property.

translation.title: 将生成的评估套件作为面向真实智能体回归缺陷的多样性驱动搜索
translation.abstract: 从智能体规格生成评估套件是一种多样性驱动的搜索：生成器填充描述符空间（需求 × 人设 × 场景类型），其输出的套件是一个档案，之后像基准一样按平均通过率评分，这丢弃了搜索的产物。我们向 τ²-bench 智能体在两个域中注入 7 个受控缺陷。覆盖度给出一个上限：若某缺陷的追踪足迹包含 b 个基线通过的场景，则它对规模为 N 的套件的贡献最多为 b/N。对 5 个可追踪缺陷中的 4 个，该上限位于或低于检测阈值 θ = 0.10，因此足迹内的任何效应都无法使套件越过该阈值；在两个域中，工具移除缺陷恰好摧毁其覆盖的全部场景（恰好等于其上限），而套件级通过率却反向变动。缺陷分为两种情形：追踪对齐的缺陷，逐格评分可完整恢复工具移除缺陷并将第二个缺陷揭示为显著改进；追踪正交的缺陷，其足迹是行为性的——强制升级在零售场景中于追踪覆盖度恰为零时被检测到。沿生成器自身轴的多样性仅在对齐处有效：在固定套件规模下，仅含正常路径的套件检测不到任何缺陷，而类型多样的套件在 20 次抽取中的 5 次检测到编排缺陷。评估档案应逐格评分，并将覆盖度作为一等属性发布。
translation.brief: 研究从智能体规格自动生成评估套件时平均通过率无法可靠检测真实缺陷的问题，通过注入受控缺陷证明应采用逐格评分并以覆盖度为一等指标。

papers.title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
papers.abstract: Before an LLM agent cancels a reservation or deletes a folder for a user, what stops it from acting on a false assumption: what its tools show, or what the user says? In this work, we study this gap with presupposition theory from linguistics: an agent may act only if each claim behind the act (e.g., one reservation fits the name) is seen to hold, answered by the user, or disclosed while the act can be undone. A simple bound shows that when lookups cannot tell one record from two, any agent acts without asking first as often with two records as with one. We then vary whether a search lists, counts, or omits a second match, and whether the user states a claim that a record refutes (e.g., "It is empty"). Under a role-only prompt, a count of a second record leaves most of 36 earlier agents acting on the one they see, whereas listing both stops most. When the user says a record such as a folder is empty, however, a count of its one item stops agents about as often as a listing, and stating the claim mostly cuts acting when it is false. The newest Claude and GPT models always open a counted second record, then never act. When we add a same-name, same-zip customer to a retail benchmark, a lookup returning that customer first led to wrong-account writes in about a quarter of conversations, and one that checks a street the user knows kept completion near the one-customer level. Safe writes therefore need lookups that list or check competing records, and evaluations that vary what tools show.

translation.title: LLM 智能体所见与用户所言
translation.abstract: 在 LLM 智能体为用户取消预订或删除文件夹之前，是什么阻止它基于错误假设行动：是工具显示的内容，还是用户的陈述？本工作借助语言学的预设理论研究这一差距：只有当行动背后的每项断言（例如一条预订匹配该姓名）被观察到成立、被用户回答，或在行动尚可撤销时被披露，智能体才可行动。一个简单的界表明：当查询无法区分一条记录与两条记录时，任何智能体在不先询问的情况下行动的频率在两条记录时与一条记录时相同。我们随后变化搜索是列出、计数还是省略第二个匹配，以及用户是否陈述被记录反驳的断言（例如"它是空的"）。在仅角色提示下，对第二条记录的计数使 36 个既有智能体中的大多数基于所见的那条行动，而列出两者则阻止了大多数。然而当用户声称某记录（如文件夹）为空时，对其唯一条目的计数阻止智能体的频率与列出相当，且陈述该断言在断言为假时大多能减少行动。最新的 Claude 和 GPT 模型总是先打开被计数的第二条记录，然后从不行动。当我们在零售基准中加入一名同名同邮编的客户时，优先返回该客户的查询导致约四分之一的对话发生错账户写入，而检查用户已知街道的查询使完成率保持在单客户水平。因此，安全写入需要能列出或核查竞争记录的查询，以及能变化工具所见内容的评估。
translation.brief: 研究 LLM 智能体在工具返回信息不完整或与用户陈述冲突时误操作的问题，用预设理论分析并表明需设计能列出或核查竞争记录的查询工具以保障安全写入。

papers.title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
papers.abstract: Autonomous agents now run for hundreds of steps with little or no human supervision. In practice, practitioners use runtime monitors such as turn limits and keyword filters to decide when a run should be stopped, upgraded, or assisted. However, these heuristics may stop runs that would otherwise succeed or allow failing runs to continue. To address this limitation, we introduce LeBet (Learn then Bet), a statistical learning framework that derives its learning objective from sufficient conditions for valid and powerful intervention. In particular, LeBet learns an interpretable OR-of-AND monitor and accumulates evidence through a fixed betting statistic, intervening when the evidence reaches a prescribed threshold. Under finite within-class exchangeability and leave-one-out stability, we derive finite-sample guarantees for false-positive control (validity) and detection power conditional on the training data, using the same trajectories for learning and calibration without assuming independent and identically distributed trajectories. To address the intractable combinatorial optimization problem in our learning formulation, we use stochastic local search that leverages the monitor's Boolean structure to propose rule edits aimed at improving empirical separation. On SWE-bench Lite with Ministral 3 8B, the learned monitor saves $34.46\%$ of input-plus-output tokens and increases output precision from $18.33\%$ to $21.59\%$. The empirical false-positive rate is $13.64\%$. Our results show how to formalize the learning problem over interpretable rule sets with statistical conditions and establish training-conditional guarantees for reliable intervention based on partial histories.

translation.title: 先学习再下注：学习可解释规则以实现可靠的智能体干预
translation.abstract: 自主智能体如今可以在极少或没有人类监督的情况下运行数百步。实践中，从业者使用回合数限制和关键词过滤等运行时监控器来决定何时应停止、升级或辅助一次运行。然而，这些启发式方法可能停止本会成功的运行，或放任失败的运行继续。为解决这一局限，我们提出LeBet（Learn then Bet），一个统计学习框架，其学习目标源自有效且有力干预的充分条件。特别地，LeBet学习一个可解释的OR-of-AND监控器，并通过固定的下注统计量积累证据，当证据达到预设阈值时进行干预。在类内有限可交换性和留一稳定性条件下，我们在不假设轨迹独立同分布的情况下，使用同一批轨迹进行学习和校准，推导出假阳性控制（有效性）和以训练数据为条件的检测功效的有限样本保证。为解决学习形式化中难以处理的组合优化问题，我们使用随机局部搜索，利用监控器的布尔结构提出旨在改善经验分离性的规则编辑。在SWE-bench Lite上配合Ministral 3 8B，学习到的监控器节省了34.46%的输入加输出token，并将输出精度从18.33%提升至21.59%。经验假阳性率为13.64%。我们的结果展示了如何在统计条件下对可解释规则集的形式化学习问题，并为基于部分历史的可靠干预建立训练条件保证。
translation.brief: 解决智能体长时间自主运行时何时干预不可靠的问题，方法是学习可解释的OR-of-AND监控规则并结合固定下注统计量的有限样本统计保证来触发干预。

papers.title: OCTAVE: A Capability-Resolved Benchmark for End-to-End HTML5 Game Generation
papers.abstract: Complete game generation requires agents to coordinate rules, interactions, states, and presentation over a long development process. A single aggregate score obscures which capabilities are implemented and which requirements remain unmet. We present OCTAVE, a benchmark for complete HTML5 game generation organized around eight Capability Dimensions, with 180 tasks and 1,800 Evaluation Requirements drawn from real player requests, commercial-mechanics reconstruction, and human expert design. It covers PC Web, Mobile Web, 2D, and 3D. Requirements distinguish Completeness, assessing publicly specified core implementation, from Richness, assessing hidden, deeper system relationships. Static source-code judgments provide requirement-level diagnosis across capabilities and task conditions. Evaluation of 11 model-harness combinations yields 33.2% Completeness and 32.5% Richness; 19.9% of generation records are static gate failures or missing artifacts. Excluding same-model self-evaluation, even the best combination remains below 50% on both public and hidden requirements. Richness is not harder than Completeness under every task condition. Systems perform relatively better on Core Rules and Numerical Design, while AI/NPC and Feedback and Game Feel show more prominent gaps. Requirement difficulty offers coarse stratification but is only weakly negatively correlated with pass rates. A limited human cross-check finds that requirements judged satisfied by humans but failed by the automated evaluator are the main direction of disagreement. OCTAVE extends evaluation beyond aggregate scores to diagnosis localized by requirement, capability, and task condition.

translation.title: OCTAVE：面向端到端HTML5游戏生成的能力细分基准
translation.abstract: 完整的游戏生成要求智能体在漫长的开发过程中协调规则、交互、状态与呈现。单一的聚合分数掩盖了哪些能力已实现、哪些需求仍未满足。我们提出OCTAVE，一个围绕八个能力维度组织的完整HTML5游戏生成基准，包含180个任务和1800条评估需求，这些需求源自真实玩家请求、商业机制重建和人类专家设计。它覆盖PC Web、Mobile Web、2D和3D。需求区分Completeness（评估公开规定的核心实现）和Richness（评估隐藏的、更深层系统关系）。静态源码判断提供跨能力和任务条件的需求级诊断。对11个模型-框架组合的评估得到33.2%的Completeness和32.5%的Richness；19.9%的生成记录是静态门控失败或产物缺失。排除同模型自评估后，最佳组合在公开和隐藏需求上均低于50%。Richness并非在所有任务条件下都比Completeness更难。系统在核心规则和数值设计上相对表现更好，而AI/NPC以及反馈与游戏手感方面差距更明显。需求难度可提供粗略分层，但与通过率仅呈弱负相关。有限的人工交叉检查发现，人工判定满足但自动评估器判定失败的需求是主要的分歧方向。OCTAVE将评估从聚合分数扩展到按需求、能力和任务条件定位的诊断。
translation.brief: 解决聚合分数无法诊断游戏生成能力短板的问题，方法是构建按八大能力维度和1800条需求细分、以静态源码判断评分的HTML5游戏生成基准。

papers.title: Orbit-AWARE: From Onboard AI Deployment to Sustainable In-Orbit Intelligence
papers.abstract: The growing role of space computing in time-critical satellite services makes the long-term reliability of onboard artificial intelligence (AI) a mission-level requirement. Model drift can undermine this reliability through critical-observation suppression or noncritical priority flooding, displacing both mission information and evidence for model correction. To address this drift-induced evidence displacement, this article presents Orbit-AWARE, a safeguard-first lifecycle management (LCM) architecture. A comparison of existing approaches motivates cooperative Data, Cognitive, and Trust Planes for continuous monitoring, event-triggered agentic orchestration, and deterministic governance. The architecture retains a model-independent sample stream before degradation is confirmed and coordinates evidence selection and exchange for diagnosis and ground-assisted adaptation. Candidate updates are verified before control over data disposition is restored. In an xBD-based emergency Earth observation (EO) case study, Orbit-AWARE delivers 14.3\% more critical observations and achieves 8.3\% higher sustainable mission utility than the Rule-Based Drift Loop under a common 10\% downlink budget. Finally, we discuss future research directions for extending LCM through task-aware reliability assessment, memory- and tool-enabled onboard agents, and evidence-centric space networking. This work makes evidence availability and recovery authorization explicit design objectives for dependable onboard AI services.

translation.title: Orbit-AWARE：从星载AI部署到可持续的在轨智能
translation.abstract: 空间计算在对时间敏感的卫星服务中的作用日益增长，使星载人工智能（AI）的长期可靠性成为任务级需求。模型漂移会通过关键观测被抑制或非关键优先级泛滥而破坏这种可靠性，同时排挤任务信息和用于模型修正的证据。为解决这种漂移导致的证据排挤，本文提出Orbit-AWARE，一种以防护为先的生命周期管理（LCM）架构。对现有方法的比较促使我们构建协作式数据平面、认知平面与信任平面，用于持续监控、事件触发的agentic编排和确定性治理。该架构在漂移被确认之前保留模型无关的样本流，并协调证据的选择与交换以支持诊断和地面辅助自适应。候选更新在恢复对数据处置的控制权之前先经过验证。在一个基于xBD的应急地球观测（EO）案例研究中，在共同的10%下行预算下，Orbit-AWARE比Rule-Based Drift Loop多提供14.3%的关键观测，并实现8.3%更高的可持续任务效用。最后，我们讨论通过任务感知可靠性评估、具备记忆和工具能力的星载智能体以及以证据为中心的空间组网来扩展LCM的未来研究方向。这项工作将证据可用性和恢复授权确立为可靠的星载AI服务的显式设计目标。
translation.brief: 解决星载AI模型漂移导致关键观测和修正证据被排挤的问题，方法是提出防护为先的生命周期管理架构，通过数据、认知与信任三平面协作来保留、选择并交换证据以支持诊断与地面辅助更新。

papers.title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon business workflows fail in two ways: errors accumulate as a chain of activities lengthens, and the knowledge an activity needs is written in a different vocabulary from the user's request. We study whether such workflows can be made reliable without changing the language model. Our method keeps the backbone fixed and moves the workflow definition, state and domain knowledge into versioned control assets outside the model. A state machine and machine-checkable acceptance gates enforce these assets during execution; an independent auditor grades the resulting trace. The assets are updated only after a regression check and human approval .We evaluate the method on three deployed workflows exceeding 200 steps. On Domain A, a 120-case end-to-end evaluation set shows unattended completion rising from 50% to 100%, retrieval recall from 56% to 91.67%, and end-to-end latency dropping from 440 to 159 minutes, with scenario-analysis recall rising from 45% to 93%. Two other domains were taken over by teams that did not write the assets, one in four days and one in seven days. A controlled ablation separates the two failure sources. The code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: Co-Sight Harness：面向长程业务智能体的外置控制资产与确定性执行
translation.abstract: 长程业务工作流以两种方式失败：随着活动链条加长误差不断累积，以及活动所需知识的表述词汇与用户请求不同。我们研究能否在不改变语言模型的情况下使这类工作流可靠。我们的方法保持骨干模型不变，将工作流定义、状态和领域知识移入模型外部的版本化控制资产中。状态机和机器可校验的验收门在执行期间强制执行这些资产；独立的审计器对 resulting trace 进行评分。资产仅在回归检查和人工批准后才更新。我们在三个超过200步的已部署工作流上评估该方法。在领域A上，120个案例的端到端评估集显示无人值守完成率从50%提升到100%，检索召回率从56%提升到91.67%，端到端延迟从440分钟降至159分钟，场景分析召回率从45%提升到93%。另外两个领域由未撰写这些资产的团队接手，分别耗时四天和七天。受控消融实验分离了两种失败来源。代码可在this https URL获取。
translation.brief: 解决长程业务工作流误差累积与知识词汇不匹配导致的不可靠问题，方法是在固定大模型不变的前提下，将工作流定义、状态与领域知识外置为版本化控制资产，并用状态机、验收门与独立审计器确定性执行。

papers.title: DesignSpecs: A DESIGN.md Dataset of Visual Design Specifications for AI Agents
papers.abstract: While AI agents increasingly generate and modify user interfaces, they rarely rely on a visual design specification for a certain project. The this http URL format, which originated from Google's AI design tool Stitch and which was open-sourced in April 2026, addresses this gap by describing a visual identity through design tokens (such as named colors, text styles) and Markdown prose. To our knowledge, no large-scale research dataset of such design specification files exists. We present DesignSpecs, a dataset of 36,906 this http URL files from 15,794 public, non-fork GitHub repositories, representing 17,240 unique file contents. We collected 613,207 files named this http URL in October 2026. Because the same file name also denotes architectural plans and other design documents, we filtered those with YAML front matter, a design-system name, at least one recognized design token, and zero errors under the official linter. Our JSON Lines dataset provides file-level and deduplicated views of the original Markdown, links files to repositories, paths, and commits, and is released with related scripts. We outline research opportunities on visual design knowledge and design-aware AI agents. Dataset is available at: this https URL

translation.title: DesignSpecs：面向AI智能体的DESIGN.md视觉设计规范数据集
translation.abstract: 虽然AI智能体日益能生成和修改用户界面，但它们很少依赖某个项目的视觉设计规范。源自Google的AI设计工具Stitch并于2026年4月开源的this http URL格式，通过设计token（如命名颜色、文本样式）和Markdown文字描述视觉风格，填补了这一空白。据我们所知，目前不存在此类设计规范文件的大规模研究数据集。我们提出DesignSpecs，一个包含来自15794个公开、非fork的GitHub仓库的36906个this http URL文件的数据集，代表17240个唯一文件内容。我们在2026年10月收集了613207个名为this http URL的文件。由于同一文件名也指代建筑规划和其他设计文档，我们筛选出具有YAML front matter、设计系统名称、至少一个可识别设计token且在官方linter下零错误的文件。我们的JSON Lines数据集提供原始Markdown的文件级和去重视图，将文件链接到仓库、路径和提交，并随相关脚本一同发布。我们概述了在视觉设计知识和设计感知AI智能体方面的研究机会。数据集可在以下地址获取：this https URL
translation.brief: 解决缺乏大规模视觉设计规范数据集的问题，方法是从GitHub收集并经YAML元数据、设计token和linter规则筛选出约3.7万个DESIGN.md文件构建数据集。

papers.title: Ego2Flow: Benchmarking the Traffic-System Impact of Autonomous Driving on Maps Distilled from Real-World Roads
papers.abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving is predominantly evaluated through ego-vehicle safety and task completion. Its deployment in urban traffic, however, creates sustained interactions among vehicles whose collective effects remain insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Ego2Flow, a closed-loop benchmark for assessing the traffic-system impact of autonomous driving on maps distilled from real-world cities. To construct realistic 3D urban environments for sustained closed-loop traffic simulation, we develop an agent-guided map distillation framework that integrates real-world maps and observations with complementary geographic information. Through an iterative feedback mechanism and a traffic information graph that jointly guide scene generation, the framework preserves lane topology, critical road geometry and decision-relevant visual conditions while simplifying nonessential details and completing unobserved regions.
