Using our proposed framework, we generate and publicly release six CARLA maps from the Argoverse 2 dataset, covering the corresponding real-world regions and enabling paired comparisons of driving behavior under real and simulated observations. On these maps, Ego2Flow evaluates how autonomous driving policies affect traffic efficiency, safety, stability and energy consumption across diverse road structures. Compared with existing construction methods, our framework achieves the lowest average displacement error between planning outputs from paired real and simulated observations. We further benchmark representative driving policies to characterize their system-level impact on urban traffic. Project Page: this https URL.

translation.title: Ego2Flow：基于真实道路蒸馏地图的自动驾驶交通系统影响基准测试
translation.abstract: 端到端自动驾驶的评估主要围绕自车安全与任务完成，但其在城市交通中的部署会引发车辆间持续交互，其集体影响尚缺乏充分评估。我们提出 Ego2Flow，一个在从真实城市蒸馏的地图上评估自动驾驶交通系统影响的闭环基准。为构建可用于持续闭环交通仿真的真实感 3D 城市环境，我们开发了 agent 引导的地图蒸馏框架，将真实地图与观测同互补的地理信息相结合。通过迭代反馈机制和交通信息图共同指导场景生成，该框架在保留车道拓扑、关键道路几何和决策相关视觉条件的同时，简化非必要细节并补全未观测区域。利用该框架，我们生成并公开发布了来自 Argoverse 2 数据集的六张 CARLA 地图，覆盖对应真实世界区域，支持在真实与仿真观测配对下的驾驶行为比较。在这些地图上，Ego2Flow 评估自动驾驶策略如何在不同道路结构下影响交通效率、安全性、稳定性和能耗。与现有构建方法相比，我们的框架在配对的真实与仿真观测下规划输出的平均位移误差最低。我们进一步对代表性驾驶策略进行基准测试，刻画其对城市交通的系统级影响。项目主页：this https URL。
translation.brief: 提出地图蒸馏框架生成真实感 CARLA 地图，并构建 Ego2Flow 闭环基准来评估自动驾驶策略对交通系统的整体影响。

papers.title: Logically Consistent Accurate Forecasts
papers.abstract: Agentic forecasting systems based on large language models (LLMs) are now competitive with expert human forecasters, but these systems still suffer from a critical limitation: the inability to produce forecasts that are logically consistent. For example, forecasts for related events often fail to satisfy the axioms of probability, which in turn implies that related forecasts cannot simultaneously be correct and undermines their utility for decision makers. Enforcing consistency is not trivial -- naive approaches (e.g., projection onto the set of consistent forecasts) can degrade accuracy. We argue that the key to overcoming the apparent tradeoff between consistency and accuracy lies in the reasoning which supports each forecast. We finetune a supervisory language model that leverages this reasoning to jointly reconcile inconsistencies while improving the accuracy of related forecasts. On ForecastBench, our method improves the Brier score of a retrieval-augmented GPT-5.1 forecaster by 9.3% while reducing measures of structural inconsistency by 82-90%. We interrogate our method via a comprehensive series of baselines and ablations, and find that no alternative method matches our gains in consistency and accuracy simultaneously.

translation.title: 逻辑一致且准确的预测
translation.abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体预测系统现已可与人类专家预测者竞争，但这些系统仍存在一个关键局限：无法产生逻辑一致的预测。例如，相关事件的预测常常不满足概率公理，这意味着相关预测无法同时正确，削弱了其对决策者的价值。强制一致性并非易事——朴素方法（如投影到一致预测集合上）可能损害准确性。我们提出，克服一致性与准确性之间表面权衡的关键在于支持每条预测的推理过程。我们微调一个监督语言模型，利用这些推理来协调不一致之处，同时提升相关预测的准确性。在 ForecastBench 上，我们的方法将检索增强的 GPT-5.1 预测器的 Brier score 提升了 9.3%，同时将结构性不一致度量降低了 82-90%。我们通过一系列全面的基线和消融实验检验该方法，发现没有其他方法能同时取得我们在一致性和准确性上的提升。
translation.brief: 通过微调监督模型利用预测推理过程来联合修正逻辑不一致并提升预测准确性。

papers.title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
papers.abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) on local devices keeps data private, removes per-token cost, cuts network latency, and keeps working without a connection. Two shifts now strain how such models are served. On one device, several agents share a locally served model with an interactive user. Across devices, a developer or small team often owns several capable machines from different vendors, which sit idle most of the day because every local server serves one runtime on one machine. We present Superfluid, an open-source LLM server built for local inference at both scales. On one device, Superfluid drives this http URL, MLX, or BaseRT in isolated worker processes through one scheduler that moves interactive requests ahead of agent work, computes a prompt shared by many requests once, and writes every token to a durable log before it reaches the client. Across devices, one Superfluid server turns a fleet of machines into a single API endpoint. Machines with different hardware serve copies of the same model, receive work according to their measured speed, and can join or fail under load without losing a request. For Qwen3.8-27B on an Apple M5 Pro, a chat sent while eight agents are working receives its first token in 1.5 s, against 291-612 s on llama-server, Ollama, and this http URL. On six machines from three chip vendors serving 64 simulated users for one hour, Superfluid answers all 5,041 requests while machines join one at a time and one is killed and rejoins; throughput grows from 112 to 534 tok/s and the median first-token time falls from 99 to 12 s. On twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras it sustains 10,656 tok/s across 38,563 requests from 384 agents without a failure. Superfluid is available under the Apache-2.0 licence at this https URL.

translation.title: Superfluid：面向分布式 LLM 推理的本地 AI 服务器
translation.abstract: 在本地设备上运行大语言模型（LLM）可以保护数据隐私、消除按 token 计费成本、降低网络延迟，并在离线时保持可用。当前有两种变化对这类模型的 serve 方式构成挑战。在单台设备上，多个 agent 与交互式用户共享一个本地模型；在多台设备之间，开发者或小团队往往拥有来自不同厂商的多台高性能机器，而由于每个本地服务器只服务一台机器上的一个运行时，这些机器大部分时间处于闲置。我们提出 Superfluid，一个为两种规模的本地推理而构建的开源 LLM 服务器。在单台设备上，Superfluid 通过单一调度器在隔离的 worker 进程中驱动 this http URL、MLX 或 BaseRT，将交互式请求排在 agent 工作之前，对多个请求共享的 prompt 只计算一次，并在每个 token 到达客户端前将其写入持久日志。在多台设备上，一台 Superfluid 服务器将一组机器变成单一 API 端点：不同硬件的机器服务同一模型的副本，按实测速度接收任务，并可在负载下加入或故障而不丢失请求。对于 Apple M5 Pro 上的 Qwen3.8-27B，当八个 agent 工作时发送的聊天请求在 1.5 秒内收到首个 token，而 llama-server、Ollama 和 this http URL 需要 291-612 秒。在来自三家芯片厂商的六台机器上服务 64 个模拟用户一小时，Superfluid 在机器逐台加入、一台被杀掉并重新加入的情况下回答了全部 5,041 个请求；吞吐量从 112 提升到 534 tok/s，首 token 中位时间从 99 秒降至 12 秒。在十二台 Mac Studio M3 Ultra 上，它在 384 个 agent 的 38,563 个请求中持续达到 10,656 tok/s 且无一次失败。Superfluid 以 Apache-2.0 许可发布于 this https URL。
translation.brief: 构建开源本地 LLM 服务器 Superfluid，通过单机智能调度与多机集群统一端点实现高效分布式推理。

papers.title: Creative Product Design under Brand Image Constraints
papers.abstract: Industrial design requires creative visual exploration while satisfying constraints that are often product-specific and implicit. Existing text-to-image (T2I) approaches can generate creative designs through concept blending or multi-agent self-enhancement, but they provide limited mechanisms for ensuring that generated designs remain consistent with such constraints. We focus on brand image as a representative design constraint and propose a framework for brand-aware redesign generation. Given a product name, the framework constructs a brand image survey report that summarizes product and market information, derives a creative direction from the report, and integrates this direction into a self-enhancement loop in which generated images are critiqued and prompts are revised. We evaluate the framework on 50 redesign tasks across five product categories, comparing it with Naive T2I, IP-Adapter/IT-Blender, and unconstrained self-enhancement under the same T2I backbone. By a VLM-as-Judge protocol to measure creativity and brand identifiability, the proposed framework achieves a more favorable trade-off between the two objectives, with particularly clear gains in highly constrained categories such as automotive and motorcycle, where the plausible design space is relatively limited compared with that of other product categories. These results suggest that dynamically eliciting and textualizing brand image can guide creative product design generation under brand image constraints.

translation.title: 品牌形象约束下的创意产品设计
translation.abstract: 工业设计需要创造性视觉探索，同时满足往往针对特定产品且隐含的约束。现有文生图（T2I）方法可以通过概念融合或多智能体自我增强生成创意设计，但缺乏确保生成设计符合此类约束的机制。我们聚焦于品牌形象这一代表性设计约束，提出品牌感知的再设计生成框架。给定产品名称，该框架构建一份总结产品与市场信息的品牌形象调研报告，从报告中推导创意方向，并将该方向融入一个自我增强循环，其中对生成图像进行评析并修订 prompt。我们在五个产品类别的 50 个再设计任务上评估该框架，在相同 T2I 主干下与 Naive T2I、IP-Adapter/IT-Blender 以及无约束自我增强进行比较。通过以 VLM 作为评判者（VLM-as-Judge）的协议衡量创造力与品牌可识别性，所提框架在两个目标之间取得了更优的权衡，在汽车、摩托车等高度约束类别（其合理设计空间相对有限）中收益尤为明显。这些结果表明，动态提取并将品牌形象文本化可以引导品牌形象约束下的创意产品设计生成。
translation.brief: 提出品牌感知的再设计生成框架，通过调研报告推导创意方向并纳入自我增强循环，使 T2I 生成符合品牌形象约束。

papers.title: GDP.xlsx: Benchmarking Frontier Models on Professional Workbooks
papers.abstract: We introduce GDP_xlsx, a benchmark of 70 realistic workplace requests written by professionals in 13 domains, each paired with an expert rubric of binary criteria and with the complete workbook or CSV file it refers to. Together the files hold 2.18 million populated cells, and the rubrics 791 criteria. Agents work in a container with spreadsheet tools, and an agentic judge that can open the file applies the rubric. Completeness and exclusivity criteria require set-valued answers to be found in full and with nothing extra. We rank models by strict pass@1, the share of attempts that meet every criterion. Across 20 model configurations, including frontier models from Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, the top-scoring one, Gemini 4 Argon, passes only 38.3% of attempts, and the median score is 19.3%, leaving wide headroom. We release the evaluation harness and three public tasks; the other 67 are held out to protect the leaderboard from contamination.

translation.title: GDP.xlsx：在专业工作簿上对前沿模型进行基准测试
translation.abstract: 我们提出 GDP_xlsx，一个包含 70 条由 13 个领域的专业人士撰写的真实职场请求的基准，每条请求配有专家制定的二值评分细则（rubric）及其对应的完整工作簿或 CSV 文件。这些文件共含 218 万个已填充单元格，评分细则共含 791 条标准。智能体在带有电子表格工具的容器中工作，由一个可打开文件的智能体评判者执行评分细则。其中完整性与排他性标准要求集合型答案被完整找出且不多不少。我们以严格 pass@1（满足所有标准的尝试比例）对模型排序。在 20 个模型配置（包括来自 Google、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的前沿模型）中，得分最高的 Gemini 4 Argon 仅通过 38.3% 的尝试，中位数为 19.3%，留有巨大提升空间。我们发布评测框架和三个公开任务；其余 67 个任务被留出以保护排行榜免受污染。
translation.brief: 构建含 70 条真实职场电子表格任务的 GDP_xlsx 基准，用容器化智能体与智能体评判者以严格 pass@1 评估前沿模型。

papers.title: Bridge: Database-Grounded Interactive Disambiguation for Text-to-SQL
papers.abstract: Ambiguity remains a persistent challenge in text-to-SQL, where an underspecified natural-language question may admit multiple plausible SQL interpretations. Recent work attempts to recover the user's intended interpretation through iterative clarification, but typically relies heavily on LLM parametric knowledge for ad hoc reasoning, leading to limited ambiguity-resolution effectiveness and high LLM cost. We further observe that many ambiguity errors stem from ambiguous column grounding, which remains poorly handled. Therefore, we propose Bridge, a database-grounded disambiguation framework built on an existing iterative protocol. Bridge supplies the LLM's ambiguity detection with offline-distilled knowledge about potential ambiguity relations among columns in the target database. Offline, Bridge constructs a Column Ambiguity Graph by first identifying potentially ambiguous column pairs using complementary database-grounded signals, followed by LLM-based verification. Online, columns and values mentioned in a previous incorrect SQL prediction are used as anchors to retrieve alternatives from the Column Ambiguity Graph and an offline-constructed value similarity index, respectively. The results are integrated for further pruning and consolidated for subsequent ambiguity detection. Extensive experiments on BIRD-dev without the benchmark-provided evidence show that, at comparable LLM cost, Bridge outperforms the strongest baseline by 11.60% in execution accuracy and improves the recall and precision of column usage in the final SQL by 5.25% and 12.37%, respectively.

translation.title: Bridge：基于数据库的交互式消歧方法用于Text-to-SQL
translation.abstract: 歧义问题一直是text-to-SQL的挑战，一个欠明确的自然语言问题可能对应多种合理的SQL解释。近期工作尝试通过迭代式澄清来恢复用户的真实意图，但通常严重依赖LLM的参数化知识进行临场推理，导致歧义消解效果有限且LLM成本高昂。我们进一步观察到，许多歧义错误源于模糊的列定位，而这一问题尚未得到妥善处理。为此，我们提出Bridge，一个建立在现有迭代协议之上的基于数据库的消歧框架。Bridge为LLM的歧义检测提供离线蒸馏的知识，即目标数据库中列之间潜在歧义关系的信息。离线阶段，Bridge首先利用互补的数据库信号识别潜在歧义列对，再通过LLM验证，构建列歧义图。在线阶段，将之前错误SQL预测中提到的列和值作为锚点，分别从列歧义图和离线构建的值相似性索引中检索备选项，将结果整合用于进一步剪枝，并汇总用于后续的歧义检测。在BIRD-dev上（不使用基准提供的证据）的大量实验表明，在相近LLM成本下，Bridge的执行准确率比最强基线高出11.60%，并使最终SQL中列使用的召回率和精确率分别提升5.25%和12.37%。
translation.brief: 该论文解决text-to-SQL中模糊问题导致的SQL歧义问题，核心方法是离线构建列歧义图并结合在线检索，为迭代式澄清提供数据库层面的消歧知识。

papers.title: Antidistillation is Cheap: Lightweight Distillation-Resistance via Stylistic Corruption
papers.abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) is a highly effective paradigm for transferring capabilities from large language models (LLMs) to smaller, more specialized student models. In commercial deployment where frontier models are restricted behind black-box APIs, sequence-level distillation remains a potent vector for competitors to clone proprietary capabilities at a fraction of the development cost. Existing defenses mostly rely on surrogate models to manipulate next-token sampling, which increases computational overhead and real-time inference latency. In this work, we propose a lightweight defense that dynamically injects style-steering vectors into the teacher model's activations upon malicious queries. This framework offers exceptional flexibility, allowing hosts to customize target defensive styles and dynamically blend them to maximize stylistic variance. Crucially, this inference-time intervention preserves semantic utility and fluency during malicious queries, misleading adversaries into believing that they are extracting pristine teacher outputs, while standard consumers continue to receive original, unmodified responses. Our experiments demonstrate that this framework successfully disrupts student learning, achieving substantial anti-distillation performance while incurring negligible overhead and preserving text naturalness. Our code is available at this https URL.

translation.title: 抗蒸馏代价低廉：基于风格扰动的轻量级蒸馏防御
translation.abstract: 知识蒸馏是一种将大语言模型能力迁移到更小、更专业学生模型的高效范式。在商业部署中，前沿模型被限制在黑盒API之后，序列级蒸馏仍是竞争对手以极低开发成本克隆专有能力的有力手段。现有防御大多依赖代理模型来操纵next-token采样，这会增加计算开销和实时推理延迟。本文提出一种轻量级防御方法，在检测到恶意查询时，动态向教师模型的激活中注入风格引导向量。该框架具有出色的灵活性，允许部署方自定义目标防御风格并动态混合，以最大化风格方差。关键在于，这一推理时干预在恶意查询期间保持语义效用和流畅性，使攻击者误以为提取到的是原汁原味的教师输出，而普通用户仍收到原始且未修改的响应。实验表明，该框架成功干扰了学生学习，实现了显著的抗蒸馏性能，同时开销可忽略不计并保持文本自然度。代码见此 https 链接。
translation.brief: 该论文解决通过黑盒API进行的模型蒸馏窃取问题，核心方法是检测到恶意查询时动态向模型激活注入风格引导向量，以污染蒸馏数据且不损害正常服务。

papers.title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
papers.abstract: The Thomson problem asks for N unit charges on a sphere with minimum Coulomb energy; for large N the best configurations known are curated in the Cambridge Cluster Database, whose largest-N entries were set in October 2026. We report configurations for N = 912, 1382 and 2502 with energies 0.0036186, 0.0109730 and 0.0614033 below the database values, certified by exact integer arithmetic. All three are numerically strict local minima modulo rotations and keep the defect inventory and scar compositions of the database configurations; the database value for N = 912 had been reached by two different methods. Our search runs unconstrained replica-exchange basin hopping from the database configurations, with a shared pool of minima, recombination of improved regions after relabelling by geometry, and gradient-only polishing; replica-exchange basin hopping alone found the N = 912 and 1382 configurations, the former in one of five runs. We built and ran it with large language model agents (Claude, through a chat interface and the Claude Code agent), and we report every search, including those that failed. Two findings matter for others who search the database. Polishing alone lowers two entries by more than the threshold at which our pipeline reports a candidate, which produced two spurious records until candidates were compared with the polished database energies (the polished baseline). A local-relaxation speed-up passed its exactness test yet found nothing in a controlled comparison in which every arm with full relaxation went below the database value within 15 minutes. We distil three practices for computational discovery with large language model agents: calibrate the search code and verify candidates with code separate from the search, compare candidates with the polished baseline, and test design changes in controlled comparisons with pass criteria fixed in advance.

translation.title: 利用大语言模型智能体构建的搜索流水线，对已知Thomson问题最优构型进行可认证的改进
translation.abstract: Thomson问题要求在球面上放置N个单位电荷使Coulomb能量最小；对于较大的N，已知最优构型收录在Cambridge Cluster Database中，其最大N的条目更新于2026年10月。我们报告了N = 912、1382和2502的构型，能量分别比数据库值低0.0036186、0.0109730和0.0614033，并经精确整数算术认证。三者均为模旋转意义下的数值严格局部极小，且保持了数据库构型的缺陷清单和scar组成；其中N = 912的数据库值此前已由两种不同方法达到。我们的搜索从数据库构型出发，运行无约束的replica-exchange basin hopping，配合共享极小值池、按几何重标记后对改进区域的重组，以及仅梯度的抛光；仅replica-exchange basin hopping就找到了N = 912和1382的构型，前者来自五次运行之一。我们使用大语言模型智能体构建并运行该流水线（通过聊天界面和Claude Code智能体使用Claude），并报告了每一次搜索，包括失败的搜索。对检索该数据库的其他研究者而言，有两个发现值得注意：仅抛光就能把两个条目降低超过流水线报告候选解的阈值，这曾产生两条虚假记录，直到将候选解与抛光后的数据库能量（抛光基线）比较后才被发现；一个局部松弛加速方法通过了精确性测试，却在对照比较中一无所获，而每个使用完整松弛的对照分支都在15分钟内降到数据库值之下。我们总结出使用大语言模型智能体进行计算发现的三条实践准则：用与搜索分开的代码校准搜索程序并验证候选解，将候选解与抛光基线比较，以及在预先固定通过标准的对照比较中测试设计改动。
translation.brief: 该论文解决大N值Thomson问题最优电荷构型未知的问题，核心方法是用LLM智能体搭建replica-exchange basin hopping与区域重组的搜索流水线，并以精确整数算术认证能量改进。

papers.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
papers.abstract: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, maintains its accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit quantized weights, and transfers zero-shot to Snowflake, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB within 3.1 points of its native SQLite accuracy. Combined with Claude Opus 5.5 in a pre-registered confidence cascade over 227 questions on databases published after Opus's training cutoff, LuthorSQL answers nearly half of all questions locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy. Finally, contamination probing shows that Opus reproduces 48-92% of public benchmark gold queries verbatim without seeing the schema; however, its tool-assisted accuracy holds on renamed schemas and reaches 95.6-97.4% on post-cutoff databases. Code and data: this https URL

translation.title: LuthorSQL：作为较慢LLM智能体System 1的单遍Text-to-SQL模型
translation.abstract: 使用工具查询数据库的前沿LLM智能体是准确率最高的text-to-SQL系统之一，但对托管模型的逐查询调用缓慢、昂贵，并将敏感的组织查询暴露给外部API。例如，一个Claude Opus 5.5智能体每天服务10,000个查询，按标价每年成本超过70,000美元。在不损害智能体准确性的前提下，组织已拥有的本地硬件能在多大程度上卸载这一负担？我们提出LuthorSQL，一个非自回归的7B text-to-SQL模型，充当较慢LLM智能体（System 2）的快速System 1门控，仅在不确定时才升级查询。LuthorSQL通过单次前向传播在受限文法上预测查询计划的槽位分数，编译并运行最多32个候选计划，并使用训练好的验证器选择答案。单独使用时，LuthorSQL在BIRD隐藏测试集上达到68.03%的执行准确率，单GPU上每题0.84秒，以8比特量化权重在9 GB内存中保持准确率，并以零样本方式迁移到Snowflake、BigQuery、MySQL、PostgreSQL和DuckDB，准确率与其原生SQLite差距不超过3.1个百分点。在Opus训练截止后发布的数据库上对227个问题进行预注册的置信度级联实验中，LuthorSQL与Claude Opus 5.5结合，本地回答了近一半问题，并在相同准确率下削减33.3%的API成本。最后，污染探测显示，Opus在未见模式的情况下能逐字复现48-92%的公开基准gold查询；不过其工具辅助的准确率在重命名的模式上保持不变，在截止后数据库上达到95.6-97.4%。代码与数据：此 https 链接。
translation.brief: 该论文解决依赖外部LLM API进行text-to-SQL成本高且隐私风险大的问题，核心方法是训练一个非自回归7B模型作为快速System 1，仅在不确定时升级到较慢的LLM智能体。

papers.title: CHARMING: Parallel Edge AI Acceleration Across Tensor Processing and In-Memory Computation
papers.abstract: Edge AI increasingly relies on specialized accelerators for low-latency inference under tight resource and energy constraints, yet their efficiency remains limited by data movement. Prior work, CHARM, mitigates this overhead by overlapping data movement with computation. We observe that in-memory computing can further supplement tensor processing as a parallel accelerator while eliminating certain data movements entirely. We present CHARMING, a heterogeneous edge AI architecture that uses accuracy- and quantization-aware partitioning to distribute and concurrently execute inference workloads across tensor processing and in-memory computation. CHARMING partitions attention heads between an AIE array and an in-DRAM compute unit, balancing execution according to model architecture, sequence length, and precision while selecting heads to minimize accuracy degradation. CHARMING also integrates quantization into the AIE projection stage to further reduce data movement. We validate CHARMING end-to-end in hardware on AMD Versal VCK5000 and Alveo U200 platforms and evaluate LLM and video-generation models across multiple precisions using measured hardware results and simulation of the latest in-memory compute hardware. CHARMING improves prefill performance by up to 23.6 percent and decode performance by up to 44 percent over AIE-only acceleration. With int4 x int4 fixed-point in-memory computation, CHARMING reduces per-layer energy by up to 7.6 percent and improves energy-delay product by up to 24.7 percent, while maintaining accuracy similar to a 32-bit floating-point baseline.

translation.title: CHARMING：跨张量处理与存内计算的并行边缘AI加速
translation.abstract: 边缘AI日益依赖专用加速器在严格的资源和能耗约束下实现低延迟推理，但其效率仍受数据搬运的限制。先前的工作CHARM通过将数据搬运与计算重叠来缓解这一开销。我们观察到，存内计算可以进一步作为张量处理的并行加速器，同时彻底消除某些数据搬运。我们提出CHARMING，一种异构边缘AI架构，利用精度与量化感知的划分，将推理工作负载分布到张量处理和存内计算上并发执行。CHARMING将注意力头划分到AIE阵列与in-DRAM计算单元之间，根据模型架构、序列长度和精度平衡执行，同时选择注意力头以最小化精度损失。CHARMING还将量化集成到AIE投影阶段，以进一步减少数据搬运。我们在AMD Versal VCK5000和Alveo U200平台上进行端到端硬件验证，并使用实测硬件结果和对最新存内计算硬件的仿真，在多种精度下评估LLM和视频生成模型。与仅AIE加速相比，CHARMING将prefill性能提升至多23.6%，decode性能提升至多44%。采用int4 x int4定点存内计算时，CHARMING将每层能耗降低至多7.6%，能量-延迟积改善至多24.7%，同时保持与32位浮点基线相近的精度。
translation.brief: 该论文解决边缘AI推理中数据搬运开销限制效率的问题，核心方法是通过精度与量化感知的注意力头划分，让张量处理与存内计算异构并行执行。

papers.title: RAG-FGO: Dynamic Optimization of Query-Rewriting Agents for Generative RAG
papers.abstract: In retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), query rewriting serves as a core interface that aligns user intent with external knowledge bases, and its effectiveness directly determines overall system performance. However, generative retrieval faces three critical challenges in real-world deployment: noisy retrieval feedback, the difficulty of jointly optimizing discrete prompt templates and continuous decoding-control parameters, and the limited generalization of static rewriting strategies under semantically complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose RAG-FGO, a dynamic optimization framework for generative retrieval strategies. RAG-FGO formulates query rewriting as a non-differentiable black-box optimization problem in a mixed discrete-continuous space, and represents prompt templates and decoding parameters as adaptively optimizable query-rewriting agents. The framework performs global search to enable semantic jumps and structural reorganization that escape local optima, while applying local perturbations for fine-grained alignment and precise refinement. In addition, RAG-FGO introduces an elite-preserving memory pool that accumulates high-quality strategies across iterations, thereby mitigating the impact of stochasticity and noisy feedback on optimization stability. Experimental results on a diverse suite of benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, supporting its applicability to complex semantic retrieval tasks.

translation.title: RAG-FGO：面向生成式 RAG 的查询改写智能体动态优化
translation.abstract: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中，查询改写是对齐用户意图与外部知识库的核心接口，其有效性直接决定整体系统性能。然而，生成式检索在真实部署中面临三个关键挑战：检索反馈噪声、离散提示模板与连续解码控制参数难以联合优化、静态改写策略在语义复杂场景下泛化能力有限。为解决这些问题，我们提出 RAG-FGO，一个面向生成式检索策略的动态优化框架。RAG-FGO 将查询改写建模为混合离散-连续空间中的不可微黑盒优化问题，并将提示模板和解码参数表示为可自适应优化的查询改写智能体。该框架通过全局搜索实现语义跳转与结构重组以逃离局部最优，同时施加局部扰动实现细粒度对齐与精确微调。此外，RAG-FGO 引入精英保留记忆池，跨迭代积累高质量策略，从而缓解随机性与噪声反馈对优化稳定性的影响。在多样化基准上的实验结果表明了所提方法的有效性与鲁棒性，支持其在复杂语义检索任务中的适用性。
translation.brief: 针对生成式 RAG 中查询改写的噪声反馈与静态策略泛化差问题，将其建模为混合离散-连续黑盒优化，用全局搜索加局部扰动和精英记忆池动态优化改写智能体。

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Optimize Pretrained Neural Network Weights? A Multi-Phase Empirical Evaluation of Gradient-Free Editing in YOLO26 Object Detection
papers.abstract: Direct weight editing offers a gradient-free alternative to fine-tuning pretrained detectors, but its generalization and the value of large language model (LLM) guidance remain uncertain. We evaluate five experimental phases using YOLO26 models and MS COCO, comparing deterministic scaling, random perturbations, differential evolution, CMA-ES, structured interventions, real local-LLM proposals, failure-aware guidance, and hybrid LLM-CMA-ES against a matched random-policy control. Optimization uses native Ultralytics mAP50-95 on 1,000 COCO Val2017 images; selected candidates are assessed on a disjoint, previously examined 1,500-image subset, with COCO API AP50-95 reported separately where available. Increasing the CMA-ES budget from 8 to 250 evaluations raised development gains from +0.11 to +0.28 percentage points, while selection changes remained negative (-0.03 to -0.12 points); the 250-evaluation result uses one seed. The hybrid LLM approach showed no statistically established advantage over random-policy guidance (p = 0.612, 0.369, and 0.694 at budgets 8, 25, and 50). Five-seed YOLO26m replication yielded a COCO API AP difference of +0.004 points (95% CI: -0.026 to +0.034). Of 225 archived LLM proposals, 53 satisfy the final strict schema; early tensor-level execution cannot be fully verified. Genuine LLM-mediated weight editing is feasible, but the tested approaches did not demonstrate consistent transfer beyond the development subset or a measurable LLM advantage.

translation.title: 大语言模型能优化预训练神经网络权重吗？YOLO26 目标检测中无梯度编辑的多阶段实证评估
translation.abstract: 直接权重编辑为微调预训练检测器提供了无梯度替代方案，但其泛化能力以及大语言模型（LLM）指导的价值仍不确定。我们使用 YOLO26 模型和 MS COCO 评估五个实验阶段，将确定性缩放、随机扰动、差分进化、CMA-ES、结构化干预、真实本地 LLM 提案、失败感知引导以及混合 LLM-CMA-ES 与匹配的随机策略对照进行比较。优化使用 1,000 张 COCO Val2017 图像上的原生 Ultralytics mAP50-95；选出的候选在互不重叠的、先前检视过的 1,500 张图像子集上评估，并在可用时单独报告 COCO API AP50-95。将 CMA-ES 预算从 8 次评估增加到 250 次，使开发集增益从 +0.11 提升至 +0.28 个百分点，但选择集变化仍为负（-0.03 至 -0.12 点）；250 次评估的结果仅使用单个种子。混合 LLM 方法相对随机策略引导未显示出统计上确立的优势（预算 8、25、50 时 p = 0.612、0.369、0.694）。五种子 YOLO26m 复现得到 COCO API AP 差异 +0.004 点（95% CI：-0.026 至 +0.034）。在 225 个存档的 LLM 提案中，53 个满足最终严格模式；早期张量级执行无法完全验证。真正的 LLM 介导权重编辑是可行的，但所测试的方法未表现出超越开发子集的一致迁移，也未显示出可测量的 LLM 优势。
translation.brief: 通过多阶段实验检验 LLM 是否能无梯度编辑预训练 YOLO26 权重，比较多种优化策略与随机对照来评估其是否优于随机策略。

papers.title: AutoRL: A Multi-Agent System towards Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is one of the most promising paths toward an AI singularity for superintelligence. Achieving this vision requires AI systems to undertake the full training pipeline for iterative improvement. Reinforcement learning (RL) plays an essential role in this cycle to improve model capabilities and generalization, yet automating RL remains difficult due to unstable training dynamics and the need for sustained supervision. We introduce AutoRL, a multi-agent system for automating RL training, as a cornerstone for future RSI. Different from conducting research by end-to-end complete experiments, AutoRL monitors the evolving training state and integrates process-level supervision and research into an ongoing RL training, following the practical workflow of an RL researcher. Specifically, AutoRL consists of three RL-specific agentic roles. Perceptors track training dynamics, rollouts, evaluation, and efficiency, triggering deliberation when they detect anomalies, degradation, or stagnation. Three complementary Proposers diagnose problems and refine candidate interventions through shared evidence and checks. The Orchestrator reviews their recommendation and applies approved changes through online hot updates or checkpoint-based resumption. Experiments on Qwen3 and LongCat-Flash-Lite demonstrate the superiority of AutoRL over static RL recipes and a general agent. The research records show that existing agents can handle unattended RL supervision and dynamic adjustment. The difficulty for future RSI lies in developing fundamental methods that are valuable for resource-consuming validation.

translation.title: AutoRL：迈向自主强化学习的多智能体系统
translation.abstract: 递归自我改进（RSI）是通往超级智能 AI 奇点最有前景的路径之一。实现这一愿景需要 AI 系统承担完整的训练流程以进行迭代改进。强化学习（RL）在这一循环中对提升模型能力与泛化至关重要，但由于训练动态不稳定以及需要持续监督，自动化 RL 仍然困难。我们提出 AutoRL，一个用于自动化 RL 训练的多智能体系统，作为未来 RSI 的基石。不同于通过端到端完整实验开展研究，AutoRL 监控不断演变的训练状态，将过程级监督与研究融入正在进行的 RL 训练，遵循 RL 研究者的实际工作流程。具体而言，AutoRL 由三个 RL 特有的智能体角色组成。Perceptor 跟踪训练动态、rollout、评估与效率，在检测到异常、退化或停滞时触发深思熟虑的决策。三个互补的 Proposer 通过共享证据与检查诊断问题并细化候选干预。Orchestrator 审查其建议，并通过在线热更新或基于检查点的恢复应用获批的更改。在 Qwen3 和 LongCat-Flash-Lite 上的实验表明 AutoRL 优于静态 RL 配方和通用智能体。研究记录显示现有智能体能够处理无人值守的 RL 监督与动态调整。未来 RSI 的难点在于开发对资源消耗型验证有价值的基础方法。
translation.brief: 针对 RL 训练自动化中不稳定动态与持续监督难题，构建由感知、提案、编排三类智能体组成的多智能体系统，对训练过程进行实时监控与干预。

papers.title: MASTARS: Multi-Agent Sequential Trajectory Augmentation with Return-Conditioned Subgoals
papers.abstract: The performance of offline Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) is limited by the quality of the fixed offline dataset, motivating trajectory augmentation. However, augmenting multi-agent trajectories presents a fundamental challenge of the diversity-coordination trade-off: independent generation improves diversity but lacks coordination, while joint generation induces coordination but lacks diversity, reproducing the training distribution. To address this challenge in multi-agent data augmentation, we introduce MASTARS, a novel diffusion-based framework that generates multi-agent trajectories sequentially across agents while enforcing cross-agent consistent coordination via the method of inpainting. MASTARS produces trajectories that are diverse, coordinated and globally coherent. Experiments on various benchmarks such as MPE, SMAC, and SMAC-v2 demonstrate significant performance gains across multiple offline MARL methods.

translation.title: MASTARS：基于回报条件子目标的多智能体序列轨迹增强
translation.abstract: 离线多智能体强化学习（MARL）的性能受限于固定离线数据集的质量，这促使人们进行轨迹增强。然而，增强多智能体轨迹面临多样性-协调性权衡的根本挑战：独立生成提升多样性但缺乏协调，联合生成带来协调但缺乏多样性，只是复现训练分布。为解决多智能体数据增强中的这一挑战，我们提出 MASTARS，一个新颖的基于扩散的框架，它跨智能体顺序生成多智能体轨迹，同时通过 inpainting 方法实现跨智能体一致的协调。MASTARS 生成多样、协调且全局一致的轨迹。在 MPE、SMAC 和 SMAC-v2 等多种基准上的实验显示，多种离线 MARL 方法均获得显著性能提升。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体轨迹增强中多样性-协调性权衡难题，提出基于扩散的顺序生成框架，用 inpainting 保证跨智能体协调一致性。

papers.title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
papers.abstract: Multimodal agentic coding requires robust visual reasoning to analyze observations and evaluate generated artifacts. Current frameworks largely rely on a Thinking-with-Images paradigm, where agents depend on their intrinsic vision to execute visually grounded tasks. However, this architectural coupling introduces a fundamental bottleneck. Agent performance remains strictly bounded by internal perceptual limitations. Furthermore, text-only agents lack native perception. Without specialized tools, they cannot perform visual reasoning. To overcome these constraints, we introduce the Vision-as-a-Tool (VaaT) paradigm. Prior visual tool-use merely manipulates images for an agent's intrinsic vision to read. In contrast, VaaT reframes general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) as callable external utilities. As a result, text-only agents can completely offload visual reasoning during agentic execution. Meanwhile, vision-capable agents can dynamically augment their native perception on demand. We instantiate this paradigm in VHarness, a unified framework driven by five atomic actions. We comprehensively evaluate VHarness across Image-to-HTML, Image-to-SVG, and Image-to-3D generation tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that VHarness consistently improves visual fidelity and geometric accuracy across both text-only and multimodal coding agents. These findings highlight that modularizing visual reasoning into callable utilities provides a flexible and scalable foundation for future agentic coding systems.

translation.title: Vision-as-a-Tool：面向多模态智能体编程的视觉工具框架
translation.abstract: 多模态智能体编程需要强大的视觉推理来分析观察结果并评估生成的产物。当前框架主要依赖 Thinking-with-Images 范式，智能体依赖其内在视觉来执行视觉接地的任务。然而这种架构耦合引入了根本性瓶颈：智能体性能被内部感知能力严格限制；此外，纯文本智能体缺乏原生感知，没有专门工具就无法进行视觉推理。为克服这些限制，我们提出 Vision-as-a-Tool（VaaT）范式。以往的视觉工具使用只是为智能体的内在视觉操纵图像以供其读取，而 VaaT 将通用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）重构为可调用的外部工具。因此，纯文本智能体可以在智能体执行过程中完全卸载视觉推理；同时具备视觉能力的智能体可以按需动态增强其原生感知。我们通过五个原子动作驱动的统一框架 VHarness 实例化该范式，并在 Image-to-HTML、Image-to-SVG 和 Image-to-3D 生成任务上全面评估 VHarness。实验结果表明，VHarness 在纯文本和多模态编程智能体上都持续提升视觉保真度与几何精度。这些发现表明，将视觉推理模块化为可调用工具为未来的智能体编程系统提供了灵活且可扩展的基础。
translation.brief: 针对智能体受内在视觉能力限制的问题，提出 VaaT 范式将 MLLM 作为可调用外部工具，让文本智能体卸载视觉推理、视觉智能体按需增强感知。

papers.title: Can Agents Keep Up with Time? An Empirical Analysis of Temporal Adaptation After a Conversational Hiatus
papers.abstract: Long-horizon agents increasingly serve as persistent personal assistants across modern web platforms, managing schedules, applications, and multi-step plans over weeks or months. Users often return to an ongoing conversation after a long conversational hiatus, while earlier bookings and preparation notes stay on record. During this hiatus, scheduled dates may pass even though the retained records remain unchanged and event outcomes go unrecorded. Existing evaluations of long-horizon agents focus on fact retention and explicit state updates. Whether agents perceive the passage of time and adapt their advice accordingly therefore remains unknown. We frame this ability as temporal state perception and use, which means perceiving the current time and applying it when interpreting dated records. To study it, we design session-rekindling tasks that keep the earlier conversation fixed and vary only the follow-up date and the way temporal information reaches the agent. Experiments across five model routes and five temporal-information conditions show that agents can obtain the current time but often fail to use it. They reliably query the clock and even note in their reasoning that the scheduled date has passed, yet many still tell users to prepare for the expired event. Supplying explicit temporal context reduces this error, and providing the computed date relation removes it entirely. Keeping up with time therefore depends on turning perceived time into updated plans. Based on these findings, we design a session-rekindling benchmark that provides temporal-awareness guidance for designing long-horizon agents. The code can be found at this https URL.

translation.title: Agent 能跟上时间吗？对话中断后时间适应性实证分析
translation.abstract: 长时程 Agent 日益成为现代网络平台上的持久性个人助手，在数周或数月内管理日程、申请和多步骤计划。用户常常在长时间中断后回到进行中的对话，而此前的预订和准备笔记仍保留在记录中。在这段中断期间，即使保留的记录未变且事件结果未被记录，预定日期也可能已经过去。现有对长时程 Agent 的评估聚焦于事实保持和显式状态更新，因此 Agent 是否感知时间的流逝并相应调整建议仍然未知。我们将这一能力定义为时间状态感知与使用，即感知当前时间并在解读带日期记录时应用它。为研究这一能力，我们设计了会话重启任务：保持先前对话不变，仅改变后续日期以及时间信息传递给 Agent 的方式。跨五个模型路线和五种时间信息条件的实验表明，Agent 能够获取当前时间，但常常未能使用它。它们可靠地查询时钟，甚至在推理中指出预定日期已过，但许多 Agent 仍然让用户为已过期的活动做准备。提供显式时间上下文可减少该错误，而提供计算好的日期关系则可完全消除该错误。因此，跟上时间取决于将感知到的时间转化为更新的计划。基于这些发现，我们设计了一个会话重启基准，为设计长时程 Agent 提供时间感知方面的指导。代码可在 this https URL 获取。
translation.brief: 研究长时程对话 Agent 能否感知对话中断期间时间的流逝并据此更新建议，通过仅改变后续日期的会话重启任务进行实证分析。

papers.title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. We introduce two complementary evaluation metrics: $S_\alpha$ prioritizes task success while accounting for resource use, and normalized cost per success (NCS) measures the resources spent per successful task. Across AppWorld, OfficeBench, and Tau2 Telecom with three LLM Actors, CarryOn achieves 75.7% macro-averaged task success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.7 percentage points. It also achieves the best average scores on both metrics.

translation.title: CarryOn：为长时程 LLM Agent 学习上下文中应保留的内容
translation.abstract: 长时程 LLM Agent 可以协调工具和应用以完成复杂的多步骤任务。随着交互历史的增长，有效的上下文管理对于可靠且高效的执行变得至关重要。现有方法通过摘要、剪枝或历史选择来缩减上下文。然而，更短的上下文并不必然带来更好的决策：摘要可能省略后续动作所需的精确细节，而保留完整交互则会带入大量无关信息。我们提出 CarryOn，一个轻量级上下文管理器，将紧凑的执行状态与细粒度、带来源链接的证据相结合。学习到的选择器和自适应保留策略在无需额外 LLM 调用进行上下文管理的情况下，保持相关证据可用。我们引入两个互补的评估指标：$S_\alpha$ 在考虑资源占用的同时优先考虑任务成功，归一化单次成功成本（NCS）衡量每次成功任务所花费的资源。在 AppWorld、OfficeBench 和 Tau2 Telecom 上使用三个 LLM Actor，CarryOn 取得 75.7% 的宏平均任务成功率，超过最强基线 6.7 个百分点，并在两个指标上均取得最佳平均分。
translation.brief: 提出 CarryOn 轻量上下文管理器，通过学习式选择器和自适应保留策略保留细粒度证据以管理长时程 LLM Agent 的上下文。

papers.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit. Prior work studies how LLM reviews align with human ones, yet we know little about which parts of a paper these models actually criticize. In this work, we investigate 2,000 papers from ACL, EMNLP, COLM, and ICLR, and show that the latest GPT and Claude models draw about 50% or more of their review weaknesses from the appendix. This behavior holds across the API, coding-agent, and web access methods for using LLMs to review a paper. In contrast, we find that humans draw only 8.4% of their weaknesses from the appendix, and these weaknesses primarily revolve around a paper's presentation and content related to its core idea. Meanwhile, LLMs draw weaknesses from deep in the appendix that concern fine-grained technical details not central to the paper's contributions. We anticipate that our analysis will contribute to the scholarly discourse on AI reviews. Our code is publicly available at: this https URL.

translation.title: AI 审稿对附录存在偏见
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被审稿人用来在审稿过程中指出弱点，其输出往往会影响人类提交的审稿意见。已有工作研究 LLM 审稿与人类审稿的一致性，但我们对这些模型实际批评论文的哪些部分知之甚少。在本工作中，我们研究了来自 ACL、EMNLP、COLM 和 ICLR 的 2,000 篇论文，结果显示最新的 GPT 和 Claude 模型约有 50% 或更多的审稿弱点来自附录。无论通过 API、coding-agent 还是网页访问方式使用 LLM 审稿，这一行为均保持一致。相比之下，我们发现人类仅有 8.4% 的弱点来自附录，且这些弱点主要围绕论文的表述及与其核心思想相关的内容。而 LLM 则从附录深处抽取涉及细粒度技术细节的弱点，这些细节并非论文贡献的核心。我们期望本分析能为 AI 审稿的学术讨论做出贡献。代码公开于 this https URL。
translation.brief: 通过分析 2,000 篇论文，揭示 LLM 审稿将约半数弱点错误地归咎于附录而非论文核心内容的问题。

papers.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
papers.abstract: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compared with a strong autonomous post-training baseline. Ablations further show that both reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration and governed reward evolution are important to these gains. G-CAST is now deployed in Yuancai(this http URL), a B2B procurement agent on Alibaba's 1688 platform.

translation.title: G-CAST：面向需求演进的电商 Agent 治理化持续自训练
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，越来越多的用户转向 LLM 驱动的 Agent 进行电商会话式购物。然而，随着新产品类目、采购场景和功能需求的出现，用户需求持续变化。与此同时，产品的执行框架——包括其工具、技能和操作流程——也在不断演进，以支持日益复杂的交互。这些变化带来两个实际挑战：1）需求漂移改变了用户请求的分布、意图和复杂度，使一次性训练的模型落后；2）框架演进要求模型正确使用新引入的能力，同时不丢失用户已依赖的行为。周期性的人工重训在这一场景下过于滞后且耗费人力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 G-CAST，一个治理化的持续自训练系统，将演进需求和Capability契约下的每日生产证据转化为 reward 路由、熵优先的训练数据和治理化奖励演进。在累积评估下的治理化 checkpoint 切换控制每次模型更新，使 Agent 能够学习新引入的行为而不牺牲已被接受的能力。在真实生产电商 Agent 上的实验表明，与强自治 post-training 基线相比，G-CAST 对新引入需求的适应性更强，同时更好地保留了先前被接受的行为。消融实验进一步表明，reward 路由、熵优先的数据编排和治理化奖励演进对这些收益都很重要。G-CAST 现已部署于 Yuancai（this http URL），这是阿里巴巴 1688 平台上的 B2B 采购 Agent。
translation.brief: 提出 G-CAST 治理化持续自训练系统，将生产数据经 reward 路由和熵优先编排转化为训练数据，使电商 Agent 适应需求漂移和执行框架演进。

papers.title: LLMs are Vulnerable to Malicious Requests with Indistinguishable Intent
papers.abstract: Jailbreak attacks can circumvent the safety mechanisms of Large Language Models (LLMs) and lead to the generation of harmful or policy-violating content. We first examine eight jailbreak methods against an LLM-based filter and observe that requests resembling normal user queries tend to have higher filter pass rates than those containing obvious anomalous patterns. This observation motivates the hypothesis that resemblance to normal requests may contribute to jailbreak success. We introduce \textbf{Detail Guidance Attack (DGA)}, a framework that uses an auxiliary LLM to construct detailed requests and interacts with the victim model in a single turn. Across 11 victim models and three datasets, the complete DGA pipeline achieves high attack success rates under our automated judging criterion, including rates above 95\% in several evaluated settings. We also evaluate a DGA-aware filter and conduct a user study on everyday requests with ambiguous or dual-use intent. The survey documents differing expectations about whether models should respond; the usability costs of the filter remain to be measured.

translation.title: LLM 容易受到意图难以分辨的恶意请求攻击
translation.abstract: Jailbreak 攻击可以绕过大型语言模型（LLM）的安全机制，导致生成有害或违反政策的内容。我们首先针对基于 LLM 的过滤器检验了八种 jailbreak 方法，观察到看起来像正常用户查询的请求往往比含有明显异常模式的请求具有更高的过滤器通过率。这一观察引发了一个假设：与正常请求的相似性可能有助于 jailbreak 的成功。我们提出 Detail Guidance Attack（DGA），一个利用辅助 LLM 构造详细请求并与受害模型进行单轮交互的框架。在 11 个受害模型和三个数据集上，完整的 DGA 流程在我们的自动化判定标准下取得了很高的攻击成功率，其中多个评估设置下超过 95%。我们还评估了具备 DGA 意识的过滤器，并针对意图模糊或双用途的日常请求开展了用户研究。调查显示人们对于模型是否应回应存在不同期望；过滤器的可用性成本仍有待测量。
translation.brief: 提出 Detail Guidance Attack，利用辅助 LLM 构造与正常查询难以区分的详细请求以单轮绕过 LLM 安全机制。

papers.title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
papers.abstract: Routine chest computed tomography (CT) captures pulmonary, cardiac, and vascular phenotypes that jointly stratify lung cancer and cardiovascular disease, the two leading causes of death in lung-screening populations. Yet clinical risk calculators evaluate each disease in isolation and omit CT findings, whereas unconstrained machine learning overfits small hospital cohorts, learns treatment- and illness-confounded risk directions, and conceals uncertainty when patient records are incomplete. Here we present the Causal Envelope Agent (CE-Agent), a two-stage framework that compiles peer-reviewed epidemiological evidence into explicit constraints on risk-factor weights before any outcome is seen, while estimating local baseline risk and newly added CT phenotypes from cohort data. At deployment, closed-form uncertainty propagation accounts for missing clinical or CT inputs within milliseconds per patient, running over two orders of magnitude faster than Monte Carlo sampling and returning calibrated risk intervals that direct chart review and selective imaging to borderline patients. Across 53,452 lung-screening participants from 33 US hospitals and 6,814 multi-ethnic adults, CE-Agent outperforms cardiovascular calculators in lung screening, exceeds the Pooled Cohort Equations on hard atherosclerotic events while correcting their 1.7-fold risk overestimation, and generalizes from a single hospital or CT scanner to external sites while lowering required sample sizes up to fivefold. Applied unchanged to lung cancer, CE-Agent matches established screening models with accurate calibration even when restricted to risk-factor directions alone, and pairing both predictions improves joint cardiopulmonary triage from a single screening visit.

translation.title: 因果约束与不确定性感知的心肺风险预测
translation.abstract: 常规胸部CT captures肺部、心脏和血管表型，可联合分层肺癌与心血管疾病风险——这两者是肺癌筛查人群的主要死因。然而临床风险计算器孤立评估各疾病且忽略CT发现，而无约束的机器学习会在小型医院队列上过拟合、学习受治疗和疾病混淆的风险方向，并在患者记录不完整时隐藏不确定性。我们提出Causal Envelope Agent（CE-Agent），一个两阶段框架：在看到任何结局之前，将经同行评审的流行病学证据编译为对风险因素权重的显式约束，同时从队列数据估计局部基线风险和新增的CT表型。部署时，闭式不确定性传播可在每患者毫秒级内处理缺失的临床或CT输入，比Monte Carlo采样快两个数量级以上，并返回校准的风险区间，以引导病历审查和选择性成像聚焦边缘患者。在来自33家美国医院的53,452名肺癌筛查参与者及6,814名多种族成年人中，CE-Agent在肺癌筛查中优于心血管计算器，在硬性动脉粥样硬化事件上超过Pooled Cohort Equations并纠正其1.7倍的风险高估，且能从单一医院或CT扫描仪泛化到外部站点，同时将所需样本量最多降低五倍。未经改动地应用于肺癌时，即使仅限风险因素方向，CE-Agent也能以准确校准匹配已有筛查模型；两种预测结合可改善单次筛查访视中的联合心肺分诊。
translation.brief: 针对临床风险计算器忽略CT信息且机器学习易过拟合、忽视不确定性的问题，提出将流行病学证据编译为显式因果约束并结合闭式不确定性传播的两阶段框架CE-Agent进行心肺风险预测。

papers.title: Aligning AI Teams
papers.abstract: Previous work has shown that alignment training on individual LLM agents can fail to transfer to multi-agent settings. We investigate the underlying mechanisms for this failure, and explore interventions to preserve alignment transfer to multi-agent LLM teams. We focus on two software-engineering tasks (sepsis triage, a news recommender) and ten consulting-proposal generation tasks. We present four findings: (1) The single-vs-team safety gap does not show a clear trend with more capable models. We find that Anthropic's Mythos Preview shows the largest gap on one of our tasks but the smallest on another; (2) Many natural interventions, such as having agents critique each other's work or coordinate in a group chat, do not reliably bring agent teams back to single-agent alignment behavior; (3) diffusion of responsibility substantially accounts for the safety gap: agents in teams are less likely to proactively check for system-level safety failures and more likely to ignore, rationalize, or deflect responsibility for issues when they arise; (4) having a designated safety lead agent ensure system-level safety, and having a coordinator agent publish a safety specifications document are effective at restoring single-agent alignment. We also release magelab, a multi-agent LLM orchestration and experimentation framework. Our findings can help practitioners design agent teams that successfully preserve the behaviors expected of aligned individual agents.

translation.title: 对齐AI团队
translation.abstract: 已有研究表明，对单个LLM智能体进行的对齐训练可能无法迁移到多智能体设置。我们研究这种失败的底层机制，并探索保持对齐迁移到多智能体LLM团队的干预措施。我们聚焦两个软件工程任务（脓毒症分诊、新闻推荐器）和十个咨询提案生成任务。我们提出四项发现：(1) 单体与团队的安全差距不随模型能力提升呈现清晰趋势；我们发现Anthropic的Mythos Preview在一个任务上差距最大，在另一个任务上差距最小；(2) 许多自然干预，如让智能体互相批评或通过群聊协调，并不能可靠地使智能体团队恢复到单智能体的对齐行为；(3) 责任分散在很大程度上解释了安全差距：团队中的智能体更少主动检查系统级安全故障，更可能在问题出现时忽略、合理化或推卸责任；(4) 指定一个安全负责智能体确保系统级安全，以及让一个协调者智能体发布安全规范文档，能有效恢复单智能体的对齐。我们还发布了magelab，一个多智能体LLM编排与实验框架。我们的发现可帮助从业者设计成功保持对齐单体智能体预期行为的智能体团队。
translation.brief: 针对单智能体对齐训练在多智能体LLM团队中失效的问题，通过机制分析发现责任分散是主因，并提出安全负责智能体和安全规范文档两类有效干预。

papers.title: SceneAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Portable Game Scene Generation
papers.abstract: Moving a scene generator to a new game engine requires more than exporting its final output: planning, construction tools, and stored experience may also depend on the original backend. We present SceneAgent, a multi-agent framework for reusing the construction process and its experience across backends. A canonical SceneContext maintains the evolving world, while backend adapters isolate coordinate conventions, asset bindings, and export. Structured handoffs let fresh Builder sessions query this persistent state without inheriting the full construction transcript. Across generations, human-approved traces are distilled into asset-ID-free Layout skills and semantic Content skills that can be retrieved and recombined. We introduce GameSceneBench, comprising 69 indoor and outdoor prompts. Under a common asset and evaluation protocol, SceneAgent obtains human tie-adjusted preference scores of 78.2-89.4% against five baselines. Ablations show that reusable skills and the multi-agent protocol primarily improve prompt alignment and scene completeness, with additional runtime. Deployment in a second engine preserves the shared construction protocol and skill library while replacing backend integration components. Together, these results support separating persistent scene state, task-local reasoning, and reusable experience for portable scene construction.

translation.title: SceneAgent：面向可移植游戏场景生成的多智能体框架
translation.abstract: 将场景生成器迁移到新游戏引擎需要的不仅是导出最终输出：规划、构建工具和存储经验也可能依赖原始后端。我们提出SceneAgent，一个跨后端复用构建过程及其经验的多智能体框架。一个规范的SceneContext维护不断演进的世界状态，后端适配器隔离坐标约定、资源绑定和导出。结构化交接让新的Builder会话查询该持久状态而无需继承完整构建记录。跨代际中，经人工批准的轨迹被蒸馏为不含资源ID的Layout技能和语义Content技能，可检索和重组。我们引入GameSceneBench，包含69个室内外提示。在统一的资源和评估协议下，SceneAgent对五个基线获得78.2–89.4%的人工平局调整偏好分数。消融实验表明可复用技能和多智能体协议主要提升提示对齐和场景完整性，代价是额外的运行时间。在第二个引擎中的部署保留了共享构建协议和技能库，仅替换后端集成组件。这些结果支持将持久场景状态、任务局部推理和可复用经验分离以实现可移植的场景构建。
translation.brief: 针对场景生成器跨游戏引擎后端难以迁移的问题，提出以规范SceneContext加后端适配器和可复用技能库的多智能体框架SceneAgent实现可移植场景构建。

papers.title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
papers.abstract: World-model video encoders such as V-JEPA learn how scenes change (direction, speed, order, state) from video alone. To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs. But each caption or question names only a few attributes of a clip, so the model learns to retrieve those attributes rather than to read the clip, and the dynamics the encoder carries go unused: on the same items, a linear probe reads speed from frozen V-JEPA features at 87% while the VLM answers at chance. We show where dynamics lives in a frozen encoder: in a subspace shared across videos for predictive encoders such as V-JEPA, but not as a shared component of frame-wise, text-aligned encoders such as SigLIP. We then build counterfactual supervision that makes the language model read it: pixel transformations turn public videos into answer-balanced variants whose answers are set by the transformation and differ only in the change. Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model. A controlled encoder x supervision study shows that the encoder decides what can be read and the supervision what is read: at a matched budget, counterfactual supervision adds 4.5 points on average and 38 on the speed questions of natural benchmarks. Code and models: this https URL.

translation.title: V-JEPA-LM：读取超越静态文本对齐表征的动态信息的视频-语言模型
translation.abstract: V-JEPA等世界模型视频编码器仅从视频学习场景如何变化（方向、速度、顺序、状态）。为回答问题，它们被连接到在字幕和问答对上训练的语言模型。但每条字幕或问题只命名片段的少数属性，因此模型学会检索这些属性而非读取片段，编码器携带的动态信息未被利用：在相同条目上，线性探针从冻结的V-JEPA特征读取速度达87%，而VLM只能达到随机水平。我们展示动态信息在冻结编码器中的位置：对V-JEPA这类预测性编码器，它位于跨视频共享的子空间中；但对SigLIP这类逐帧、文本对齐的编码器则不是共享成分。然后我们构建反事实监督使语言模型读取它：像素变换将公开视频转化为答案均衡的变体，其答案由变换设定且仅在变化上不同。在453万公开样本、每帧32个视觉token上单阶段训练（开放视频LLM通常使用多个阶段、900万至1.72亿样本、每帧平均64至256个token），得到的V-JEPA-LM模型（1B至8B，Qwen3和Llama）在十一个视频基准的平均分数上领先所有尺寸级别；我们的4B模型得分72.1，而最好的开放4B模型为61.1，最好的开放8B模型为64.8。一项受控的编码器×监督研究表明，编码器决定什么可被读取，监督决定什么被读取：在匹配预算下，反事实监督平均提升4.5分，在自然基准的速度问题上提升38分。代码和模型：this https URL。
translation.brief: 针对视频LLM无法利用编码器中动态信息的问题，定位V-JEPA特征中的共享动态子空间并用像素变换构建反事实监督，实现单阶段高效训练的V-JEPA-LM。

papers.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
papers.abstract: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Using this dataset, we train an AI reviewer model, PaperCritic, through reinforcement learning with the F1 score of precision and recall as the reward. Our experiments show that PaperCritic outperforms frontier models and models trained with other AI reviewer training methods on an in-domain test set. Surprisingly, learning to review ICLR submissions also transfers to reviewing Nature-family papers and even to out-of-domain reviewing tasks (e.g., code review, legal contract review, and feedback on story writing).

translation.title: PaperCritic：训练AI审稿人评估论文的可靠性
translation.abstract: 随着AI会议投稿快速增长，AI审稿人被视为一种替代方案。然而，简单模仿人类审稿存在问题，因为审稿服务于多种目的，包括评估论文的可靠性、有趣性和清晰度，后两者是主观的。在本工作中，我们仅聚焦评估可靠性这一最重要且客观的标准，并将学习目标定义为同时最大化：(1) 精确率，基于审稿意见点的可靠性和实质性；(2) 召回率，高质量参考审稿意见点的覆盖率。在此问题设定下，我们使用1K份ICLR投稿和23K条人类撰写及LLM生成的审稿意见点构建了质量标注的审稿意见点数据集PaperSound-23K。利用该数据集，我们通过以精确率和召回率F1分数为奖励的强化学习训练AI审稿模型PaperCritic。实验表明，PaperCritic在域内测试集上优于前沿模型和其他AI审稿训练方法训练的模型。出人意料的是，学习审阅ICLR投稿还能迁移到审阅Nature系列论文，甚至迁移到域外审阅任务（如代码审查、法律合同审查和故事写作反馈）。
translation.brief: 针对AI审稿需聚焦客观评估论文可靠性的问题，构建PaperSound-23K数据集并以精确率和召回率F1为奖励的强化学习训练PaperCritic。

papers.title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors
papers.abstract: Abliteration, a fine-tuning-free weight edit, removes refusal from open-weight large language models (LLMs). The developer of Arbitrary-Rank Ablation (ARA), an optimisation-based variant, reports that direction-based abliteration, which ablates a refusal direction, increasingly fails on newer models. On five release pairs, refusal removal did not become uniformly harder. Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-2-27B and Gemma-4-31B, OLMo-2-32B and Olmo-3.1-32B, Mistral-Small-2409 and Mistral-Small-3.2, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3.5-4B were edited in Heretic 2.0 by three or four direction-based methods (difference-in-means, MPOA, SOM and, on the small pair, J-space) and ARA under the same prompts, nominal search budget, first-token KL divergence cap and selection rule; removal counted as harder when the automatic WildGuard judge found more of 972 held-out harmful prompts (JailbreakBench, XSTest, StrongREJECT, HarmBench and an author-compiled malicious-code bank) still refused. After direction-based removal, newer releases retained -1 to +37 percentage points more refusal, and after ARA -26 to +34. With run-to-run variance included, between-pair heterogeneity of the direction-based effect ranged from high to low with the scale and variance model (I^2 20-80%). ARA lost less effectiveness than direction-based methods in Gemma and OLMo and more in Qwen; each verdict rests on one ARA run, and some changed with the divergence budget or variance model. In Gemma the direction-based increase came from the malicious-code bank and reversed on public sets. Contrary to prediction, keyword counts at the tool's window did not undercount judged refusal on average, but differed by a mean 7 points per model. Audits of a single pair, method or prompt source can reach opposite conclusions. Whether a newer model resisted removal depended on the release pair, method and budget, not on generation alone.

translation.title: 拒绝移除是否越来越难？并非如此：基于方向的消融与 Heretic 中 ARA 在 Qwen3.8、Gemma 4、Olmo 3.1 和 Mistral Small 3.2 LLM 及其前代模型上的表现
translation.abstract: Abliteration 是一种无需微调的权重编辑方法，可移除开源大语言模型（LLM）的拒绝行为。基于优化的变体 Arbitrary-Rank Ablation（ARA）的开发者报告称，对拒绝方向进行消融的基于方向的 abliteration 在新模型上日益失效。在五个发布版本对上，拒绝移除并未一致变得更难。研究者对 Qwen2.5-32B 与 Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma-2-27B 与 Gemma-4-31B、OLMo-2-32B 与 Olmo-3.1-32B、Mistral-Small-2409 与 Mistral-Small-3.2 以及 Qwen2.5-7B 与 Qwen3.5-4B，在 Heretic 2.0 中使用三种或四种基于方向的方法（difference-in-means、MPOA、SOM 以及小模型对上的 J-space）和 ARA 进行编辑，采用相同的提示、名义搜索预算、首 token KL 散度上限和选择规则；当自动 WildGuard 评审判定 972 个保留的有害提示（来自 JailbreakBench、XSTest、StrongREJECT、HarmBench 及作者自编的恶意代码库）中仍有更多被拒绝时，即认为移除更难。基于方向移除后，新版本多保留了 -1 到 +37 个百分点的拒绝行为；ARA 后为 -26 到 +34。纳入运行间方差后，基于方向效应在版本对之间的异质性随规模和方差模型从高到低变化（I^2 20-80%）。ARA 在 Gemma 和 OLMo 上损失的有效性少于基于方向的方法，在 Qwen 上则更多；每个结论都基于单次 ARA 运行，且部分结论随散度预算或方差模型而改变。在 Gemma 上，基于方向的增加来自恶意代码库，且在公开数据集上出现反转。与预测相反，工具窗口处的关键词计数平均并未低估评审判定的拒绝，但每个模型平均相差 7 个百分点。对单个版本对、方法或提示来源的审计可能得出相反的结论。新模型是否抵抗移除取决于版本对、方法和预算，而非模型代际本身。
translation.brief: 研究新版 LLM 是否更难通过 abliteration 移除拒绝行为，通过在五个版本对上统一比较多种方向消融方法与 ARA 的效果来回答。

papers.title: OrbitWeaver: LLM Agent Planning with Simulation Feedback for Optically Interconnected Orbital GPU Clusters
papers.abstract: Space-based data-center designs increasingly consider GPU computing formations connected by inter-satellite optical links. With limited neighboring connections, jobs assigned disjoint GPUs can still contend on shared relay paths. Rank placement and communication priorities jointly affect this contention and the readiness of downstream computation. We present OrbitWeaver, an offline large language model (LLM) agent planner that jointly optimizes rank placement and communication order. Guided by communication structure, execution dependencies, and simulation feedback, the agent constructs and refines plans that coordinate shared-link access with computation progress. This coordination reduces contention and dependency blocking, shortening mean job completion time (JCT). Simulation experiments on optically interconnected orbital GPU clusters show that OrbitWeaver reduces aggregate mean JCT by 6.2-33.5% relative to the state-of-the-art baselines CASSINI, Crux, and Symphony. These results demonstrate the value of LLM-guided planning for efficient concurrent computing in orbital GPU clusters.

translation.title: OrbitWeaver：面向光互联轨道 GPU 集群的基于仿真反馈的 LLM 智能体规划
translation.abstract: 天基数据中心设计日益考虑由星间光链路连接的 GPU 计算编队。在相邻连接有限的情况下，分配到不相交 GPU 的作业仍可能在共享中继路径上产生争用。秩（rank）放置与通信优先级共同影响这种争用及下游计算的就绪程度。我们提出 OrbitWeaver，一个离线的大语言模型（LLM）智能体规划器，可联合优化秩放置与通信顺序。在通信结构、执行依赖和仿真反馈的引导下，该智能体构建并改进协调共享链路访问与计算进度的方案。这种协调减少了争用和依赖阻塞，缩短了平均作业完成时间（JCT）。在光互联轨道 GPU 集群上的仿真实验表明，与最先进的基线 CASSINI、Crux 和 Symphony 相比，OrbitWeaver 将总体平均 JCT 降低了 6.2-33.5%。这些结果证明了 LLM 引导的规划对轨道 GPU 集群高效并发计算的价值。
translation.brief: 解决星间光链路共享路径上分布式作业的通信争用问题，采用 LLM 智能体结合仿真反馈联合优化秩放置与通信顺序。

papers.title: DECODE: Diagnosing Interpretability Failures in Automated Interpretation Process
papers.abstract: Tools for interpreting the internal representations of Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on LLMs themselves to both generate and evaluate explanations, creating a self-referential automated interpretation process with minimal human oversight. This automation raises significant reliability concerns, which are exacerbated by the absence of ground truth. In practice, it is difficult to validate explanations or to attribute interpretability failures to their source -- whether they originate from the tool's extracted representations or from the LLM used in the process. To address these challenges, we present DECODE, a visual analytics system that reintroduces human oversight into the automated interpretation process. Our approach decomposes the diagnostic workflow into three progressive stages, isolating failure sources ranging from structural defects to explanation-level misalignments. Drawing inspiration from inter-coder consensus in qualitative analysis, we utilize consensus among independently generated explanations and their evaluation metrics as a proxy for reliability. To further scale human inspection, we employ a three-phase active seeding protocol that strategically recommends high-priority instances for manual review. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through a case study on 16,384 Sparse Autoencoder features, showing that it can efficiently identify and attribute interpretability failures at scale.

translation.title: DECODE：诊断自动化解释过程中的可解释性失效
translation.abstract: 解释大语言模型（LLM）内部表示的工具日益依赖 LLM 本身来生成和评估解释，形成了一个人类监督极少、自我指涉的自动化解释过程。这种自动化引发了严重的可靠性担忧，而缺乏真值进一步加剧了这一问题。实践中，难以验证解释的有效性，也难以将可解释性失效归因于其来源——是源自工具提取的表示，还是过程中使用的 LLM。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 DECODE，一个将人类监督重新引入自动化解释过程的可视化分析系统。我们的方法将诊断工作流分解为三个渐进阶段，隔离从结构性缺陷到解释层面错位的各类失效来源。借鉴定性分析中的编码者间共识，我们利用独立生成的解释之间的共识及其评估指标作为可靠性的代理。为进一步扩展人工检查规模，我们采用三阶段主动播种协议，策略性地推荐高优先级实例供人工审查。最后，我们通过对 16,384 个 Sparse Autoencoder 特征的案例研究展示了方法的有效性，表明其能够大规模高效地识别并归因可解释性失效。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 自动解释过程缺乏人类监督、失效难以归因的问题，提出可视化系统 DECODE，通过解释共识和主动播种分阶段隔离失效来源。

papers.title: Fuse-All MoE Inference Kernel with Load Balancing on TPUs
papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures activate only a subset of experts for each token, allowing large language models (LLMs) to scale parameter capacity without a proportional increase in computation per token. However, intermediate data movement and uneven expert loads limit the efficiency of MoE inference on TPUs. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce Fuse-All MoE, a TPU kernel design that jointly optimizes expert computation, output communication, and load balancing. The kernel fuses token collection, expert projections, gated activation, and output writes, retaining expert computation intermediates on chip. Fixed token-slot destinations allow scheduling and expert placement to change while preserving routing semantics. In prefill-decode (PD) disaggregated serving, Fuse-All MoE balances EP16 prefill workloads through scheduling and expert redistribution, while symmetric EP8TP2 shares active expert computation between the two TensorCore devices within each chip during decode. Our experiments show that Fuse-All MoE reduces kernel runtime for a measured skewed EP16 prefill workload from 2.3x to 1.09x the same fixed reference time for a balanced workload. Across 32-512 decode tokens, symmetric EP8TP2 reduces kernel latency by up to 21.3% relative to fused EP16. With accompanying serving stack optimizations, the integrated system improves serving throughput by up to 34.5% over the Megablox EP16 baseline.

translation.title: Fuse-All：具有负载均衡的 TPU MoE 推理内核
translation.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）架构对每个 token 仅激活部分专家，使大语言模型（LLM）能够在不按比例增加每 token 计算量的情况下扩展参数容量。然而，中间数据搬运和不均的专家负载限制了 TPU 上 MoE 推理的效率。为解决这些瓶颈，我们提出 Fuse-All MoE，一种联合优化专家计算、输出通信和负载均衡的 TPU 内核设计。该内核融合了 token 收集、专家投影、门控激活和输出写回，将专家计算中间结果保留在片上。固定的 token-slot 目的地允许调度和专家布局变化，同时保持路由语义。在 prefill-decode（PD）分离式服务中，Fuse-All MoE 通过调度和专家重分配来均衡 EP16 prefill 负载，而对称的 EP8TP2 在解码期间让每芯片内的两个 TensorCore 设备共享活跃专家计算。实验表明，对于实测倾斜的 EP16 prefill 负载，Fuse-All MoE 将内核运行时间从均衡负载固定参考时间的 2.3 倍降至 1.09 倍。在 32-512 个解码 token 范围内，对称 EP8TP2 相对于融合 EP16 将内核时延最多降低 21.3%。配合服务栈优化，集成系统相比 Megablox EP16 基线将服务吞吐量最多提升 34.5%。
translation.brief: 解决 TPU 上 MoE 推理的中间数据搬运和专家负载不均问题，提出融合专家计算、通信与负载均衡的 Fuse-All 内核设计。

papers.title: Disentangling Forgetting from Utility: Lightweight LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Null-Space Projection
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) pose significant security risks by retaining private or hazardous information, creating an urgent need for unlearning techniques that excise specific knowledge without compromising general utility. However, prevailing fine-tuning-based unlearning methods struggle to achieve this balance, often suffering from computational inefficiency and unintended utility degradation due to the entangled nature of knowledge within model parameters. To disentangle forgetting from utility, we propose UUE, a theoretically grounded framework that reformulates unlearning as controllable model editing. First, UUE projects parameter updates into the orthogonal left null space of retained knowledge representations, strictly ensuring that the editing process causes minimal interference to the model's general capabilities. Second, distinct from targeted mapping, we introduce a convex untargeted objective that derives a closed-form analytical solution to effectively disrupt undesired knowledge by pushing forget-set embeddings toward their antipodal points. We implement UUE via lightweight, pluggable adapters (including a low-rank variant, UUE-L), enabling efficient deployment without modifying the frozen backbone. Extensive experiments on TOFU and WMDP benchmarks demonstrate that UUE and UUE-L achieve superior unlearning efficacy, significantly outperforming existing methods.

translation.title: 将遗忘与效用解耦：基于正交零空间投影的轻量级 LLM 机器遗忘
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）因保留私密或危险信息而带来重大安全风险，迫切需要在不损害通用效用的情况下移除特定知识的机器遗忘（unlearning）技术。然而，主流基于微调的遗忘方法难以实现这种平衡，由于知识在模型参数中相互纠缠，常存在计算效率低下和非预期的效用退化。为将遗忘与效用解耦，我们提出 UUE，一个有理论基础的框架，将机器遗忘重新表述为可控模型编辑。首先，UUE 将参数更新投影到保留知识表示的正交左零空间，严格确保编辑过程对模型通用能力的干扰最小。其次，不同于靶向映射，我们引入一个凸的非靶向目标，推导出闭式解析解，通过将遗忘集嵌入推向其对跖点来有效破坏不想要的知识。我们通过轻量、可插拔的适配器（包括低秩变体 UUE-L）实现 UUE，可在不修改冻结主干的情况下高效部署。在 TOFU 和 WMDP 基准上的大量实验表明，UUE 和 UUE-L 实现了更优的遗忘效果，显著超越现有方法。
translation.brief: 解决机器遗忘中遗忘效果与通用效用难以兼顾的问题，提出 UUE 框架，通过正交零空间投影和凸非靶向目标的闭式解以可插拔适配器实现轻量遗忘。

papers.title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications
papers.abstract: We study encoder models that pick one of several options in a single forward pass, without generating text. This technical report compares recipes for fine-tuning UltraBERT-380M with one mask per option. The four recipes differ in how an option is scored and how the scores become probabilities; one follows the expert gate of DeepSeek-V3. Trained on the same data as Qwen3-0.6B with the LLM-as-Jev recipe (67.6% test accuracy), the encoder reaches 69.7% to 72.1%. Scoring an option by "yes" minus "no" instead of "yes" alone gives the larger gain, from 69.7% to 71.3% on the test set and from 57.8% to 59.6% on external benchmarks (56.1% for the decoder). Sigmoid normalisation adds 0.8 test points; a square-root softplus adds none. One request at a time on an NVIDIA A100, the encoder takes 29 ms per decision against 68 ms, but uses more peak memory (2.8 against 2.2 GiB). An auxiliary head, trained on human-marked evidence and on labels selected with a reward adapted from SelfCite, predicts in the same pass the sentences annotated as support for the answer.

translation.title: UltraBERT-JEV：面向 System One 应用的编码器模型
translation.abstract: 我们研究在单次前向传播中从多个选项中挑选一个、无需生成文本的编码器模型。本技术报告比较了使用每选项一个 mask 对 UltraBERT-380M 进行微调的多种方案。四种方案的区别在于选项如何被打分以及分数如何转化为概率；其中一种遵循 DeepSeek-V3 的专家门控。在与采用 LLM-as-Jev 方案的 Qwen3-0.6B 相同的数据上训练（后者测试准确率为 67.6%），编码器达到 69.7% 至 72.1%。用"yes"减"no"而非仅用"yes"为选项打分带来更大提升，在测试集上从 69.7% 提升至 71.3%，在外部基准上从 57.8% 提升至 59.6%（解码器为 56.1%）。Sigmoid 归一化额外带来 0.8 个测试点；平方根 softplus 则无提升。在 NVIDIA A100 上逐条处理请求时，编码器每次决策耗时 29 毫秒（解码器为 68 毫秒），但峰值内存占用更高（2.8 GiB 对 2.2 GiB）。一个辅助头在人工标注证据和用改编自 SelfCite 的奖励所选标签上训练，可在同一次前向传播中预测被标注为支持答案的句子。
translation.brief: 研究无需生成文本、单次前向传播即可完成选项选择的编码器方案，核心方法是比较四种选项打分与概率化方案微调 UltraBERT-380M，并用辅助头在同次推理中预测支持证据。

papers.title: Soteria: Formally Verified Planning with Runtime Enforcement for Safe LLM Agents
papers.abstract: LLM agents that execute multi-step tool calls must satisfy two objectives simultaneously: completing the user's task (utility) and conforming to domain policies and correctness constraints (safety). These objectives are in tension -- blocking an unsafe action prevents a violation but can leave the agent stranded with no principled way to recover. Existing approaches sacrifice one objective for the other. We introduce Soteria, a framework that reconciles safety and utility through verified hierarchical planning and runtime enforcement of specifications. Before execution, the agent generates a structured plan that is formally verified against the specifications prior to any tool invocation. During execution, the verified plan serves dual roles: it ensures that the agent takes specification-conformant trajectories and provides guidance when unsafe actions are blocked. Across multiple benchmarks covering a diverse range of tool-use tasks, Soteria achieves 1.7 times the average task success rate of the best baselines, with no violations of policy specifications, demonstrating that safety and utility need not be traded off.

translation.title: Soteria：面向安全 LLM 智能体的形式化验证规划与运行时强制执行
translation.abstract: 执行多步工具调用的 LLM 智能体必须同时满足两个目标：完成用户任务（效用）和符合领域策略与正确性约束（安全）。这两个目标相互冲突——阻止不安全动作虽可避免违规，却可能使智能体陷入困境且缺乏有原则的恢复方式。现有方法往往牺牲一个目标来换取另一个。我们提出 Soteria，一个通过经过验证的分层规划和规范的运行时强制执行来调和安全与效用的框架。在执行之前，智能体生成一个结构化计划，该计划在任何工具调用之前针对规范进行形式化验证。执行期间，经过验证的计划发挥双重作用：既确保智能体遵循符合规范的轨迹，又在阻断不安全动作时提供引导。在覆盖多种工具使用任务的多个基准上，Soteria 的平均任务成功率是最佳基线的 1.7 倍，且没有任何策略规范违规，表明安全与效用无需权衡。
translation.brief: 解决 LLM 智能体安全与效用难以兼顾的问题，核心方法是先对结构化计划做形式化验证、再在运行时强制执行该计划以同时保障规范合规与任务恢复。

papers.title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. We theoretically establish security guarantees for SecMAS against both untargeted and targeted attacks. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing aggregation rules are vulnerable to ReMA, whereas SecMAS effectively defends against all evaluated attacks, including adaptive variants of ReMA, while maintaining utility comparable to that of existing aggregation rules.

translation.title: 从设计上保障多智能体系统安全
translation.abstract: 多智能体系统通过将复杂任务分解为子任务、把子任务委派给各智能体、并使用聚合规则汇总各智能体的响应来求解。恶意智能体可通过对其被分配子任务提供恶意响应来操纵最终结果。本文首先提出响应操纵攻击（ReMA），其迭代优化恶意响应以最大化攻击效果。具体而言，我们将无目标攻击和有目标攻击形式化为优化问题，并开发了一种通过基于代理多智能体系统的反馈迭代细化恶意响应来近似求解的方法。为防御此类攻击，我们进一步提出 SecMAS，一种利用智能体响应间语义相似性、选出与足够大的其他响应子集最一致的响应的安全聚合规则。我们从理论上为 SecMAS 建立了针对无目标攻击和有目标攻击的安全保证。大量评估表明，现有聚合规则易受 ReMA 攻击，而 SecMAS 能有效防御所有被评估的攻击（包括 ReMA 的自适应变体），同时保持与现有聚合规则相当的效用。
translation.brief: 解决恶意智能体通过操纵子任务响应破坏多智能体系统的问题，核心方法是提出 ReMA 迭代攻击与基于语义相似性多数一致的安全聚合规则 SecMAS。

papers.title: Game-Theoretic Analysis of RIS-Assisted Challenge-Response PLA - Part II: Partial Channel Knowledge
papers.abstract: We consider a physical layer authentication scenario in which a legitimate user (Alice) communicates with an authenticator (Bob) through a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS), controlled by Bob. An attacker (Trudy) aims to impersonate Alice by suitably precoding her messages and still transmitting them through the RIS. This two-part study analyzes this attack-defense interaction between Bob and Trudy under perfect (Part I) and partial (Part II) channel knowledge by all the agents. Part I formulates the joint RIS selection and precoder design under perfect channel knowledge as a finite zero-sum game, establishing exact channel subspace conditions for attack indistinguishability alongside equilibrium mixed strategies. Part II extends the defense to incomplete channel information, where each agent observes only its own channel, by formulating a finite-action Bayesian game and characterizing the resulting Bayesian Nash equilibrium. Simulations in geometric and 3GPP TR 38.901 UMi-NLOS channels reveal that authentication performance is governed by available spatial degrees of freedom, channel correlation, and operating signal-to-noise ratio. The proposed equilibrium strategies effectively balance communication rate and security, outperforming conventional benchmark policies.

translation.title: RIS 辅助挑战-响应物理层认证的博弈论分析——第二部分：部分信道知识
translation.abstract: 我们考虑一个物理层认证场景：合法用户（Alice）通过由认证方（Bob）控制的可重构智能表面（RIS）与认证方通信。攻击者（Trudy）试图通过对消息进行适当预编码并仍经由 RIS 发送来冒充 Alice。这项分为两部分的研究在所有参与者具备完美（第一部分）和部分（第二部分）信道知识的条件下分析 Bob 与 Trudy 之间的攻防交互。第一部分将完美信道知识下的 RIS 选择与预编码器联合设计形式化为有限零和博弈，确立了攻击不可区分的精确信道子空间条件以及均衡混合策略。第二部分将防御扩展到不完整信道信息的情形——每个参与者仅能观测自己的信道——通过形式化为有限动作贝叶斯博弈并刻画所得的贝叶斯纳什均衡。在几何信道和 3GPP TR 38.901 UMi-NLOS 信道中的仿真表明，认证性能由可用空间自由度、信道相关性和工作信噪比决定。所提出的均衡策略能有效平衡通信速率与安全性，优于传统基准策略。
translation.brief: 解决各参与方仅有部分信道知识时 RIS 辅助物理层认证的攻防设计问题，核心方法是将交互形式化为有限动作贝叶斯博弈并刻画贝叶斯纳什均衡策略。

papers.title: Adversarially Attacking Symbolic Vocabulary Vulnerabilities In LLM Planners
papers.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, their abilities in navigating automated planning tasks have become essential. However, despite their strengths, LLMs' planning ability is not robust, particularly when they are not allowed to exploit commonsense cues in the symbolic vocabulary (e.g., names of actions, predicates, and objects) used to define planning tasks. This makes LLMs unreliable compared to symbolic planners. With recent reasoning models showing improved planning performance on tasks with obfuscated symbolic vocabularies, we utilize an adversarial attack framework to reveal to what extent the crucial weaknesses of LLM agents at joint symbolic interpretation and planning remain and whether they can reason properly when presented with severe cases. As such, our main contribution is devising an LLM-based attack model, which we call Symbolic Swapper, to automatically generate obfuscated planning domains with non-standard symbolic vocabularies that systematically break strong reasoning models' ability to plan. In doing so, we reveal how much LLMs' planning abilities can be further degraded under more advanced obfuscation schemes, allowing us to ascertain their success when having to rely on their pure planning ability. We find that attacks can decrease the planning performance of base models and even robust planning frameworks by over 70%. We further analyze the factors behind how LLM planning abilities break down and find that successful obfuscation causes models to appear to significantly degrade in reasoning quality despite them showing some inherent ability to understand the domain, revealing a gap in the perception of a task domain and being able to plan under it.

translation.title: 对抗性攻击 LLM 规划器中的符号词汇脆弱性
translation.abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署为自主智能体，其完成自动规划任务的能力变得至关重要。然而，尽管具备诸多优势，LLM 的规划能力并不鲁棒，尤其是在不允许利用用于定义规划任务的符号词汇（如动作、谓词和对象的名称）中的常识线索时。这使 LLM 相比符号规划器不够可靠。鉴于近期推理模型在符号词汇被混淆的任务上表现出更好的规划性能，我们利用对抗攻击框架来揭示 LLM 智能体在联合符号解释与规划方面的关键弱点在多大程度上仍然存在，以及在面对严重情形时能否正确推理。为此，我们的主要贡献是设计了一个名为 Symbolic Swapper 的基于 LLM 的攻击模型，自动生成使用非标准符号词汇、系统性地破坏强推理模型规划能力的混淆规划域。由此，我们揭示了在更先进的混淆方案下 LLM 的规划能力还能被削弱多少，从而可以判断其在必须依赖纯规划能力时的表现。我们发现攻击可使基础模型甚至鲁棒规划框架的性能下降超过 70%。我们进一步分析了 LLM 规划能力崩溃背后的因素，发现成功的混淆会使模型在推理质量上显著退化，尽管它们表现出一定的理解领域的内在能力，揭示了感知任务领域与在该领域下进行规划之间的鸿沟。
translation.brief: 揭示 LLM 在符号词汇混淆下规划能力脆弱的问题，核心方法是设计 Symbolic Swapper 攻击模型自动生成非标准符号词汇的混淆规划域来系统性破坏模型规划能力。

papers.title: DOCKET: A Pluralistic Benchmark for Evaluating AI-Assisted Policy Feedback in U.S. Rulemaking
papers.abstract: As AI models advance and impact deliberative democracies, there is a growing need to assess their support of pluralistic viewpoints. Most pluralism benchmarks are insufficient for this: they are not grounded in diversity (i.e., stakeholders across different frames, skills and needs), quality (i.e., rigorous and technical debates), and impact (i.e., invested deliberators and real-world outcomes). To address this, we first (i) curate DOCKET, the most comprehensive dataset of the U.S. Federal Notice & Comment process to date. DOCKET consists of 42.3M public comments on 22,400 regulations across 44 government agencies between 2016 and 2026 and contains millions of policy debates; we link public comments to particular policy items proposed by regulators to track the public's attention and the responsiveness of regulators to public input. (ii) Next, we demonstrate the pluralistic utility of DOCKET - we show that public commenters have a wide breadth of perspectives with significant depth in policy expertise and that regulators are often responsive. (iii) Finally, we present DOCKETBench, the first systematic evaluation of LLMs' ability to represent human policy perspectives in federal rulemaking. Only 18-30% of LLM-generated feedback aligns with real human comments. LLMs critique proposals broadly but generally, lacking the specific grounding, citations, and lived-experience arguments that humans bring to bear; in addition, most models we test systematically agree with government perspectives (overlapping with up to 68% of their claims) and agree least with labor unions (as little as 26% of their claims), demonstrating a fundamental skew in perspectives that even tools like persona modeling do not solve. Taken together, we reveal fundamental gaps in how language models navigate real policy issues, and DOCKETBench serves as a testbed for closing those gaps in a crucial real-world domain.

translation.title: DOCKET：一个用于评估美国规则制定中AI辅助政策反馈的多元化基准
translation.abstract: 随着AI模型的发展并影响协商民主，评估其对多元观点的支持变得日益重要。现有的多元化基准大多不足，因为它们缺乏多样性（即跨不同视角、技能和需求的利益相关者）、质量（即严谨的技术性辩论）和影响力（即投入的协商者和现实世界的结果）。为此，我们首先（i）构建了DOCKET——迄今最全面的美国联邦“通知与评论”流程数据集。DOCKET包含2016年至2026年间44个政府机构22,400项法规的4230万条公众意见，并包含数百万条政策辩论；我们将公众意见与监管者提出的具体政策条款关联，以追踪公众关注点和监管者对公众意见的回应。（ii）其次，我们展示了DOCKET的多元化效用——公众评论者具有广泛且在政策专业知识上有深度的观点，而监管者也常常有回应。（iii）最后，我们提出DOCKETBench，首个系统性评估LLM在联邦规则制定中表达人类政策观点能力的基准。仅18-30%的LLM生成的反馈与真实人类意见一致。LLM对提案的批评宽泛而笼统，缺乏人类所具备的具体依据、引用和生活经验论证；此外，我们测试的大多数模型系统性偏向政府观点（与其观点重合度高达68%），而与工会的观点重合度最低（仅26%），显示出一种根本性的观点偏差，即使角色建模等工具也无法解决。综上，我们揭示了语言模型在处理真实政策问题上的根本差距，DOCKETBench可作为弥合这一关键现实领域差距的测试平台。
translation.brief: 构建美国联邦规则制定中公众意见的大规模数据集和基准DOCKETBench，以评估LLM表达多元政策观点的能力。

papers.title: Condensing Law of Security Information
papers.abstract: Scaling laws indicate that the generalization error of a large language model (LLM) decreases monotonically with model size once data is sufficient, and the corollary that larger models outperform smaller ones is now widely accepted. We argue that this corollary fails in security: decisions there hinge on anomalous inputs, which are long-tailed (e.g., zero-day attacks) and therefore poorly served by likelihood fitting. Worse still, the capability brought about by scale (e.g., inferring the intended whole from a corrupted part) leads a LLM silently \emph{repair} the anomaly before any downstream security head ever sees it. We formalize this as a tradeoff between two quantities: the cognitive capability $K(W)=I(W;P)$ that a model holds about the world distribution, and the security-information retention $R(W)=\frac{I(Z;S)}{I(A;S)}$ that survives in its intermediate representation.
