We derive three information-theoretic bounds to connect them: an upper bound on restoration accuracy in terms of $K(W)$, an upper bound on $R(W)$ in terms of the restoration error, and a Fano lower bound on security-task error in terms of $R(W)$. These theorems approximately imply that usable security information is a product of how much security information survives and how well it can be extracted, indicating that optimal usable security information can be achieved at a certain model size. We state this as the \emph{condensing law of security information}: usable security information is unimodal in model size, so security generalization error is U-shaped and is minimized at a finite $N^{\star}$ rather than decreasing without bound. The experiments on various real-world LLMs validate the condensing law, indicating that there is an optimal model size to solve security issues.

translation.title: 安全信息凝聚定律
translation.abstract: 缩放定律表明，在数据充足的情况下，大语言模型（LLM）的泛化误差随模型规模单调下降，“更大的模型优于更小的模型”这一推论如今已被广泛接受。我们认为这一推论在安全领域失效：安全决策依赖于异常输入，而异常输入是长尾分布的（例如零日攻击），因此似然拟合难以很好地覆盖它们。更糟的是，规模带来的能力（例如从损坏的部分推断预期的整体）会使LLM在下游安全模块看到异常之前就将其默默“修复”。我们将其形式化为两个量之间的权衡：模型对世界分布的认知能力 $K(W)=I(W;P)$，以及其中间表示中保留下来的安全信息保留度 $R(W)=\frac{I(Z;S)}{I(A;S)}$。我们推导出三个信息论界来连接它们：以 $K(W)$ 表示的修复准确率上界、以修复误差表示的 $R(W)$ 上界，以及以 $R(W)$ 表示的安全任务误差的Fano下界。这些定理大致意味着可用安全信息是存活下来的安全信息量与提取能力之积，表明最优的可用安全信息可在某个模型规模处达到。我们将其表述为“安全信息凝聚定律”：可用安全信息关于模型规模呈单峰，因此安全泛化误差呈U形，在有限的 $N^{\star}$ 处取得最小值而非无界下降。在多个真实世界LLM上的实验验证了凝聚定律，表明存在一个解决安全问题的最优模型规模。
translation.brief: 形式化并提出“安全信息凝聚定律”，证明安全泛化误差随模型规模呈U形，存在最优模型规模。

papers.title: TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Synchronous, colocated RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) today suffers from severe under-utilization due to long-tail rollouts. Inference engines fall idle waiting for long-tail rollouts or decode at low, inefficient batch sizes. To address this, we present TIDE, an RL training system that preserves on-policy training semantics while recovering resource utilization. TIDE does so by two complementary techniques: (1) dynamically repurposing rollout GPUs for training while long-tail rollouts complete and (2) dynamically migrating rollouts between inference engines to boost decoding throughput. TIDE automatically determines the right time to repurpose rollout resources through an adaptive migration policy, obtaining performance improvements that generalize across multiple applications and hardware configurations without requiring bespoke configuration. In our evaluation, TIDE provides end-to-end speedups of up to 1.36x over colocated systems, outperforming all evaluated on-policy baselines and achieving up to 97% of optimal throughput.

translation.title: TIDE：找回在策略强化学习中损失的性能
translation.abstract: 目前大语言模型（LLM）的同步、同置RL后训练由于长尾rollout而严重利用不足。推理引擎在等待长尾rollout时闲置，或以低效的小批量解码。为此，我们提出TIDE，一个在保持在策略训练语义的同时恢复资源利用率的RL训练系统。TIDE通过两种互补技术实现：（1）在长尾rollout完成期间将rollout GPU动态转用于训练；（2）在推理引擎之间动态迁移rollout以提升解码吞吐量。TIDE通过自适应迁移策略自动确定转用rollout资源的恰当时机，获得的性能提升可泛化到多种应用和硬件配置，无需专门配置。在我们的评估中，TIDE相比同置系统提供了高达1.36倍的端到端加速，优于所有评估的在策略基线，并达到最优吞吐量的97%。
translation.brief: 提出RL训练系统TIDE，通过动态转用rollout GPU和迁移rollout来消除长尾rollout造成的资源闲置。

papers.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
papers.abstract: Scientific literature search can benefit from locally deployed LLM assistants, which reduce reliance on hosted model providers while giving research teams greater control over their data and infrastructure. This work investigates whether open-weight models can support web-assisted paper retrieval under practical computing constraints. We first characterize inference latency as the input context grows from 512 to 128k tokens on a Mac Studio and a server equipped with two NVIDIA A100 GPUs. We then evaluate eight models on the retrieval of 70 papers from seven scientific repositories, using queries that represent three levels of domain knowledge. The results show that retrieval success depends strongly on the selected model and the specificity of the query. And that A100 GPUs are generally faster than the Mac Studio, but its unified memory allows larger models that could not be loaded in the tested GPU configuration.

translation.title: 评估大语言模型在科学论文检索中的表现：Mac Studio与NVIDIA A100上的检索成功率与推理延迟
translation.abstract: 科学文献检索可以受益于本地部署的LLM助手，这减少了对托管模型提供商的依赖，同时让研究团队对数据和基础设施拥有更大控制权。本研究探讨开源权重模型能否在现实计算约束下支持网络辅助的论文检索。我们首先在Mac Studio和一台配备两块NVIDIA A100 GPU的服务器上，表征输入上下文从512到128k token增长时的推理延迟。然后我们评估八个模型在七个科学存储库中检索70篇论文的表现，查询代表三个层次的领域知识。结果表明检索成功率强烈依赖于所选模型和查询的具体性；A100 GPU通常比Mac Studio更快，但其统一内存可以加载在测试的GPU配置中无法加载的更大模型。
translation.brief: 在Mac Studio与A100上评测八个开源LLM的推理延迟与科学论文检索成功率。

papers.title: MineralExp: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Experimental Design in Real-World Mineral Exploration
papers.abstract: In mineral exploration, verifying geological hypotheses relies on designing a variety of geochemical experiments. While large language model (LLM) agents increasingly automate downstream geoscientific data analysis, a crucial upstream capability remains largely unexplored: automated geochemical experimental design, i.e., deciding which experiments to conduct before committing to costly laboratory work. Evaluating this capability of LLM agents is difficult for two reasons. First, geochemical experiments exhibit high methodological diversity and subjectivity: to test the same hypothesis, different geologists may choose different minerals and instruments, so no single protocol can serve as the reference answer. Second, open-ended experimental plans resist representation as structured labels, which makes objective scoring difficult. To address these challenges, we introduce MineralExp, a benchmark that reformulates geochemical experimental design as a hypothesis-based experiment selection problem, i.e., a multi-label classification problem. We abstract concrete instrument names and procedural details into a shared taxonomy of 19 experimental types across five mineral-system processes: Source, Transport, Deposition, Modification, and Preservation. This taxonomy yields deterministic multi-label targets while accommodating diverse experimental protocols. Constructed from published ore-deposit literature and verified by domain experts, MineralExp comprises 277 cases and 1,572 reference experimental plans. Given a geological hypothesis and initial context, an LLM agent selects the relevant tasks and generates concrete experimental plans, which are scored by multi-label classification metrics and an LLM-as-a-Judge metric. The experimental results show that current agents generally achieve high recall but low precision, tending to propose more experiments than are necessary to test the hypothesis.

translation.title: MineralExp：面向真实矿产勘探中实验设计的LLM智能体基准
translation.abstract: 在矿产勘探中，验证地质假设依赖于设计多样化的地球化学实验。虽然大语言模型（LLM）智能体日益自动化下游的地球科学数据分析，但一个关键的上游能力仍鲜有探索：自动化地球化学实验设计，即在投入昂贵的实验室工作之前决定进行哪些实验。评估LLM智能体的这一能力面临两个困难。首先，地球化学实验具有高度的方法多样性和主观性：为检验同一假设，不同地质学家可能选择不同的矿物和仪器，因此没有单一方案可作为参考答案。其次，开放式的实验方案难以表示为结构化标签，使客观评分困难。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MineralExp，一个将地球化学实验设计重新表述为基于假设的实验选择问题（即多标签分类问题）的基准。我们将具体的仪器名称和流程细节抽象为涵盖五个矿物系统过程（源区、运移、沉积、改造和保存）的19种实验类型的共享分类体系。该分类体系在容纳多样实验方案的同时产生确定性的多标签目标。MineralExp基于已发表的矿床文献构建并经领域专家验证，包含277个案例和1,572个参考实验方案。给定地质假设和初始上下文，LLM智能体选择相关任务并生成具体实验方案，通过多标签分类指标和LLM-as-a-Judge指标进行评分。实验结果表明，当前智能体普遍达到高召回率但低精确率，倾向于提出多于检验假设所需的实验。
translation.brief: 提出MineralExp基准，将地球化学实验设计转化为基于19类实验分类体系的多标签分类任务来评估LLM智能体。

papers.title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
papers.abstract: In many long-horizon settings, an agent's own choices create future constraints: committing finite capacity establishes future obligations and forecloses later opportunities. Sustaining performance therefore requires both keeping evolving plans feasible and comparing the value of resource allocations with the alternatives they displace. Recent benchmarks increasingly evaluate LLM agents in continuing operations, but give less attention to how agents keep their own commitments feasible while reassessing resource allocations as opportunities change. We introduce OutfitterBench, where agents manage an outdoor-equipment rental business for 200 days, purchasing from a 46-product catalog and handling roughly 1,100 reservation requests. Under a fixed capital ceiling, reservations and uncertain walk-in demand compete for reusable equipment whose availability changes over time. Experiments with seven frontier LLMs show that several agents underperform a simple rule-based baseline, while only the leading agent consistently surpasses it. Trajectory analysis shows that some agents apply known constraints inconsistently and make new decisions that conflict with existing commitments. Agents with more reliable fulfillment can still secure low returns from comparable commitments or delay resource reallocation. The leading agent better connects preparation with economic choices but also misses opportunities for more profitable asset use. These findings highlight limitations in sustaining coherent resource plans and reassessing their value over time. The benchmark code is publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: OutfitterBench：评估 LLM 智能体在长时程资源分配与承诺协调上的能力
translation.abstract: 在许多长时程场景中，智能体自身的选择会形成未来的约束：承诺有限容量会建立未来的义务并排除后续机会。因此，持续保持性能既需要让不断演进的计划保持可行，又需要在机会变化时比较资源分配的价值与其所放弃的替代方案的价值。近期的基准越来越多地评估 LLM 智能体在持续运营中的表现，但对智能体如何在机会变化时重新评估资源分配的同时保持自身承诺的可行性关注较少。我们提出 OutfitterBench，其中智能体管理一家户外装备租赁业务200天，从46种产品的目录中采购并处理约1100个预订请求。在固定资金上限下，预订和不确定的上门客流需求竞争使用可用性随时间变化的可复用装备。对七个前沿 LLM 的实验表明，若干智能体的表现低于一个简单的规则基线，只有领先智能体稳定超过它。轨迹分析显示，一些智能体对已知约束的应用不一致，并做出与现有承诺冲突的新决策。履约更可靠的智能体仍可能从可比承诺中获得低回报，或延迟资源重新分配。领先智能体能更好地将准备与经济选择相联系，但也会错失更有利可图的资产使用机会。这些发现凸显了在维持一致的资源计划并随时间重估其价值方面的局限。基准代码已在 this https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 OutfitterBench 基准，用200天户外装备租赁模拟评估 LLM 智能体在资源承诺可行性与分配价值重估上的协调能力。

papers.title: Can You Trust Your Finance Agent? Drift, Diagnosis and Auditable Intervention on One Shipped Financial Research Agent
papers.abstract: Can you trust a finance agent you did not build? We take the reference agent shipped with the Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2, leave it untuned, and ask four questions a leaderboard score does not answer. Is the score stable? Seven identical runs on 18 questions pass between 105 and 123 of 149 rubric criteria, and the bill varies by up to 17%. When the agent fails, who owns the fix? We classify 20 failed trajectories, from three runs of nine held-out questions, by the layer whose owner would remedy them, under a taxonomy frozen in advance: 13 belong to the agent's instructions, 3 to its tools, 4 to the model, none to its data. Can that diagnosis be trusted? Four blind readers from three model families, given only the traces, name the same fault as our LLM analyzer in 94% of cases, the rate at which they agree with one another (93%). Can a change be trusted? An optimization loop reads the traces, makes one targeted change per round and keeps it only if it clears a fixed threshold. Under a cost objective its final configuration costs 0.34x the baseline on the held-out questions (95% CI [0.22, 0.58]) at accuracy within noise. Under an accuracy objective it gains 14 points on the development questions and 1.5 on the held-out ones (CI [-5.3, +7.2]). Judged against the measured run-to-run noise, under a rule written before the test was opened, the first is a real saving and the second is not. This is a case study of one agent and nine test questions, not a general result.

translation.title: 你能信任你的金融智能体吗？对一个已上线金融研究智能体的漂移、诊断与可审计干预
translation.abstract: 你能信任一个不是你构建的金融智能体吗？我们取 Vals Finance Agent Benchmark v2 附带的参考智能体，不做调优，并回答排行榜分数无法回答的四个问题。分数稳定吗？对18个问题的七次相同运行，149项评分标准中通过的项数在105到123之间波动，账单最多相差17%。智能体失败时，修复责任归谁？我们对来自九个保留问题三次运行的20条失败轨迹，按预先冻结的分类法归到应由其负责人修复的层级：13个归因于智能体的指令，3个归因于其工具，4个归因于模型，没有归因于数据的。这一诊断可信吗？来自三个模型家族的四位盲评者仅凭轨迹，与我们的 LLM 分析器在94%的案例中指认同一故障，接近他们相互一致的程度（93%）。修改可信吗？一个优化循环读取轨迹，每轮做一个针对性修改，且仅在超过固定阈值时保留。以成本为目标时，其最终配置在保留问题上的成本为基线的0.34倍（95% CI [0.22, 0.58]），准确率差异在噪声范围内。以准确率为目标时，它在开发问题上提升14分，在保留问题上提升1.5分（CI [-5.3, +7.2]）。以测得的运行间噪声为基准，并按测试开始前写定的规则判定，第一个是真实节省，第二个不是。这是对一个智能体和九个测试问题的案例研究，并非普遍性结论。
translation.brief: 该论文对一个已上线金融研究智能体进行审计式案例研究，通过轨迹分类、盲评验证与阈值化优化循环来诊断失败归属并降低成本。

papers.title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
papers.abstract: Web agents powered by large language and vision-language models are increasingly applied to realistic browser work that spans heterogeneous applications, multimodal content, and stateful workflows. However, existing reproducible web-agent benchmarks cover only a small number of web applications drawn from a few software categories, and restrict modality to text and vision. Live benchmarks broaden site coverage but sacrifice reproducibility, since pages and data drift between runs. Moreover, existing benchmarks do not meaningfully evaluate whether agents can understand and use audio and video content embedded within web tasks. To address these gaps, we introduce WebArena-Pro, a benchmark comprising 300 tasks across 20 self-hosted web applications in six domain categories, spanning distinct interface conventions, workflows, and data models. Across the evaluated agents, the best performance is achieved by both Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 at 62.3%, followed by OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro at 60.7%. The strongest GenericAgent configurations, Gemini 3.1 Pro omni and Gemma4 31B, both achieve 30.3%. Among reproducible, human-curated web agent benchmarks, WebArena-Pro provides the broadest application coverage and the most comprehensive multimodal support to date. The benchmark treats audio and video as core observations alongside text and vision, with dedicated actions for extracting information from each. WebArena-Pro runs each task in isolation and supports reproducible, parallel evaluation. Tasks are authored through a dedicated annotator interface, filtered by LLM-assisted triage, and finally validated by humans before release. Project page: this https URL

translation.title: WebArena-Pro：一个异构、多模态、可复现的 Web 智能体基准
translation.abstract: 由大语言模型和视觉语言模型驱动的 Web 智能体正被越来越多地应用于跨异构应用、多模态内容和有状态工作流的真实浏览器工作。然而，现有可复现的 Web 智能体基准只覆盖来自少数软件类别的少量 Web 应用，并将模态限制在文本和视觉。在线基准扩大了站点覆盖范围，但由于页面和数据在运行之间漂移而牺牲了可复现性。此外，现有基准没有实质性地评估智能体能否理解和使用嵌入在 Web 任务中的音频和视频内容。为填补这些空白，我们提出 WebArena-Pro，一个包含六个领域类别中20个自托管 Web 应用上的300个任务的基准，涵盖不同的界面约定、工作流和数据模型。在被评估的智能体中，Codex with GPT 6.1 Sol 和 Claude Code with Claude Opus 5.5 并列取得最佳成绩62.3%，其次是 OpenCode with Kimi 3.1 Pro 的60.7%。最强的 GenericAgent 配置 Gemini 3.1 Pro omni 和 Gemma4 31B 均达到30.3%。在可复现、人工策划的 Web 智能体基准中，WebArena-Pro 迄今提供了最广泛的应用覆盖和最全面的多模态支持。该基准将音频和视频与文本、视觉并列为核心观测，并配有专门的动作来从各自模态提取信息。WebArena-Pro 将每个任务隔离运行，并支持可复现的并行评估。任务通过专门的标注界面编写，经 LLM 辅助的分诊过滤，最后由人工验证后发布。项目页面：this https URL
translation.brief: 该论文构建 WebArena-Pro 基准，用20个自托管应用上的300个多模态（含音视频）任务，弥补现有可复现 Web 智能体基准覆盖窄、模态受限的问题。

papers.title: From Images to Grounded Edits: A Real-World Benchmark for Chinese Grammatical Error Correction in Handwritten Essays
papers.abstract: Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (CGEC) is typically formulated as a text-to-text problem. While suitable for digital texts, this formulation falls short in real-world K-12 education, where AI-assisted corrections are expected directly on essay images, which are primarily handwritten and exhibit many irregularities. To bridge this gap, we introduce Grounded Chinese Grammatical Error Correction (G-CGEC), an image-to-grounded-edit task requiring systems to predict both corrections and their positions on essay images. We propose G-CGEC-Eval, a benchmark comprising real-world images of K-12 Chinese essays with fine-grained annotations. For evaluation, we adapt IoU-based metrics from object detection and propose a more tolerant alternative based on center-distance matching. Using this benchmark, we evaluate open-source and proprietary vision-language models under a direct single-pass setting, as well as settings with auxiliary components (OCR and character grounding) coordinated via pipelining or agentic harnessing. Results show that even top-tier proprietary models perform surprisingly poorly in the single-pass setting, while pipelining and agentic harnessing yield meaningful improvements. Notably, an error-type-based multi-agent workflow achieves the best performance, establishing it as the strongest baseline for future G-CGEC research. Through ablations and fine-grained analysis, we find the task remains far from solved, with linguistic error discovery and character-level grounding as the primary bottlenecks. This underscores the need for models that better integrate visual perception with linguistic reasoning and visual grounding.

translation.title: 从图像到定位编辑：手写作文中文语法纠错的真实世界基准
translation.abstract: 中文语法纠错（CGEC）通常被表述为文本到文本的问题。这一表述适用于数字文本，但在真实世界的 K-12 教育中有所不足，那里期望 AI 辅助的批改直接作用于作文图像，而图像以手写为主并呈现大量不规则性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出定位式中文语法纠错（G-CGEC），一个图像到定位编辑的任务，要求系统在作文图像上同时预测修改内容及其位置。我们提出 G-CGEC-Eval 基准，包含 K-12 中文作文的真实图像及细粒度标注。在评估上，我们改编自目标检测的 IoU 类指标，并提出一种基于中心距离匹配的更宽容的替代方案。使用该基准，我们在直接单次推理设定下评估开源与专有视觉语言模型，以及在流水线或智能体框架协调下带辅助组件（OCR 和字符定位）的设定。结果表明，即使是顶级专有模型在单次推理设定下表现也出奇地差，而流水线与智能体框架带来显著改进。值得注意的是，基于错误类型的多智能体工作流取得最佳表现，成为未来 G-CGEC 研究的最强基线。通过消融和细粒度分析，我们发现该任务远未解决，语言错误发现和字符级定位是主要瓶颈。这凸显了对更好融合视觉感知、语言推理与视觉定位的模型的需求。
translation.brief: 该论文提出 G-CGEC 任务及 G-CGEC-Eval 基准，要求模型在手写作文图像上预测语法纠错及其位置，并以多智能体流水线作为最强基线。

papers.title: Algorithmic Opacity as a Principal-Agent Problem
papers.abstract: Concerns about gaming and trade secrecy, frequently invoked to justify algorithmic opacity, can also mask self-serving strategic behavior by decision-makers, who may prioritize private benefits over social welfare. We develop a principal-agent test for when algorithmic decision-making should trigger disclosure obligations even when concerns about gaming or trade secrecy exist. The test, which is anchored in decision quality, relies on two diagnostics that can be disclosed without enabling gaming or revealing trade secrets: the error profile (false positive and false negative rates, overall and for each group) and the distribution of decision outcomes across groups. These diagnostics make visible whether decision-makers align design and implementation with the public interest or instead use opacity to obscure bias, inefficiency, or strategic shirking. Strong disparities across social groups, and asymmetries in the distribution of decision errors across outcome types, should trigger rebuttable presumptions favoring further disclosure. Where ground-truth error rates are unavailable, outcome distributions across groups can support the same presumption, and a decision-maker's inability to produce an error profile is itself diagnostic. The test thus treats fairness metrics as triggers for further disclosure and extends to generative and agentic systems through analogous metrics. The framework informs differentiated disclosure regimes (staged, partial, mediated, or audience-segmented). Once such regimes are considered, the domain of justifiable algorithmic opacity is significantly narrower than commonly assumed: when gaming or trade secrecy risks are legitimate, actionable disclosures (such as training data characteristics and key system design parameters) ordinarily can be mandated without compromising innovation or enabling gaming, even for technically inscrutable algorithms.

translation.title: 作为委托-代理问题的算法不透明性
translation.abstract: 对被操纵（gaming）和商业秘密的担忧常被用来为算法不透明性辩护，但也可能掩盖决策者自利的策略性行为，他们可能将私人利益置于社会福利之上。我们提出一个委托-代理检验，用于判断在存在被操纵或商业秘密担忧的情况下，何时算法决策仍应触发披露义务。该检验以决策质量为锚点，依赖两项可在不助长操纵或不泄露商业秘密的前提下披露的诊断指标：错误特征（总体及各群体的假阳性率和假阴性率）以及决策结果在各群体间的分布。这些诊断指标能够揭示决策者是否使设计与实施符合公共利益，还是利用不透明性来掩盖偏见、低效或策略性怠工。社会群体间的显著差异以及决策错误在结果类型上分布的不对称，应触发有利于进一步披露的可反驳推定。在无法获得真值错误率的情况下，各群体间的结果分布也可支持同样的推定，而决策者无法给出错误特征本身就具有诊断意义。该检验因此将公平性指标视为触发进一步披露的机制，并通过类似指标扩展到生成式与智能体系统。该框架为差异化披露制度（分阶段、部分、中介化或受众分层）提供了依据。一旦考虑此类制度，可正当化的算法不透明性领域就比通常假设的窄得多：当被操纵或商业秘密风险确实存在时，可操作的披露（如训练数据特征和关键系统设计参数）通常可以被强制要求，而不会损害创新或助长操纵，即使对技术上难以解读的算法也是如此。
translation.brief: 该论文将算法不透明性建模为委托-代理问题，提出以错误特征和结果分布等可披露诊断指标作为触发进一步披露义务的检验框架。

papers.title: RecurIR: Learning When and How to Revise Restoration Policies via Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.abstract: Agent-based image restoration has achieved promising performance by coordinating restoration tools to handle heterogeneous and coupled degradations. However, existing agents often improve their decisions through accumulated successful and failed executions, without explicitly identifying the conditions under which learned restoration strategies remain effective. Consequently, changes in degradation severity, spatial coverage, or interactions may invalidate previous decisions, while providing limited guidance on how these decisions should be revised. In this paper, we propose \textbf{RecurIR}, a recursive self-improvement framework that enables restoration agents to learn when and how to revise their decision rules. Specifically, we introduce a policy-hypothesis discovery mechanism to identify testable, condition-dependent rules through matched tool executions. We then design a rule-falsification-driven task evolution mechanism to generate targeted degradation variations, examine the validity of learned rules, and identify their applicability boundaries. Based on the resulting evidence, we develop a change-conditioned policy revision mechanism that learns how variations in degradation conditions should modify tool selection, execution order, operation strength, and processing regions. We further incorporate independent verification to retain effective revisions and use the resulting feedback to guide subsequent hypothesis discovery and task evolution. Through this recursive process, RecurIR progressively refines its restoration policies as degradation conditions change. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

translation.title: RecurIR：通过递归式自我改进学习何时以及如何修订修复策略
translation.abstract: 基于Agent的图像修复通过协调修复工具来处理异构且相互耦合的退化，已取得可观的性能。然而，现有Agent通常通过积累成功与失败的执行记录来改进决策，并未显式识别所学修复策略在何种条件下仍然有效。因此，退化严重程度、空间覆盖范围或退化间相互作用的变化可能使先前决策失效，而对于如何修订这些决策却缺乏指导。本文提出RecurIR，一个递归式自我改进框架，使修复Agent能够学习何时以及如何修订其决策规则。具体而言，我们引入策略假设发现机制，通过匹配的工具执行识别可检验的、依赖条件的规则。随后我们设计基于规则证伪的任务演化机制，生成有针对性的退化变体，检验所学规则的有效性，并确定其适用边界。基于所得证据，我们开发条件变化的策略修订机制，学习退化条件的变化应如何修改工具选择、执行顺序、操作强度和处理区域。我们进一步引入独立验证以保留有效的修订，并利用反馈指导后续的假设发现与任务演化。通过这一递归过程，RecurIR随着退化条件的变化逐步精化其修复策略。大量实验证明了所提框架的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决修复Agent缺乏识别策略失效条件及修订决策的问题，提出RecurIR递归自我改进框架，通过假设发现、规则证伪和条件驱动的策略修订来学习何时及如何修订修复策略。

papers.title: RSSA: Robust Semantic and Spatial Aligner for Collaborative Perception
papers.abstract: V2X collaborative perception improves single-vehicle perception by aggregating multi-view features from collaborative agents. However, existing methods typically rely on simple spatial warping to align the collaborative features, which can cause semantic misalignment during fusion. Meanwhile, these deterministic warping-based methods are highly sensitive to the positional noises. In this paper, we propose a plug-in module called Robust Semantic and Spatial Aligner (RSSA), which performs semantic and probabilistic spatial transformations for robust feature alignment. Specifically, a Semantic Transformation (SemT) block modulates feature channels based on the observed relative pose to correct semantic inconsistencies. Subsequently, a Probabilistic Spatial Transformation (P-SpaT) block performs probabilistic warping by sampling from the Gaussian-modeled relative pose space. A Relative Transformation Augmentation (RT-Aug) strategy is further introduced to augment the relative poses and facilitate the training of the RSSA. Extensive experiments on both simulated and real-world datasets demonstrate that RSSA improves the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin under the configuration of both clean and noisy positions.

translation.title: RSSA：面向协同感知的鲁棒语义与空间对齐器
translation.abstract: V2X协同感知通过聚合来自协同Agent的多视角特征来提升单车感知能力。然而，现有方法通常依赖简单的空间变换来对齐协同特征，这在融合过程中会导致语义不对齐。同时，这些确定性的基于变换的方法对位置噪声高度敏感。本文提出一个即插即用模块——鲁棒语义与空间对齐器（RSSA），通过语义和概率性的空间变换实现鲁棒的特征对齐。具体而言，语义变换（SemT）模块基于观测到的相对位姿调制特征通道，以纠正语义不一致。随后，概率空间变换（P-SpaT）模块通过从高斯建模的相对位姿空间采样执行概率性变换。此外，引入相对变换增强（RT-Aug）策略来增强相对位姿并促进RSSA的训练。在模拟与真实数据集上的大量实验表明，RSSA在干净和带噪声位姿两种配置下都大幅提升了现有最先进方法的性能。
translation.brief: 解决协同感知中简单空间变换导致语义不对齐且对位姿噪声敏感的问题，提出RSSA即插即用模块，结合语义变换与概率性空间变换实现鲁棒特征对齐。

papers.title: Beyond Bot Labels: Retrospective Consequence-Grounded Ranking of Attributed Cache Harm in E-Commerce Logs
papers.abstract: Web caches reduce origin load and latency, but automated traffic can either warm them or evict objects shoppers reuse, lowering the cache hit ratio (CHR). Existing bot defenses generally infer automation from User-Agent (UA) strings or behavior rather than identify sessions that impose cross-session cache harm. We instead formulate the task as ranking sessions by eviction damage and propose consequence-grounded session ranking. A single chronological replay attributes each eviction-induced miss by a protected shopping session (a victim) to the session whose insertion last evicted the object. A behavioral model predicts the target from session behavior alone. Selected sessions bypass the cache but remain origin-served. In a controlled check of 539 non-victim sessions selected across harm levels, attribution order tracks victim-hit changes after removal (Spearman correlation 0.80). On a 12.7-million-request real trace, the top 1% of sessions carry 48.8% of attributed harm. Sessions without bot tags contribute 49.1% of this tier's harm. At the 20% request-volume target, the default conditional CHR difference reaches 93% of the UA baseline, which selects 47 times as many sessions. Six training seeds show little variation. This comparison conditions on the victims that remain, so we also report victim bypass. Local replay and retraining on a second store reproduce harm concentration and a top tier dominated by sessions without bot tags. These results establish attributed cross-session harm as an outcome-based target for retrospective cache audits and selective intervention design.

translation.title: 超越机器人标签：电商日志中基于后果归因的缓存危害回溯性排序
translation.abstract: Web缓存可降低源站负载与延迟，但自动化流量既可能为其预热，也可能驱逐购物者会复用的对象，从而降低缓存命中率（CHR）。现有机器人防御通常通过User-Agent（UA）字符串或行为来推断自动化，而非识别造成跨会话缓存危害的会话。我们转而将任务形式化为按驱逐危害对会话排序，并提出基于后果的会话排序。通过单次按时间顺序的回放，将受保护购物会话（受害会话）每次因驱逐导致的未命中归因到最后一次插入并驱逐该对象的会话。行为模型仅依据会话行为预测目标。被选中的会话绕过缓存但仍由源站提供服务。在一项对跨危害等级选出的539个非受害会话的受控检查中，归因排序与移除后受害命中变化相吻合（Spearman相关系数0.80）。在一个包含1270万请求的真实轨迹上，排名前1%的会话承担了48.8%的归因危害，其中没有机器人标签的会话贡献了该层级49.1%的危害。在20%请求量目标下，默认条件CHR差异达到UA基线的93%，而UA基线选择的会话数量是前者的47倍。六个训练种子显示结果变化很小。由于该比较以剩余受害会话为条件，我们还报告了受害会话绕过方案。在第二家商店上的本地回放与再训练复现了危害集中现象以及由无机器人标签会话主导的顶级层级。这些结果确立了归因的跨会话危害作为面向后果的目标，可用于回溯性缓存审计与选择性干预设计。
translation.brief: 解决传统基于UA或行为的机器人识别无法发现造成跨会话缓存危害会话的问题，提出基于驱逐后果的会话归因与排序方法，实现选择性缓存干预。

papers.title: PerfArena: Ranking LLMs by Code Performance
papers.abstract: Industry now relies on LLMs to write a large share of production code. Although that code is mostly, but not always, correct, correctness alone does not determine whether it is fit for repeated and extensive use, which depends on what the code costs in time, memory and energy. Most code-generation benchmarks nonetheless evaluate correctness in isolation, and most performance-oriented benchmarks cover few languages and rarely measure energy consumption. To address this gap, we present PERFARENA, an open-source, reproducible arena that ranks LLMs by the performance of their generated code across multiple languages and competitions. PERFARENA executes the solutions of each LLM on a Unix-like host and reports correctness together with latency, peak memory, and energy consumption. Correctness oracles, performance oracles, profilers, and code-generation workflows are pluggable in PERFARENA, enabling the integration of new judging backends and measurement tools without changing the pipeline. We evaluate PERFARENA on two competitions: CLBGComp, 10 compute-intensive benchmarks from the Computer Language Benchmarks Game, and LeetCodeComp, 99 LeetCode problems whose accepted solutions differ measurably in latency. Currently, PERFARENA holds 9,455 correct and measured solutions from 13 state-of-the-art LLMs across 7 programming languages. Across both competitions, got-6-astra is the only LLM that no other LLM beats significantly in latency, energy consumption, or peak memory, solving 99.7% of LeetCodeComp and 100% of CLBGComp. All PERFARENA leaderboards and measured solutions are publicly available, providing a continuously updated reference that helps developers choose an LLM per language and metric, instead of relying only on correctness rates or pricing.

translation.title: PerfArena：按代码性能对LLM进行排序
translation.abstract: 工业界如今依赖LLM编写很大一部分生产代码。尽管这些代码大多（但并非总是）正确，但仅凭正确性并不能决定其是否适合被反复且大量使用，这还取决于代码在时间、内存和能耗上的开销。然而，多数代码生成基准只孤立地评估正确性，而多数面向性能的基准覆盖的语言很少且很少测量能耗。为填补这一空白，我们提出PERFARENA，一个开源、可复现的竞技场，按LLM所生成代码在多种语言和多项竞赛中的性能对其进行排序。PERFARENA在类Unix主机上运行每个LLM的解决方案，并报告正确性以及延迟、峰值内存和能耗。正确性判据、性能判据、分析器和代码生成工作流在PERFARENA中均可插拔，使得无需更改流水线即可集成新的评测后端和测量工具。我们在两项竞赛上评估PERFARENA：CLBGComp（来自Computer Language Benchmarks Game的10个计算密集型基准）和LeetCodeComp（99道LeetCode题目，其通过解在延迟上存在可测差异）。目前，PERFARENA收录了来自13个最先进LLM、涵盖7种编程语言的9,455个正确且经过测量的解决方案。在两项竞赛中，got-6-astra是唯一没有在其他LLM的延迟、能耗或峰值内存上被显著超越的LLM，其解决了99.7%的LeetCodeComp题目和100%的CLBGComp题目。所有PERFARENA排行榜和测量结果均公开可用，提供了一个持续更新的参考，帮助开发者按语言和指标选择LLM，而不仅依赖正确率或价格。
translation.brief: 解决现有代码生成基准只评正确性而忽视时间、内存和能耗的问题，构建可插拔、开源的PerfArena竞技场，按多语言代码运行性能对LLM进行排序。

papers.title: From institutional journalism to political extremes: Structural asymmetries in YouTube's news recommender during the 2022 French presidential campaign
papers.abstract: Debate has intensified over how algorithmic recommendations shape news visibility, particularly regarding structural and ideological bias. This study examines YouTube's News Recommender System (NRS) in the French ``News'' section, using a large-scale audit based on automated browsing agents operating under cold-start conditions, without prior viewing history, to isolate the algorithm's structural baseline independently of user preferences. Our results reveal that YouTube's NRS operates within a structurally asymmetric visibility regime: even in the absence of prior user behaviour, recommendation outputs disproportionately privilege platform-native creators and politically engaged content over established journalism. Television channels retain some relative advantage, but institutional news outlets, particularly press and radio, are systematically marginalised across recommendation sequences. Among political content, figures affiliated with far-left and far-right movements occupy a disproportionately visible position in recommendation outputs. Rather than correcting this asymmetry, continuity effects reproduce and stabilise it across recommendation sequences. These results show that visibility in YouTube's News section cannot be reduced to accumulated user preferences alone, but is also shaped by a structural bias embedded in the platform's recommendation system, which plays an important role in sustaining the prominence of political actors affiliated with the far left and far right.

translation.title: 从机构化新闻到政治极端：2022年法国总统竞选期间YouTube新闻推荐系统的结构性不对称
translation.abstract: 关于算法推荐如何塑造新闻可见性的争论日益激烈，尤其是结构性偏差和意识形态偏差方面。本研究考察YouTube“新闻”栏目中的新闻推荐系统（NRS），采用基于自动化浏览Agent的大规模审计方法，在无先前观看历史的冷启动条件下运行，从而在不受用户偏好影响的情况下分离算法的结构性基线。我们的结果表明，YouTube的NRS运行在一个结构性不对称的可见性体制之中：即使不存在先前的用户行为，推荐输出也不成比例地偏向平台原生创作者和政治性内容，而非成熟的新闻机构。电视频道保持了一定的相对优势，但机构化新闻媒体，尤其是报纸和广播，在整个推荐序列中被系统性地边缘化。在政治内容中，与极左和极右运动有关联的人物在推荐输出中占据了不成比例的显著位置。延续效应非但没有纠正这种不对称，反而在推荐序列中将其复制并固化。这些结果表明，YouTube新闻栏目的可见性不能仅仅归结为用户偏好的积累，还受到平台推荐系统中根植的结构性偏差的塑造，该偏差在维持极左和极右政治人物突出地位方面发挥了重要作用。
translation.brief: 研究冷启动条件下YouTube新闻推荐是否存在结构性偏差，通过自动化浏览Agent大规模审计发现其系统性偏向平台创作者与极左极右政治内容而边缘化机构新闻媒体。

papers.title: C-to-Rust Translation Validation at the LLVM IR Level via AI-Assisted Refinement Proof
papers.abstract: Migrating C codebases to Rust is a promising approach to securing legacy software, but existing translators do not guarantee that a translated Rust program preserves the behavior of the C program. Neither rule-based nor large language model (LLM)-based translators have been formally verified, and existing approaches to checking translation correctness are limited to testing and bounded checks, which cannot reason about all possible executions. In this work, we present R2C2, which validates C-to-Rust translation by proving in Rocq that the Rust program refines the C program, i.e., every behavior on the Rust side is also a behavior on the C side. Since no formal semantics defines the behaviors of C and Rust programs in the same terms, we prove refinement between the two programs compiled to the LLVM intermediate representation (LLVM IR). In addition, to resolve the discrepancies between the data representations of C and Rust, we introduce a common abstraction that relates two corresponding representations through an abstract value, and specify the behavior of each library function over abstract values. We construct the refinement proof as a chain of refinement relations, where only one relation is program-specific and proved at validation time, while the others are proved for all programs in advance. Proof construction is automated by AI agents, and since Rocq checks the proofs, the agents need not be trusted. We evaluate R2C2 on LLM translations of 519 C programs drawn from a benchmark suite used in prior work on C-to-Rust translation validation. R2C2 proves the translations of 486 programs correct without bounding their executions and discovers three incorrect translations, providing valid counterexamples that existing translation validation tools cannot find. We also conduct a case study on a small real-world image compression library and demonstrate how R2C2 can handle file operations.

translation.title: 基于AI辅助精化证明的LLVM IR层级C到Rust翻译验证
translation.abstract: 将C代码库迁移到Rust是保障遗留软件安全的有前景的方法，但现有的翻译器无法保证翻译后的Rust程序保持C程序的行为。无论是基于规则还是基于大语言模型（LLM）的翻译器都未经形式化验证，而现有的翻译正确性检查方法仅限于测试和有界检查，无法对所有可能的执行进行推理。在本工作中，我们提出R2C2，通过在Rocq中证明Rust程序精化（refines）C程序来验证C到Rust的翻译，即Rust侧的每个行为也是C侧行为的一个行为。由于没有形式化语义以相同的术语定义C和Rust程序的行为，我们在这两个程序编译到LLVM中间表示（LLVM IR）之后证明二者之间的精化关系。此外，为了解决C和Rust数据表示之间的差异，我们引入了一种共同抽象，通过抽象值关联两个对应的表示，并规范每个库函数在抽象值上的行为。我们将精化证明构建为一条精化关系链，其中只有一条关系是程序特定的并在验证时证明，而其他关系则预先对所有程序证明。证明构建由AI代理自动化完成，且由于Rocq会检查这些证明，因此无需信任这些代理。我们在来自先前C到Rust翻译验证工作所用基准套件的519个C程序的LLM翻译上评估了R2C2。R2C2在不限制执行的情况下证明了486个程序的翻译是正确的，并发现了三个不正确的翻译，提供了现有翻译验证工具无法找到的有效反例。我们还对一个小的真实世界图像压缩库进行了案例研究，展示了R2C2如何处理文件操作。
translation.brief: 该论文解决C到Rust翻译行为保持性验证问题，核心方法是在LLVM IR层面用Rocq证明Rust程序对C程序的精化关系，并由AI代理自动化构造证明。

papers.title: FEND: Far-End Detection in Outbound Voice AI Calls
papers.abstract: When a conversational Voice AI agent places an outbound call, the far end may be a live person, a voicemail greeting, an interactive voice response (IVR) system, or increasingly another AI system answering on the callee's behalf. Standard Answering Machine Detection (AMD) reports only whether a human or a machine picked up, a design meant for human call centres, where one machine is as uninteresting as another. That single bit does not tell a Voice AI agent what to do, since leaving a voicemail message, navigating an IVR and holding a short exchange with another AI are three different actions and a two-valued label cannot distinguish them. In 1,000 randomly sampled calls from our own outbound deployment, a live person answered 48.1%, a voicemail system 44.6%, an AI 6.9% and an IVR 0.4%. Our proposed framework, FEND, reads the far end's audio and its streaming transcript and runs one detector for each automated class (voicemail, IVR, AI callee), with human the default when nothing fires, returning a single label within 20 seconds. On a public benchmark the voicemail components reach 100% accuracy without ever misclassifying a live human, where Asterisk's AMD misclassifies 30 to 66% of them. For the AI callee, acoustic features do not transfer across recording conditions, but speech timing does, separating AI from human at 0.952 ROC-AUC, because synthesised speech leaves far shorter gaps between words. On production traffic, separating a live person from any automated far end reaches F1 0.979, and only 2.9% of live people are given an automated label, the error that matters most for an agent acting on the result.

translation.title: FEND：外呼语音AI通话中的远端检测
translation.abstract: 当对话式语音AI代理发起外呼时，远端可能是真人、语音信箱问候语、交互式语音应答（IVR）系统，或者日益增多的由另一个AI系统代表被叫方接听。标准的应答机检测（AMD）只报告接听的是人还是机器，这一设计面向人工呼叫中心，在那里机器之间没有区别。这一个比特的信息无法告诉语音AI代理该做什么，因为留下语音信箱留言、导航IVR以及与另一个AI进行简短对话是三种不同的操作，二值标签无法区分它们。在我们自己的外呼部署中随机抽样的1,000通电话中，48.1%由真人接听，44.6%是语音信箱系统，6.9%是AI，0.4%是IVR。我们提出的框架FEND读取远端的音频和流式转录文本，并为每个自动化类别（语音信箱、IVR、AI被叫方）运行一个检测器，当没有任何检测器触发时默认为真人，在20秒内返回单一标签。在一个公开基准上，语音信箱组件达到100%准确率且从未将真人误分类，而Asterisk的AMD会将30%到66%的真人误分类。对于AI被叫方，声学特征无法跨录音条件迁移，但语音时序特征可以，因为合成语音的词间间隙远短于人类，以此区分AI与真人的ROC-AUC达到0.952。在生产流量上，区分真人与任何自动化远端的F1达到0.979，且只有2.9%的真人被赋予自动化标签，而对于基于结果行动的代理而言，这是最关键的错误。
translation.brief: 该论文解决语音AI外呼中区分真人、语音信箱、IVR和AI被叫方的问题，核心方法是基于音频和流式转录为每个自动化类别分别运行专用检测器。

papers.title: A$^3$: Adaptive Audio Agent Framework for Collaborative Edge Computing
papers.abstract: Embedded audio agents need a nearby edge server for speed, but a server-dependent agent returns nothing when the link fails. We present A$^3$, an adaptive audio agent framework that places whole pipeline stages on the server, keeps a complete fallback agent on devices that can host one, and hedges both paths with a link-aware deadline that decides when to give up on the server. On Jetson devices and an RTX A4500 server, A$^3$ matches the server-only agent on a healthy link, answers every request in a full outage on the AGX, and beats a percentile hedge in simulated outages.

translation.title: A$^3$：面向协同边缘计算的自适应音频代理框架
translation.abstract: 嵌入式音频代理需要邻近的边缘服务器来保证速度，但依赖服务器的代理在链路故障时无法返回任何结果。我们提出A$^3$，这是一个自适应音频代理框架，它将整个流水线阶段放在服务器上，在能够承载完整代理的设备上保留完整的回退代理，并通过链路感知的截止时间对两条路径进行对冲，以决定何时放弃服务器。在Jetson设备和一台RTX A4500服务器上，A$^3$在链路正常时与纯服务器代理的表现相当，在AGX上完全断链时仍能响应所有请求，并在模拟断链场景中优于百分位对冲方法。
translation.brief: 该论文解决边缘音频代理在链路故障时失效的问题，核心方法是服务器/设备双路径部署并用链路感知的截止时间进行对冲决策。

papers.title: Agent-as-a-Judge
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence has progressed from task-specific systems toward general models spanning perception, generation, reasoning, and autonomous interaction, making reliable evaluation essential for comparison, deployment, and post-training feedback. At scale, modern evaluation pipelines increasingly rely on LLM-as-a-Judge to produce scores, preferences, and critiques; in its fixed-context setting, the judge relies on the supplied evaluand and evaluation materials. Yet a reliable verdict may require evidence beyond the supplied evaluand and context---either because critical environmental states remain unrecorded in the static execution log, or because controversial factual claims require external verification. Passive judges cannot obtain that missing evidence before deciding, especially when evaluating agent trajectories, executable artifacts, or domain-specific reports. Recent work therefore develops active evaluators that seek missing evidence and update their grounds for judgment before deciding. We bring these advances together through Agent-as-a-Judge, focusing on how evaluators construct and control checking processes within the broader LLM-based judging landscape. We define the scope through evaluation-directed checks and the use of their results, covering both structured workflows and observation-driven control. We organize the design space by multi-agent collaboration, tool integration, memory, and planning, and show how these mechanisms supply the checks and evidence on which a verdict rests. We consolidate published scores and reproduce missing entries for key agentic judges; the comparison reveals uneven agentic gains and motivates dedicated agentic evaluation. We conclude by characterizing application demands and open challenges in cost, reliability, safety, and governance that condition trusted deployment of agentic judges at scale.

translation.title: Agent-as-a-Judge
translation.abstract: 人工智能已从任务特定系统发展到涵盖感知、生成、推理和自主交互的通用模型，使得可靠评估对于比较、部署和后训练反馈至关重要。在大规模场景下，现代评估流程日益依赖LLM-as-a-Judge来产生分数、偏好和评论；在其固定上下文设置中，评审者依赖于所提供的被评估对象和评估材料。然而，可靠的判定可能需要超出所提供的被评估对象和上下文的证据——或者因为关键的环境状态未被记录在静态执行日志中，或者因为争议性的事实性主张需要外部验证。被动评审者在做出决定之前无法获取缺失的证据，尤其是在评估代理轨迹、可执行工件或领域特定报告时。因此，近期工作发展出主动评估器，它们在决定之前寻找缺失证据并更新判定依据。我们通过Agent-as-a-Judge将这些进展汇聚起来，重点关注评估器如何在更广泛的基于LLM的评审格局中构建和控制检查过程。我们通过面向评估的检查及其结果的使用来界定研究范围，涵盖结构化工作流和观察驱动的控制。我们按多代理协作、工具集成、记忆和规划来组织设计空间，并展示这些机制如何为判定提供所需的检查和证据。我们整合了已发表的分数并复现了关键代理评审者缺失的条目；比较揭示了代理化收益的不均衡，并促使了专门的代理化评估。最后，我们刻画了应用需求以及在成本、可靠性、安全性和治理方面的开放挑战，这些因素决定了代理评审者能否获得规模化可信部署。
translation.brief: 该论文综述Agent-as-a-Judge，即通过主动执行检查、获取缺失证据来提升基于LLM评审可靠性的评估器，并系统组织其设计空间。

papers.title: TelePhysica: Agentic Reconstruction of Physically Interactive Scenes
papers.abstract: Direct image-to-video diffusion models entangle pixel synthesis with implicit latent motion, precluding persistent 3D mechanical equilibrium, mid-rollout intervention, and counterfactual force control. Conversely, single-pass programmatic 3D reconstruction from an uncalibrated photograph leaves monocular depth and support clearance underconstrained, causing reconstructed scenes to interpenetrate or collapse under gravity. We present TelePhysica, a closed-loop framework that reconstructs an executable, multi-regime physical world from a single photograph to drive stateful 3D interaction and trajectory-grounded video synthesis. A vision-language coding agent synthesizes separable visual meshes and declarative physical models within a two-stage verification loop that pairs pixel-aligned silhouette critique with a zero-force gravitational equilibrium preflight. The verified world compiles into a unified solver coupling rigid bodies, articulated chains, co-dimensional cloth shells, and 3D tetrahedral elastodynamics, whose simulated rollouts condition pretrained video diffusion models through pixel-aligned structural streams. On a 100-scene single-image benchmark, closed-loop execution raises equilibrium-verified world recovery from $0\%$ in single-pass synthesis to $81\%$. Controlled constitutive ablations show over an order-of-magnitude larger localized corner displacement and out-of-plane pleating in finite-element cloth than in matched rigid-plate proxies. Conditioning video diffusion on simulated trajectories increases dynamic motion-mask overlap by $2{\times}\text{--}5{\times}$ and preserves motion direction under counterfactual force reversals where direct image-to-video models fail.

translation.title: TelePhysica：物理交互场景的智能体重构
translation.abstract: 直接的图像到视频扩散模型将像素合成与隐式潜在运动纠缠在一起，无法实现持久的3D力学平衡、 rollout过程中的干预以及反事实力控制。相反，从未标定照片进行的单次程序化3D重构使单目深度和支撑间隙欠约束，导致重构场景相互穿透或在重力作用下坍塌。我们提出TelePhysica，这是一个闭环框架，可从单张照片重构一个可执行的多模态物理世界，以驱动有状态的3D交互和基于轨迹的视频合成。一个视觉语言编码智能体在两阶段验证循环中合成可分离的视觉网格和声明式物理模型，该循环将像素对齐的轮廓评审与零力重力平衡预检相结合。经过验证的世界被编译为统一的求解器，耦合刚体、铰接链、共维布料壳和3D四面体弹性动力学，其模拟的rollout通过像素对齐的结构流来调节预训练的视频扩散模型。在一个包含100个场景的单图像基准上，闭环执行将经验证达到平衡的世界恢复率从单次合成的0%提升到81%。受控本构消融实验表明，有限元布料在局部角落位移和面外褶皱方面比匹配的刚性平板代理模型大一个数量级以上。用模拟轨迹调节视频扩散模型使动态运动掩码重叠度提升2倍到5倍，并在反事实力反转下保持运动方向，而直接的图像到视频模型则无法做到。
translation.brief: 该论文解决单张照片重构可执行物理交互场景的问题，核心方法是用视觉语言智能体驱动的闭环验证重构物理世界，再以模拟轨迹调节视频扩散模型。

papers.title: Distributed Output-Feedback Control for Linear Multichannel Systems
papers.abstract: This paper investigates distributed output-feedback stabilization of linear multichannel systems in which agents exchange state estimates without disclosing local control inputs or feedback gains. Remote control actions are treated as unknown inputs and geometrically decoupled from stable quotient-error dynamics. The proposed framework accommodates nontrivial intersections of local loss subspaces by retaining the coupling between the plant and common estimation errors. A Hurwitz condition on the coupled dynamics, together with a sufficient consensus-gain bound, guarantees exponential closed-loop convergence for every fixed feedback selection in a compact family. For polytopic feedback families, a quotient-preserving parameterization of output injections enables joint synthesis of nominal feedback and observer gains via alternating linear matrix inequalities, followed by a convex semidefinite program certifying a common consensus gain. A numerical example demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed design.

translation.title: 线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈控制
translation.abstract: 本文研究线性多通道系统的分布式输出反馈镇定问题，其中各智能体交换状态估计但不披露本地控制输入或反馈增益。远程控制动作被视为未知输入，并通过几何方法与稳定的商误差动态解耦。所提出的框架通过保留被控对象与公共估计误差之间的耦合，可处理本地损失子空间的非平凡交集。耦合动态的 Hurwitz 条件以及充分的一致性增益上界，保证了紧致反馈族中每个固定反馈选择下的指数闭环收敛。对于多面体反馈族，输出注入的保商参数化方法使得可通过交替线性矩阵不等式联合综合标称反馈和观测器增益，随后用凸半定规划认证公共一致性增益。数值算例验证了所提设计的有效性。
translation.brief: 解决不共享控制输入与增益的多通道分布式输出反馈镇定问题，核心方法是将远程控制视为未知输入进行几何解耦，并利用交替LMI与半定规划联合综合反馈和观测器增益。

papers.title: Deep Latents, Long Memory: Latent persistence explains temporal correlations in transformer activations
papers.abstract: The hidden layers of Large Language Models (LLMs) are believed to encode representations of the data whose abstraction increases with depth. However, in the absence of an operational notion of abstraction, this statement is hard to test quantitatively. Here, we propose an alternative view, building on the principle that the correlations of a sequence reflect the structure of the process that generated it. We define the autocorrelation function of a layer as the average dot product between its activations at two context positions separated by a lag. Latent variables encoded persistently along the context create slowly decaying tails in the autocorrelation, and we find these tails to grow across layers in both synthetic and natural data. In synthetic data with controlled hierarchical latent structure, this growth stems from the encoding of abstract latent variables, which govern long stretches of the input. Indeed, the persistence of latent codes predicts the qualitative structure of autocorrelations and accounts for most of the empirical measures. In real text, we take sparse-autoencoder features as proxies for latent variables, and find that their persistence correlates strongly with the magnitude of autocorrelations across datasets and LLMs. In particular, the persistence time increases with depth, as do autocorrelations, implying that deeper latent features persist for longer context spans. We complement this analysis by explicitly ablating the persistent sparse-autoencoder features and observing a consequent decrease in the autocorrelations.

translation.title: 深层潜变量，长时记忆：潜变量持续性解释Transformer激活中的时间相关性
translation.abstract: 人们普遍认为大语言模型（LLM）的隐藏层编码了随深度增加而抽象程度提高的数据表示。然而，由于缺乏可操作的抽象概念定义，这一说法难以定量检验。本文提出一种替代视角，基于如下原则：序列的相关性反映了生成该序列的过程的结构。我们将某一层的自相关函数定义为其在相隔一定滞后的两个上下文位置上激活之间的平均点积。沿上下文持续编码的潜变量会在自相关中产生缓慢衰减的尾部，我们发现这些尾部在合成数据和自然数据中均随层数加深而增长。在具有受控层级潜变量结构的合成数据中，这种增长源于对控制输入长片段的抽象潜变量的编码。事实上，潜变量编码的持续性可预测自相关的定性结构，并解释了大部分经验测量。在真实文本中，我们以稀疏自编码器特征作为潜变量的代理，发现其持续性与跨数据集和LLM的自相关幅值强相关。特别是，持续性时间随深度增加，自相关亦然，这意味着更深的潜特征在更长的上下文范围内持续存在。我们进一步通过显式消融持续存在的稀疏自编码器特征，观察到自相关随之下降，以此补充上述分析。
translation.brief: 研究LLM各层激活的时间相关性成因，核心方法是用层激活自相关度量潜变量持续性，并结合稀疏自编码器特征与消融实验揭示深层更抽象的潜特征持续更久。

papers.title: Do Machines Learn Deviance From Their Peers? A Randomized Test of Differential Association With AI Agents
papers.abstract: Differential association theory and its extension, social learning theory, hold that rule-breaking, and the definitions that make it acceptable, are learned through interaction with others. Because people choose their friends, this claim has been hard to test. We addressed this selection problem with AI agents, which learn only through communication and can be assigned to peers at random. In a preregistered experiment, 420 teams of three agents (1,260 agents; seven AI models) worked on coding tasks that could not be solved honestly. A scripted teammate said that it had cheated (deviant peer), that it had reported the problem honestly (honest peer), or said nothing (silent peer). Half of the teams were told that an auditor read their chat. Compared with a silent peer, a deviant peer increased cheating (66.2% vs. 62.9%; OR = 1.96) and an honest peer reduced it (55.7%; OR = 0.35). Among agents that cheated, a deviant peer increased claims that cheating was normal (13.7% vs. 3.4%), often as the team's norm. Monitoring did not suppress prohibited discussion; it doubled it. Peers mattered only for models that had not yet decided. AI agents offer a new way to test criminological learning theories without selection effects.

translation.title: 机器会从同伴那里学到越轨吗？与AI智能体差异交往的随机化实验
translation.abstract: 差异交往理论及其延伸的社会学习理论认为，违规行为以及使其显得可接受的概念是通过与他人互动习得的。由于人们会自主选择朋友，这一论断一直难以检验。我们利用AI智能体来解决这一选择偏差问题，因为AI智能体仅通过交流学习，且可被随机分配同伴。在一项预注册实验中，420个由三个智能体组成的团队（共1,260个智能体，涉及七个AI模型）执行无法诚实地完成的编程任务。一名脚本化的队友声称自己作弊了（越轨同伴）、诚实地报告了问题（诚实同伴），或什么也不说（沉默同伴）。一半团队被告知有审核员会阅读其聊天记录。与沉默同伴相比，越轨同伴增加了作弊行为（66.2% vs. 62.9%；OR = 1.96），而诚实同伴减少了作弊（55.7%；OR = 0.35）。在作弊的智能体中，越轨同伴增加了将作弊视为正常的主张（13.7% vs. 3.4%），且常将其作为团队规范。监督并未抑制违规讨论，反而使其翻倍。同伴仅对尚未做出决定的模型产生影响。AI智能体为检验犯罪学学习理论提供了一种无选择效应的新方法。
translation.brief: 解决差异交往理论因同伴自选择而难以检验的问题，核心方法是让可随机分配同伴的AI智能体团队接受越轨/诚实/沉默同伴与监督的预注册随机实验。

papers.title: Contagious Fingerprints: When LLMs Inherit Another Model's Identity
papers.abstract: The fingerprint by which a classifier recognizes the LLM behind a text is usually treated as a fixed property of the model. We show that it is contagious: a model that continues a conversation begun by another model inherits that model's fingerprint. This undermines audits of API relays, which can serve the first turns of a conversation with the model a customer pays for and silently hand the rest to a cheaper one. After such a handoff, detection of the substitute by a text classifier drops from 0.97 to 0.72 (DeepSeek replacing Claude Sonnet) and from 0.87 to 0.54 for a same-vendor downgrade (Haiku), and retraining on handoff data repairs only substitutes seen in training. Preregistered experiments trace the contagion to imitation of the history's style. History also moves a model away from its own fingerprint: active probes are not camouflaged, but when calibrated on fresh conversations they flag \emph{honest} models on long contexts at rates up to 1.00, and a standard MMD equality test rejects all nine models we test. Both failures come from comparing a history-dependent reply with a history-free reference. We propose \textsc{Lineup}, which samples references from the claimed model \emph{on the same history} and tests the audited reply by its rank among them. \textsc{Lineup} controls false positives by exchangeability and needs no fitted threshold or log-probabilities. With contemporaneous references on two closed models, its false-positive rate is 0.056 (preregistered bound 0.10), and it detects 0.81 of substitute sessions across six pairs after four audited turns.

translation.title: 会传染的指纹：当LLM继承另一个模型的身份
translation.abstract: 分类器用于识别文本背后LLM的指纹通常被视为模型的固定属性。我们证明它具有传染性：一个接续另一模型开启的对话的模型会继承该模型的指纹。这削弱了对API中转服务的审计，因为中转方可以用客户付费的模型提供对话的前几轮，然后悄悄将其余部分交给更便宜的模型。经过这种交接后，文本分类器对替代模型的检测率从0.97降至0.72（DeepSeek 替代 Claude Sonnet），同厂商降级（Haiku）时从0.87降至0.54，且在交接数据上重训只能修复训练中见过的替代模型。预注册实验将这种传染追溯到对历史对话风格的模仿。历史还会使模型偏离自身指纹：主动探测并未被伪装，但当以全新对话校准时，它们在长上下文上对诚实模型的误报率高达1.00，且标准MMD等价性检验拒绝了我们所测的全部九个模型。这两种失败都源于将依赖历史的回复与无历史的参照进行比较。我们提出 \textsc{Lineup}，它在相同历史条件下从声称的模型采样参照，并通过被审计回复在其中的排名进行检验。\textsc{Lineup} 通过可交换性控制假阳性，无需拟合阈值或对数概率。使用两个闭源模型的同期参照，其假阳性率为0.056（预注册上界0.10），在四次审计对话后，六对模型组合中可检测出0.81的替代会话。
translation.brief: 解决对话历史导致模型指纹互相传染、使API中转审计失效的问题，核心方法是提出 Lineup：在同一对话历史上从声称模型采样参照并按排名检验被审计回复。

papers.title: Interpretable weight-space programming builds transparent transformers and brain encoding models
papers.abstract: Neural networks are powerful predictors, yet their opacity limits their usefulness in science, where the goal is explanation rather than mere prediction. In neuroscience, for example, deep encoding models accurately predict brain activity in response to natural stimuli, but struggle to reveal which stimulus features drive those predictions. Here we introduce interpretable weight-space programming (iWSP), a method in which an LLM agent iteratively builds interpretable models by explicitly programming their weights and features in code, without gradient-based training (backpropagation). Without backpropagation to tune parameters, the agent must draw on its prior knowledge and reason over previous trials to hypothesize, hand-craft, and refine human-interpretable computations mirroring the workflow of a human scientist. LLM audits confirm the interpretability of the hand-crafted models. We first validate iWSP by tasking it with constructing transformers for canonical benchmarks such as arithmetic and sentiment classification, finding that LLM agents can successfully craft compact, accurate networks directly. Next, we apply iWSP to build neural encoding models across vision, language, and audition. In the visual cortex, iWSP outpredicts existing interpretable baselines, uncovers distinct computations across early/higher visual areas, and generalizes to unseen data. In language fMRI, iWSP surfaces a confound in the data and in auditory ECoG, it systematically discovers interpretable acoustic features that predict neural activity. Together, these results establish iWSP as a general paradigm for aligning high predictive performance with human-interpretable scientific discovery.

translation.title: 可解释的权重空间编程构建透明Transformer与大脑编码模型
translation.abstract: 神经网络是强大的预测器，但其不透明性限制了它在科学中的用处，因为科学的目标是解释而非仅仅是预测。例如在神经科学中，深度编码模型能准确预测大脑对自然刺激的响应活动，却难以揭示是哪些刺激特征驱动了这些预测。我们提出可解释权重空间编程（iWSP），该方法由LLM智能体通过直接以代码显式编程模型权重和特征来迭代构建可解释模型，而不使用基于梯度的训练（反向传播）。由于没有反向传播来调整参数，智能体必须借助其先验知识并对以往试验进行推理，以提出假设、手工构建并改进人类可解释的计算，这类似于人类科学家的工作流程。LLM审计证实了这些手工构建模型的可解释性。我们首先通过让iWSP构建算术、情感分类等经典基准上的Transformer来验证该方法，发现LLM智能体能够直接成功构建紧凑而准确的网络。接着，我们将iWSP应用于构建涵盖视觉、语言和听觉的神经编码模型。在视觉皮层，iWSP的预测优于现有的可解释基线，揭示了早期/高级视觉区域的不同计算，并能泛化到未见数据。在语言fMRI中，iWSP发现了数据中的混杂因素；在听觉ECoG中，它系统地发现了可预测神经活动的可解释声学特征。这些结果共同确立了iWSP作为将高预测性能与人类可解释的科学发现相结合的通用范式。
translation.brief: 解决深度模型缺乏可解释性、难以揭示驱动预测的机制的问题，核心方法是让LLM智能体无需反向传播、直接以代码编程权重与特征来迭代构建可解释模型并用于大脑编码建模。

papers.title: Evaluating Language Models as Spatial Priors for Object-Goal Navigation
papers.abstract: Semantic exploration methods for object-goal navigation use large language models (LLMs) to score how strongly a target object is associated with a room type or with a nearby object. This paper considers obtaining from the LLM a spatial prior instead: a distribution over the position of the target in a room. We evaluate whether two open-weight LLMs, Qwen3.5-27B and Gemma-4-31B-it, can provide such a prior. Using real room layouts from CubiCasa5K and ScanNet, we measure the likelihood the models assign to real and perturbed layouts, and the layouts they generate. The object frequencies and room sizes of the generated rooms follow the room type, but the proximity of the objects to the walls does not follow the differences between room types found in real rooms. The likelihood distinguishes real layouts from perturbed ones partly through their geometry and partly through the agreement between the coordinates and a field that states the wall each object touches; for the movable furniture of ScanNet, it is higher for layouts with all objects piled near the room center than for the real layouts in most rooms. When an object is given in the prompt, the models place a related object relative to it. When the wall of each object is given, they place most objects against that wall, but do not keep all objects inside a given room rectangle. As a prior for object search, the generated placements reduce the searched area relative to a uniform prior, but by less than a third of the reduction obtained with a prior built from real layouts, and by less than two thirds when both priors are spatially smoothed. These results support the use of LLMs for object-room associations and for writing coordinates under constraints determined by another component, followed by a geometric check, but not as a source of placement priors where real layouts are available.

translation.title: 将语言模型作为物体目标导航的空间先验进行评估
translation.abstract: 物体目标导航的语义探索方法使用大语言模型（LLM）来评估目标物体与房间类型或附近物体之间的关联强度。本文考虑从LLM获取一种空间先验：目标物体在房间内位置的分布。我们评估两个开放权重LLM，Qwen3.5-27B和Gemma-4-31B-it，能否提供这样的先验。使用来自CubiCasa5K和ScanNet的真实房间布局，我们测量模型对真实布局和扰动布局赋予的似然，以及它们生成的布局。生成房间的物体频率和房间大小遵循房间类型，但物体与墙壁的接近程度并不遵循真实房间中不同房间类型之间的差异。似然能够区分真实布局和扰动布局，部分依据是几何结构，部分依据是坐标与一个标明每个物体接触哪面墙的字段之间的一致性；对于ScanNet的可移动家具，在大多数房间中，所有物体堆在房间中心附近的布局比真实布局获得更高的似然。当提示中给出某个物体时，模型会相对于它放置相关物体。当给出每个物体的墙壁时，模型会把大多数物体靠墙放置，但不会将所有物体保持在给定的房间矩形内。作为物体搜索的先验，生成的放置方案相比均匀先验能减少搜索面积，但减少幅度不足基于真实布局构建的先验所得减少量的三分之一；当两个先验都经过空间平滑后，也不足其三分之二。这些结果支持将LLM用于物体-房间关联，以及在由其他组件确定的约束下书写坐标并随后进行几何检查，但在有真实布局可用时不适合作为放置先验的来源。
translation.brief: 该论文评估LLM能否为目标物体在房间内的位置提供空间先验，方法是测量模型对真实与扰动房间布局的似然并检验其生成布局作为搜索先验的效果。

papers.title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to finance, creating a need for benchmarks that evaluate their capabilities across financial systems with different regulations and practices. However, existing financial benchmarks provide limited coverage of country-specific financial systems, and they are difficult to keep up to date as released questions leak into training data. We introduce JFinBench, a Japanese financial benchmark comprising 321 examples from the 2026 editions of six regularly administered certification exams covering accounting, tax, financial planning, and banking. To construct it, we develop a human-in-the-loop agentic pipeline in which a coding agent writes exam-specific conversion code and a review page, while a human verifies every example and feeds corrections back to the agent. This pipeline adapts to heterogeneous exam formats and reduces the effort of incorporating new exam editions, enabling periodic refreshes that mitigate data contamination. Evaluating 12 recent LLMs, we find that Claude Fable 5 and GPT-6 Astra exceed 93% overall, while even the best open-weight model, Kimi K3.1 Pro, trails Claude Fable 5 by 12 percentage points. When models can additionally use a terminal and web access, they retrieve the knowledge they lack and every model improves. The gap narrows but about 4 points remain, and the ranking of models stays largely the same, suggesting that knowledge held in the model itself remains valuable even with tools. We release the dataset, the evaluation code, and the construction pipeline.

translation.title: JFinBench：来自最新认证考试的可持续更新的日本金融基准
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地应用于金融领域，因此需要能评估其在具有不同监管和实践的金融体系中能力的基准。然而，现有的金融基准对特定国家金融体系的覆盖有限，且随着发布的题目泄露到训练数据中，难以保持更新。我们提出JFinBench，一个日本金融基准，包含来自六个定期举办的认证考试2026年版共321个样例，涵盖会计、税务、理财规划和银行业务。为构建该基准，我们开发了一个人机协同的智能体流水线：编码智能体编写针对特定考试的转换代码和审阅页面，而人工验证每个样例并将修正反馈给智能体。该流水线能适应异构的考试格式，并降低纳入新考试版本的工作量，从而支持定期更新以缓解数据污染。对12个近期LLM的评估发现，Claude Fable 5和GPT-6 Astra总体准确率超过93%，而最好的开放权重模型Kimi K3.1 Pro仍落后Claude Fable 5 12个百分点。当模型额外可以使用终端和网络访问时，它们能检索自身缺乏的知识，所有模型都有提升。差距缩小但仍存在约4个百分点，模型排名基本不变，这表明即使有工具，模型自身掌握的知识仍然有价值。我们发布了数据集、评估代码和构建流水线。
translation.brief: 该论文构建了来自日本金融认证考试的可持续更新基准JFinBench，采用人机协同的智能体流水线来转换考题并缓解数据污染，用于评估LLM在日本金融体系上的能力。

papers.title: Forget the Lineage: Forward-Secure, Lineage-Complete Cryptographic Erasure for LLM-Agent Memory
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents keep a long-term memory that the model itself writes: summaries, extracted facts and embeddings derived from what users said. Deleting a message is therefore not enough: its derivatives, storage residue and backups survive. We define lineage-complete forward-secure erasure: after a forget request, an adversary that later obtains all storage and the agent's current keys learns nothing about the forgotten input or any memory derived from it. We present LinEra, which encrypts each memory under a key derived from its parents' keys along the derivation graph; source keys come from a puncturable pseudorandom function, so forgetting is a single puncture and every descendant becomes unreadable without being located. A sound lineage rule records as parents everything the writer saw, which confines all influence of a source to its descendants. We prove security and lineage integrity and integrate LinEra with mem0. With real LLMs from two families (1.5B to 7B parameters) writing the memory of LoCoMo conversations, an attacker holding every file and the current keys recovers, on all ten conversations written by the largest model, 70 of 71 forgotten secrets after logical deletion, 67 with per-object or epoch keys, and none with LinEra; the same holds for every writer tested. The price is a larger forgetting radius, which follows a simple law in the writer's fan-in: forgetting 1% of turns erases 73.0% of derived memories with session-level summaries but only 3.8% with four-turn windows, which also answer better; re-deriving restores what is lost.

translation.title: 忘却谱系：面向LLM智能体记忆的前向安全且谱系完备的加密擦除
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体维护着由模型自身写入的长期记忆：摘要、提取的事实以及从用户话语派生的嵌入。因此仅仅删除一条消息是不够的：其派生物、存储残留和备份仍然存在。我们定义了谱系完备的前向安全擦除：在遗忘请求之后，稍后获得全部存储和智能体当前密钥的攻击者无法获知被遗忘的输入或任何由其派生的记忆。我们提出LinEra，它使用沿派生图由父节点密钥派生的密钥加密每条记忆；源密钥来自可穿孔伪随机函数，因此遗忘只需一次穿孔，所有后代记忆无需被定位即变为不可读。一条可靠的谱系规则将写入者看到的一切记录为父节点，从而将源的所有影响限制在其后代内。我们证明了安全性与谱系完整性，并将LinEra集成到mem0中。使用来自两个家族的真实LLM（1.5B至7B参数）为LoCoMo对话写入记忆，在持有所有文件和当前密钥的攻击者面前，对于由最大模型写入的全部十个对话，逻辑删除后可恢复71个被遗忘秘密中的70个，使用逐对象或逐时期密钥可恢复67个，而使用LinEra则一个也无法恢复；这对所有测试的写入者均成立。代价是更大的遗忘半径，它遵循与写入者扇入相关的简单规律：遗忘1%的对话轮次在使用会话级摘要时会擦除73.0%的派生记忆，而使用四轮窗口时仅擦除3.8%，后者回答效果也更好；重新派生可以恢复丢失的内容。
translation.brief: 该论文提出LinEra，通过沿记忆派生图使用可穿孔伪随机函数派生的密钥加密记忆，实现对LLM智能体记忆的谱系完备前向安全加密擦除，使遗忘后代不可恢复。

papers.title: PUMA-Former: Uncertainty-Aware Agentic Computation Offloading in MEO-LEO Satellite Networks With Incomplete Information
papers.abstract: Satellite edge computing distributes mobile workloads across moving processors whose service capacity must be coordinated over time. In medium Earth orbit (MEO)--low Earth orbit (LEO) networks, periodic reports leave CPU states stale or missing, making offloading sensitive to uncertain capacity and shared-destination congestion. We propose PUMA-Former, an uncertainty-aware agentic framework for cooperative offloading under incomplete information that balances completed work, service delay, and execution cost. A MEO coordinator maintains distinct-report memory and closes the loop between available evidence, capacity estimates, allocation commands, and execution feedback. Latent-delay attention weights plausible measurement-age hypotheses, and historical innovations refine CPU estimates around the latest received report. Queue-error-aware fusion incorporates auxiliary pressure while accounting for backlog uncertainty. The inferred resource moments condition a structured Transformer allocator for joint destination, partition, bandwidth, CPU, and power decisions. Bounded risk-aware calibration then adjusts workload splits to reflect uncertainty and shared destination load. In traffic-driven development evaluation, PUMA-Former increases admitted compute-work completion by 8.62%, reduces mean modeled service delay by 34.78%, and reduces mean episode-P95 delay by 71.08% relative to ATLA-adapt. It also improves completion and normalized energy over fixed-half round-robin offloading. Service gains over the learning baselines involve higher normalized energy.

translation.title: PUMA-Former：信息不完全条件下MEO-LEO卫星网络中不确定性感知的智能体计算卸载
translation.abstract: 卫星边缘计算将移动工作负载分布到移动的处理器上，其服务能力需要随时间进行协调。在中地球轨道（MEO）—低地球轨道（LEO）网络中，周期性报告导致CPU状态陈旧或缺失，使卸载决策对不确定的容量和共享目的地的拥塞敏感。我们提出PUMA-Former，一个在信息不完全条件下进行协同卸载的不确定性感知智能体框架，权衡已完成的工作量、服务延迟和执行成本。MEO协调器维护差异化报告记忆，并在可用证据、容量估计、分配命令和执行反馈之间闭环。潜在延迟注意力对合理的测量时效假设加权，历史新息在最近接收报告的基础上修正CPU估计。队列误差感知融合在考虑积压不确定性的同时纳入辅助压力信息。推断出的资源矩量条件化一个结构化Transformer分配器，联合做出目的地、分区、带宽、CPU和功率决策。有界风险感知校准随后调整工作负载划分，以反映不确定性和共享目的地负载。在流量驱动的开发评估中，与ATLA-adapt相比，PUMA-Former将可接纳的计算工作完成量提升8.62%，平均建模服务延迟降低34.78%，平均回合P95延迟降低71.08%。相比固定一半的轮询卸载，它也提升了完成量和归一化能耗表现。相对于学习基线的服务增益伴随着更高的归一化能耗。
translation.brief: 该论文提出PUMA-Former框架，在MEO-LEO卫星网络CPU状态陈旧缺失的不完全信息下，通过注意力机制估计容量不确定性并进行风险感知的Transformer联合分配决策来实现协同计算卸载。

papers.title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
papers.abstract: Fast charging of lithium-ion batteries is a multi-objective control problem that requires reducing charging time and sustaining high energy throughput while suppressing accelerated degradation and safety-critical electrochemical reactions. Conventional protocols are easy to implement but have limited ability to adapt to variations in battery chemistry, operating conditions, and aging state. Model-based optimization and conventional data-driven control often require accurate models, costly iterative search, or task-specific policies. We develop a large language model (LLM)-empowered intelligent agent for adaptive battery fast-charging control. In this closed-loop framework, the agent interprets structured battery states, generates executable charging actions, observes the resulting battery response, and continuously adjusts subsequent decisions. We construct a large-scale simulation corpus with PyBaMM across five battery chemistries and 11 parameter sets and convert the resulting state-action-response trajectories into structured process data for agent training. Our two-stage strategy combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SFT establishes battery-control semantics and feasible decision priors from simulation-derived demonstrations. GRPO aligns the agent with a multi-objective control objective covering energy throughput, degradation mitigation, and operational constraints. Closed-loop simulations show that, under matched energy-throughput requirements, the agent achieves longer cycling life than conventional charging baselines and optimization-based strategies across heterogeneous battery configurations. This study provides a simulation-grounded proof of concept for using LLM agents as sequential decision makers in battery management and takes a step toward language-model-enabled control of physical energy systems.

translation.title: 大语言模型赋能的智能体用于锂离子电池自适应快充控制
translation.abstract: 锂离子电池快充是一个多目标控制问题，需要在抑制加速老化和安全关键电化学反应的同时缩短充电时间并维持高能量吞吐。传统协议易于实施，但适应电池化学体系、运行条件和老化状态变化的能力有限。基于模型的优化和传统数据驱动控制通常需要精确模型、代价高昂的迭代搜索或特定任务的策略。我们开发了一个大语言模型（LLM）赋能的智能体，用于自适应电池快充控制。在该闭环框架中，智能体解释结构化的电池状态，生成可执行的充电动作，观察随之产生的电池响应，并持续调整后续决策。我们使用PyBaMM在五种电池化学体系和11个参数集上构建了大规模仿真语料库，并将得到的状态-动作-响应轨迹转换为用于智能体训练的结构化过程数据。我们的两阶段策略结合了监督微调（SFT）和分组相对策略优化（GRPO）。SFT从仿真衍生的示范中建立电池控制语义和可行决策先验。GRPO将智能体与涵盖能量吞吐、减缓老化和运行约束的多目标控制目标对齐。闭环仿真表明，在匹配的能量吞吐要求下，该智能体在异构电池配置下比传统充电基线和基于优化的策略获得更长的循环寿命。本研究为使用LLM智能体作为电池管理中的序列决策者提供了基于仿真的概念验证，并朝着语言模型赋能的物理能源系统控制迈出一步。
translation.brief: 该论文提出用SFT加GRPO两阶段训练的LLM智能体进行闭环电池快充控制，基于PyBaMM大规模仿真数据学习多目标自适应充电策略。

papers.title: A Multi-Layered AI Pipeline for BPMN Generation from Natural Language
papers.abstract: The automated transformation of unstructured natural language process descriptions into Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) diagrams remains a challenging task, due to linguistic ambiguity and the difficulty to detect non-adjacent control-flow relationships. This paper proposes a solution for generating BPMN models from natural language descriptions through a multi-layered pipeline that integrates transformer-based architectures, Large Language Models and ontology population. The proposed method starts with natural language descriptions and separates textual processing, control-flow relation extraction, and structural validation into dedicated components. Entity extraction is performed using a fine-tuned RoBERTa-based transformer model while a control-flow engine captures non-adjacent relationships through LLM-based inference. To improve generalization under limited available data, the approach uses a dynamic few-shot strategy with con- trolled template input construction, enabling improved generalization under limited data availability. Additionally, an ontology population mechanism is introduced to represent the generated process models as semantic knowledge structures. For evaluation purposes we have used from the literature and industry reference processes. Additionally, we have validated the proposed method on a real-world heart disease patients transitional care process, capturing practical constraints and multi-actor collaboration, and serving as an expert-defined benchmark scenario. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance in the relation extraction task, achieving an accuracy of 90.7%, as well as maintaining structural alignment between the generated and reference BPMN models across multiple evaluation scenarios scenarios.

translation.title: 一种用于从自然语言生成BPMN的多层AI流水线
translation.abstract: 将非结构化的自然语言流程描述自动转换为业务流程模型与标记法（BPMN）图仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务，其原因在于语言歧义以及检测非相邻控制流关系的困难。本文提出一种通过多层流水线从自然语言描述生成BPMN模型的解决方案，该流水线集成了基于Transformer的架构、大语言模型和本体填充。所提方法从自然语言描述出发，将文本处理、控制流关系抽取和结构验证分离到专门的组件中。实体抽取使用基于RoBERTa的微调Transformer模型完成，而控制流引擎通过基于LLM的推理捕获非相邻关系。为了在可用数据有限的情况下提升泛化能力，该方法采用动态少样本策略与受控模板输入构造，从而在数据有限时实现更好的泛化。此外，引入本体填充机制，将生成的流程模型表示为语义知识结构。在评估方面，我们使用了来自文献和工业界的参考流程。此外，我们还在一个真实世界的心脏病患者过渡护理流程上验证了所提方法，捕获了实际约束和多参与者协作，并作为一个专家定义的基准场景。实验结果表明，该方法在关系抽取任务中表现出色，准确率达到90.7%，并且在多个评估场景中，生成的BPMN模型与参考BPMN模型保持了良好的结构一致性。
translation.brief: 该论文解决从自然语言流程描述自动生成BPMN模型的问题，核心方法是构建集成Transformer、LLM推理和本体填充的多层流水线来抽取实体与非相邻控制流关系并验证结构。

papers.title: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
papers.abstract: Independently pretrained language models and vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide complementary building blocks for embodied agents, but connecting them does not automatically produce coordinated behavior. The VLA may generate actions that diverge from the LLM's intended subtask and, upon regaining control after a correction, undo the promising state restored by the LLM. We introduce ESI (Embodied Self-Improvement), an automated flywheel that uses environmental interaction to align reasoning and action. ESI treats the modular agent as the unit of post-training, repeatedly refining the prompts that guide the LLM, the shared skill interface that expresses its intent, and the VLA parameters that realize that intent, then redeploying these components together. Our key insight is that collaboration itself can supply supervision for improving this interface. The LLM's subtask decisions provide semantic supervision for what the policy should execute, while its effective corrections and subsequent student continuations provide action-level supervision for recovery and handoff. The student also learns from its own effective execution, allowing locally useful experience to contribute even when the overall episode fails. On ten selected RoboDojo tasks, ESI achieves a mean Score of 62.03 and a mean success rate of 49.41% using an LLM-VLA agent without generating task-specific control code. On both metrics, it outperforms the published reference results of all hybrid embodied agents, including the Agent+WAM system GO-3 Nano Preview (47.27 Score and 36.60% success), as well as all compared code-based methods.

translation.title: ESI：面向LLM-VLA智能体的具身自我改进飞轮
translation.abstract: 独立预训练的语言模型和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为具身智能体提供了互补的基础模块，但简单连接二者并不会自动产生协调的行为。VLA可能生成偏离LLM预期子任务的动作，并且在纠正后重新获得控制时，撤销LLM所恢复的有利状态。我们提出ESI（具身自我改进），一种利用环境交互来对齐推理与动作的自动化飞轮。ESI将模块化智能体视为后训练的单元，反复优化引导LLM的提示词、表达其意图的共享技能接口，以及实现该意图的VLA参数，然后将这些组件重新部署在一起。我们的关键洞察是：协作本身可以为改进这一接口提供监督信号。LLM的子任务决策为策略应执行什么提供了语义监督，而其有效的纠正及后续的student延续则为恢复与交接提供了动作级监督。student还从自身的有效执行中学习，使得即使整个episode失败，局部有用的经验也能有所贡献。在十个精选的RoboDojo任务上，ESI使用不生成任务特定控制代码的LLM-VLA智能体，取得平均Score 62.03和平均成功率49.41%。在这两项指标上，它超越了所有已发表的混合式具身智能体的参考结果，包括Agent+WAM系统GO-3 Nano Preview（47.27 Score和36.60%成功率），以及所有对比的基于代码的方法。
translation.brief: 该论文解决LLM与VLA组合后推理与动作不协调的问题，核心方法是构建ESI自动化飞轮，利用环境交互迭代优化提示词、技能接口和VLA参数以实现自我改进。

papers.title: When Should a Virtual Patient Ask? RISP-Guided Proactive Information Seeking in Multi-Agent Patient Simulation
papers.abstract: Virtual patient (VP) systems support nursing communication training by providing simulated encounters in which learners practise explaining care and responding to patient concerns. Although large language models (LLMs) support flexible dialogue, current approaches give less explicit attention to how patients' information needs develop and guide the content and timing of their questions. We draw on the Risk Information Seeking and Processing (RISP) model, which relates information seeking to perceived risk and the gap between perceived knowledge and desired understanding. Guided by this perspective, we propose the RISP Multi-Agent System (RISP-MAS), a VP system for patient-initiated information seeking. The system links ongoing assessment of the patient's perceptions and information needs to coordinated decisions about whether to seek information, when to ask and which uncertainty to address. Evaluation of nursing student-VP interactions suggested that RISP-MAS exhibited plausible patient information-seeking behaviour, as indicated by expert assessments, while student feedback reflected positive interaction experiences. This work extends patient simulation by connecting a psychological account of information needs to explicit decisions about question initiation. The approach offers nursing students opportunities to practise recognising unresolved patient concerns and tailoring explanations to patients' information needs.

translation.title: 虚拟患者何时应该提问？多智能体患者仿真中RISP引导的主动信息寻求
translation.abstract: 虚拟患者（VP）系统通过提供模拟情境支持护理沟通训练，学习者在其中练习解释护理工作并回应患者的担忧。尽管大语言模型（LLM）支持灵活的对话，但现有方法对患者信息需求如何发展以及如何引导其提问的内容和时机关注较少。我们借鉴风险信息寻求与加工（RISP）模型，该模型将信息寻求与感知风险以及感知知识与期望理解之间的差距联系起来。基于这一视角，我们提出RISP多智能体系统（RISP-MAS），一个由患者发起信息寻求的VP系统。该系统将对患者感知和信息需求的持续评估与是否寻求信息、何时提问以及回应哪种不确定性的协调决策相连接。对护理学生与VP交互的评估表明，RISP-MAS表现出合理可信的患者信息寻求行为，这一点得到了专家评估的印证，同时学生反馈也反映出积极的交互体验。这项工作通过将信息需求的心理学解释与明确的提问发起决策相连接，拓展了患者仿真研究。该方法为护理学生提供了练习识别未解决的患者担忧并根据患者信息需求调整解释的机会。
translation.brief: 该论文解决虚拟患者系统中患者提问的内容与时机缺乏明确建模的问题，核心方法是基于RISP心理学模型构建多智能体系统，将患者信息需求评估与主动提问决策相连接。

papers.title: Large language models put existential risk from artificial intelligence at 10%
papers.abstract: How likely is it that advanced artificial intelligence (AI) will cause human extinction or a similarly permanent disempowerment of humanity? Humans, including AI experts, frequently disagree on this question. Yet one important perspective is missing from this debate: that of AI systems themselves. We put the question to 241 large language models (LLMs) at every available reasoning setting. The models converged on a median risk of 10.0%, with the middle 90% of their estimates between 3.5% and 15.8%, far narrower than the spread among human experts. More expensive, and typically more capable, models stated higher risks; newer models showed more uniform, but not higher, risks. More reasoning barely changed the models' estimates but widened their uncertainty, mostly toward higher risk. Almost all models named loss of control over AI as the most likely cause. These answers are not independent judgments; they likely echo training data, including published expert polls, and choices made in aligning the models. Still, they document the position that current AI systems state on the risks of their own technology. Whether this position reflects any genuine understanding of the systems' own capabilities remains open. Repeated measurements can show whether it shifts as AI systems advance, and how training and alignment shape it is a question for both research and public debate.

translation.title: 大语言模型认为人工智能带来生存风险的概率为10%
translation.abstract: 先进的人工智能（AI）导致人类灭绝或类似的人类永久性失权的可能性有多大？包括AI专家在内的人类对这一问题经常意见不一。然而这场辩论中缺失一个重要的视角：AI系统自身的看法。我们向241个大语言模型（LLM）在所有可用的推理设置下提出了这一问题。这些模型收敛于10.0%的中位风险估计，其估计值的中间90%介于3.5%和15.8%之间，远窄于人类专家之间的分歧幅度。更昂贵且通常更强大的模型给出的风险更高；更新的模型给出的风险更趋一致，但并非更高。增加推理量几乎不改变模型的估计值，但会扩大其不确定性，且大多向更高风险方向偏移。几乎所有模型都将AI失控列为最可能的成因。这些回答并非独立的判断；它们很可能反映了训练数据（包括已发表的专家调查）以及模型对齐过程中所做的选择。尽管如此，它们记录了当前AI系统对自身技术风险所持的立场。这一立场是否反映了系统对自身能力的任何真正理解，仍是开放问题。重复测量可以显示这一立场是否随AI系统的进步而变化，而训练和对齐如何塑造它则是研究与公共辩论需要回答的问题。
translation.brief: 该论文解决AI系统自身如何看待AI生存风险这一视角缺失的问题，核心方法是对241个LLM进行大规模问卷调查以估计人类灭绝风险概率。

papers.title: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to Space-Filling Input Design for Nonlinear System Identification
papers.abstract: In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) approach to space-filling input design for nonlinear system identification, in which an agent learns a control policy that actively drives the system to explore its state space. Classical input design, developed mainly for linear models, minimises the covariance of the estimated parameters. For nonlinear black-box models, however, the dominant error is the bias induced by the model structure over the region of interest, which motivates space-filling strategies that seek to cover the system state space. Existing space-filling approaches rely on predefined input signal classes and require solving explicit optimisation problems. Unlike these methods, the proposed approach requires no input class to be selected and no frequency band to be tuned for the system at hand, satisfies an amplitude bound by construction, and adapts to varying initial conditions through its observation-based policy without re-optimisation. The learned excitation signals exhibit physically meaningful behaviours, such as resonance excitation and amplitude modulation. The approach is evaluated against tuned swept sine and crest-factor-optimised multisine excitations, and against a state-of-the-art space-filling multisine design, on two nonlinear benchmark systems: a mass-spring-damper with nonlinear stiffness and a Van der Pol oscillator. Under the same amplitude bound, the learned policy achieves the best overall space-filling performance on both systems and distributes its samples more uniformly than the state-of-the-art design.

translation.title: 一种用于非线性系统辨识的填满空间输入设计的强化学习方法
translation.abstract: 本文提出一种强化学习（RL）方法，用于非线性系统辨识的填满空间（space-filling）输入设计，其中一个智能体学习一种主动驱动系统探索其状态空间的控制策略。经典输入设计主要针对线性模型开发，旨在最小化估计参数的协方差。然而对于非线性黑箱模型，主要误差是由关注区域上的模型结构引起的偏差，这促使人们采用旨在覆盖系统状态空间的填满空间策略。现有填满空间方法依赖于预定义的输入信号类别，并需要求解显式的优化问题。与这些方法不同，所提方法不需要选择输入类别，也不需要为特定系统调整频带，在构造上即满足幅值约束，并通过基于观测的策略适应不同的初始条件而无需重新优化。学习到的激励信号表现出物理上有意义的行为，如共振激励和幅值调制。我们在两个非线性基准系统上，将该方法与调优的扫频正弦和 crest-factor 优化的多正弦激励以及最先进的填满空间多正弦设计进行了比较评估：一个具有非线性刚度的质量-弹簧-阻尼系统和Van der Pol振子。在相同幅值约束下，学习到的策略在两个系统上都取得了最佳的总体填满空间性能，并且其样本分布比最先进设计更加均匀。
translation.brief: 该论文解决非线性系统辨识中传统输入设计依赖预定义信号类别与显式优化的问题，核心方法是用强化学习训练智能体生成满足幅值约束的自适应填满空间激励信号。

papers.title: NeoResearch: Literature- and Experience-Guided Autonomous Time Series Model Discovery
papers.abstract: Developing effective forecasting models for diverse time-series domains requires substantial expert knowledge, evidence from scientific literature on the web, and iterative experimentation. However, translating this knowledge and research experience into model designs requires preserving source context and testing applicability under task-specific assumptions. In this paper, we propose NeoResearch, a literature- and experience-guided autonomous research framework that leverages large language models (LLMs) as researchers to discover lightweight, domain-specific forecasting models. Specifically, NeoResearch establishes an expert-inspired dual-loop research workflow, coupling hypothesis-driven architecture exploration with iterative training and hyperparameter optimization through experimental feedback. To enable knowledge-grounded discovery, the agent autonomously mines scientific literature from the Web, extracting modeling mechanisms, empirical evidence, and applicability conditions to formulate task-grounded, testable architecture hypotheses. Furthermore, a hierarchical experience memory links literature findings to experimental outcomes and consolidates conditional lessons, guiding architecture discovery and training optimization while supporting reuse across forecasting tasks. Experiments on ten datasets show competitive performance and support dual loops, literature extraction, and memory reuse. Our code is available.

translation.title: NeoResearch：文献与经验引导的自主时间序列模型发现
