translation.abstract: 开发适用于多样时间序列领域的有效预测模型需要大量专家知识、来自网络科学文献的证据以及迭代实验。然而，将这些知识和研究经验转化为模型设计，需要保留源上下文并在任务特定假设下检验其适用性。本文提出 NeoResearch，一个文献与经验引导的自主研究框架，利用大语言模型（LLM）作为研究者来发现轻量级、面向特定领域的预测模型。具体而言，NeoResearch 建立了受专家启发的双循环研究工作流，将假设驱动的架构探索与通过实验反馈进行的迭代训练和超参数优化耦合起来。为实现基于知识的发现，智能体自主从网络上挖掘科学文献，提取建模机制、经验证据和适用条件，以形成基于任务、可检验的架构假设。此外，分层经验记忆将文献发现与实验结果关联起来，并整合条件化经验教训，引导架构发现和训练优化，同时支持跨预测任务的复用。在十个数据集上的实验展示了有竞争力的性能，并支持双循环、文献提取和记忆复用。我们的代码已开源。
translation.brief: 解决自主发现领域特定时间序列预测模型的问题，核心方法是让LLM智能体挖掘科学文献并结合分层经验记忆进行假设驱动的架构探索与迭代训练优化。

papers.title: Dancing Tokens on the Vocabulary Network from LLM Generation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) generate text one token at a time, yet how a particular generation relates to the geometry learned in pre-training remains unclear. The fundamental explainability of LLMs is elusive. Here, we build a similarity network from the input embeddings of six open LLMs and map generation onto it. The token-embedding network is scale-free while heavy-tailed, as are random embeddings with matched covariance, but far more fragmented. Distillation barely changes this topology because input embeddings are largely inherited. The knowledge space is thus deterministic from pre-training. Consecutive generated tokens are rarely graph neighbours and, in most models, no more often than in shuffled order, so generation is not a walk on the predefined network, although the tokens it visits are concentrated within it. Through the logit lens in a layer- wise manner, tokens settle late in depth in most models, and repetitive models remain confined to small domain-specific sub-graphs. These observables could serve as inference-time monitors of degeneration. We thus provide a fresh perspective on understanding LLM generation in the microscopic way from node or link prediction by graph learning.

translation.title: 词汇网络上的舞蹈Token：来自LLM的生成
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）逐个token地生成文本，但某次特定生成与预训练中学到的几何结构之间的关系仍不清楚，LLM的根本可解释性依然难以捉摸。本文基于六个开源LLM的输入嵌入构建相似性网络，并将生成过程映射到其上。token嵌入网络是无标度且重尾的，与协方差匹配的随机嵌入类似，但更加碎片化。蒸馏几乎不改变这种拓扑结构，因为输入嵌入在很大程度上是继承而来的，因此知识空间在预训练时就是确定的。连续生成的token很少是图上的邻居，且在大多数模型中并不比打乱顺序时更频繁，所以生成不是在预定义网络上的随机游走，尽管它访问的token集中于网络内部。通过逐层的 logit lens 观察，大多数模型中token在深度上较晚才稳定下来，而重复输出的模型始终局限于小的领域特定子图。这些观测量可作为推理时退化（degeneration）的监控指标，从而从图学习的节点或链接预测视角为理解LLM生成提供了微观层面的新视角。
translation.brief: 解决LLM生成与预训练嵌入几何关系不明的问题，核心方法是将生成token映射到输入嵌入相似性网络并分析其拓扑与层级稳定性。

papers.title: NER-D: A cross-domain benchmark for German NER
papers.abstract: We present NER-D, a cross-domain benchmark for German NER comprising 13 datasets spanning 9 domains, including General/Politics, Wikipedia, Legal, Medical, Historical, Financial, Agriculture and Archaeology. We examine the performance of both proprietary LLMs and state-of-the-art small open-source models using normal prompting and further examine the performance gains achievable via in-context learning and LoRA fine-tuning. Our results show that without any sort of optimization a proprietary model (GPT-5.4 mini) outperforms the smaller open-source models on 6 out of 13 datasets, but LoRA fine-tuning enables the smaller models to substantially outperform the proprietary baseline. We further analyze the influence of the domain and the tagset used in each task on the performance achieved in the different evaluation settings. Our benchmark will be available as a resource for the development of future German NER methods on both general and specialized domains.\footnote{We make our code, data, and models publicly available upon acceptance of this paper.

translation.title: NER-D：面向德语NER的跨领域基准
translation.abstract: 我们提出 NER-D，一个面向德语命名实体识别（NER）的跨领域基准，包含覆盖9个领域的13个数据集，包括通用/政治、维基百科、法律、医疗、历史、金融、农业和考古。我们考察了专有LLM和最先进小型开源模型在普通提示下的表现，并进一步研究了通过上下文学习和LoRA微调可获得的性能提升。结果显示，在不做任何优化的情况下，专有模型（GPT-5.4 mini）在13个数据集中的6个上优于小型开源模型，但LoRA微调使小型模型能大幅超越该专有基线。我们进一步分析了领域和各任务所用标签集对不同评估设置下性能的影响。本基准将作为资源公开，支持未来在通用与专业领域上的德语NER方法开发。
translation.brief: 解决德语NER缺乏跨领域基准的问题，核心方法是构建覆盖9个领域的13个数据集基准并系统比较LLM提示、上下文学习和LoRA微调。

papers.title: From Bytes to Behavior: Request-Level Attribution from Live GPU Hidden States
papers.abstract: Existing memory forensics for machine learning systems typically targets static artifacts, such as model weights or prompt logs, rather than the transient computational states of a live inference process. This gap limits an examiner's ability to analyze the specific behavior of a running large language model (LLM) service that cannot be restarted or modified. We present a method for acquiring per-layer residual-stream activations from a live GPU process using a non-modifying debugger, without requiring prior knowledge of the model's architecture parameters or weights. The approach employs a general six-stage process with platform-specific adapters, utilizing either a PyTorch allocator clock or a kernel-launch clock to identify and read tensor allocations from video memory. We validate this acquisition on 33 open-source decoder-only models across nine architecture classes, demonstrating that the recovered bytes are byte-exact and usable for downstream analysis. As a use case, we apply linear probes trained on standard framework activations to the recovered states, successfully distinguishing refusal from compliance with an AUROC of 0.88 on held-out prompts. This work establishes that live, observational access to intermediate hidden states is feasible on named inference platforms, providing a new source of evidence for examining the operational behavior of deployed AI systems.

translation.title: 从字节到行为：基于运行中GPU隐藏状态的请求级归因
translation.abstract: 现有的机器学习系统内存取证通常针对静态产物，如模型权重或提示日志，而非运行中推理过程的瞬态计算状态。这一缺口限制了审查者对无法重启或修改的运行中大语言模型（LLM）服务具体行为的分析能力。我们提出一种使用非侵入式调试器从运行中的GPU进程获取逐层残差流激活的方法，无需预先了解模型的架构参数或权重。该方法采用包含平台特定适配器的通用六阶段流程，利用PyTorch分配器时钟或内核启动时钟来识别并读取显存中的张量分配。我们在9个架构类别的33个开源decoder-only模型上验证了该采集方法，证明恢复的字节是逐字节精确且可用于下游分析的。作为用例，我们将基于标准框架激活训练的线性探针应用于恢复的状态，在留出提示上以0.88的AUROC成功区分拒绝与顺从。这项工作证明了对中间隐藏状态进行运行时观测式访问在主流推理平台上是可行的，为审查已部署AI系统的运行行为提供了新的证据来源。
translation.brief: 解决对运行中无法重启的LLM服务进行内存取证的问题，核心方法是用非侵入式调试器配合分配器/内核启动时钟逐字节恢复GPU显存中的逐层隐藏状态。

papers.title: PrivacyPR: A Dataset of Real-World Privacy Fixes for Benchmarking Privacy-Aware Code Review
papers.abstract: Coding agents increasingly review code, yet whether they catch the privacy defects that laws such as the GDPR require software to avoid remains largely untested, partly because few datasets connect real privacy defects to their accepted fixes and review context. We present PrivacyPR, a dataset of 4,131 merged GitHub pull requests (PRs) from 1,469 repositories, created between June 2018 and January 2024. Each PR includes its commits, diffs, review discussion, and LLM-generated labels for privacy relevance, fix type, and GDPR principles. PrivacyPR provides 1,169 high-confidence privacy fixes and 1,643 non-fix PRs, together with Verified, a manually checked split of 250 privacy fixes and 250 non-fix PRs, and Small, a 100 + 100 subset for evaluation. On Verified, both annotators endorsed 72% of the LLM's GDPR-principle assignments. Beyond supporting empirical study of how privacy defects arise and are fixed, PrivacyPR provides a benchmark for privacy-aware code review on real, developer-accepted fixes. Its evaluation harness reverts each fix to reintroduce the defect. On Small, two coding agents detect only 42-51% of defects under a generic review prompt, but 88-91% when explicitly asked to check privacy, while flagging 11-15% of non-fix PRs. These results show that privacy defects can be detected by coding agents, but that detection depends strongly on review intent and comes with false alarms. Data, code, reviews, judge verdicts, and an extensible evaluation harness are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: PrivacyPR：用于隐私感知代码评审基准测试的真实隐私修复数据集
translation.abstract: 编码智能体越来越多地参与代码评审，但它们能否发现GDPR等法律要求软件避免的隐私缺陷，在很大程度上未经测试，部分原因在于很少有数据集将真实隐私缺陷与其被采纳的修复及评审上下文关联起来。我们提出 PrivacyPR，一个包含来自1469个仓库、2018年6月至2024年1月间创建的4131个已合并GitHub拉取请求（PR）的数据集。每个PR包含其提交、diff、评审讨论以及LLM生成的关于隐私相关性、修复类型和GDPR原则的标签。PrivacyPR 提供1169个高置信度隐私修复和1643个非修复PR，以及人工核查的 Verified 子集（250个隐私修复和250个非修复PR）和用于评估的 Small 子集（100+100）。在 Verified 上，两位标注者均认可LLM的GDPR原则标注的72%。除支持隐私缺陷如何产生和修复的实证研究外，PrivacyPR 还提供了基于真实开发者已采纳修复的隐私感知代码评审基准。其评估工具通过回滚每个修复来重新引入缺陷。在 Small 上，在通用评审提示下两个编码智能体仅检测到42-51%的缺陷，而在明确要求检查隐私时达到88-91%，同时误报11-15%的非修复PR。这些结果表明编码智能体可以检测隐私缺陷，但检测效果强烈依赖于评审意图且伴随误报。数据、代码、评审内容、判定结果和可扩展的评估工具均公开于该网址。
translation.brief: 解决编码智能体能否检出隐私缺陷缺乏基准的问题，核心方法是构建关联真实隐私缺陷与已采纳修复的PR数据集，并通过回滚修复的评估工具测试智能体检出率。

papers.title: Experts Across Schemas: Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Relational-Experts for Cross-Database Generalization
papers.abstract: Web platforms record user and item activity in relational databases whose schemas differ from platform to platform, which makes it difficult to transfer predictive models between them. Relational foundation models address this through cross-database pretraining, yet recent improvements have relied on increasingly large pretraining corpora. We ask whether a better architecture, together with features specific to the target database, can deliver comparable gains from far less pretraining data. We introduce MoREGT, a mixture-of-relational-experts graph transformer that represents both rows and cells as tokens, adds the log-ages of rows and the names of foreign-key relationships to attention, and routes cells and rows to experts by column metadata rather than by values. A label-blind LLM agent complements the model: it reads the target database's schema and column statistics and adds validated single-row derived columns, without access to labels or model scores. On 21 RelBench tasks with leave-one-database-out pretraining on six databases, the MoREGT backbone improves on the Relational Transformer pretrained on the same databases by 2.25 points of mean AUROC and 5.83 points of mean nMAE. The agent's columns raise mean AUROC from 78.45 to 79.63 and lower mean nMAE from 27.91 to 26.98, the highest means on both metrics among the compared methods, including RT-J, which pretrains on about 400 times as many databases.

translation.title: 跨模式的专家：面向跨数据库泛化的智能体引导关系专家混合模型
translation.abstract: Web 平台在关系数据库中记录用户和物品活动，而各平台数据库模式各异，这使得预测模型难以在平台之间迁移。关系基础模型通过跨数据库预训练来解决这一问题，但近来的改进依赖于越来越大的预训练语料。我们探究更好的架构结合目标数据库特有的特征，能否用少得多的预训练数据带来相当的性能提升。我们提出 MoREGT，一种关系专家混合图 Transformer，将行和单元格都表示为 token，在注意力中加入行的 log-age 和外键关系名称，并按列元数据（而非值）将单元格和行路由到专家。一个标签盲的 LLM 智能体对模型进行补充：它读取目标数据库的 schema 和列统计信息，添加经过验证的单行派生列，且无法访问标签或模型分数。在 21 个 RelBench 任务上，采用六数据库留一数据库预训练，MoREGT 骨干网络比在相同数据库上预训练的 Relational Transformer 平均 AUROC 提升 2.25 分、平均 nMAE 提升 5.83 分。智能体的列将平均 AUROC 从 78.45 提升至 79.63，将平均 nMAE 从 27.91 降至 26.98，在所有对比方法中两项指标均为最高，包括在约 400 倍数据库上预训练的 RT-J。
translation.brief: 针对跨异构数据库模式迁移预测模型的问题，提出按列元数据路由专家的关系专家混合图 Transformer MoREGT，并用 LLM 智能体读取目标库 schema 自动添加派生列以提升泛化能力。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Null-Space Exploitation in Pseudo-Inverse Control Allocation
papers.abstract: Pseudo-inverse methods are widely used to solve control allocation problems for overactuated aircraft with redundant control effectors. These methods reliably satisfy the primary command tracking objective, while the remaining null-space degrees of freedom are in principle available for secondary objectives such as drag reduction or actuator wear balancing. However, exploiting this freedom in practice requires hand-tuned weighting matrices or a priori preferred deflections that are difficult to specify across a wide flight envelope with nonlinear, state-dependent dynamics. This paper presents a hybrid architecture in which a reinforcement learning agent operates exclusively within the null space of the control effectiveness matrix, learning secondary objective strategies directly from interaction with the flight dynamics. The null-space projector guarantees by construction that primary command tracking remains invariant regardless of the agent output, providing a principled separation between certified primary control and adaptive secondary optimization. The approach is demonstrated on a nonlinear six-degree-of-freedom distributed electric propulsion aircraft model with aero-propulsive effects across diverse mission scenarios, achieving measurable drag reduction compared to the baseline allocation while preserving tracking integrity and respecting actuator constraints. The proposed architecture forms a foundation for future extensions toward multi-objective, mission-conditioned policies.

translation.title: 用于伪逆控制分配零空间利用的强化学习
translation.abstract: 伪逆方法被广泛用于解决具有冗余控制执行器的过驱动飞机的控制分配问题。这些方法可靠地满足主指令跟踪目标，而剩余的零空间自由度原则上可用于次要目标，如减阻或执行器磨损均衡。然而，在实践中利用这种自由度需要手工调节的权重矩阵或先验偏转偏好，这在具有非线性、状态相关动力学的宽飞行包线内难以指定。本文提出一种混合架构，其中强化学习智能体仅在控制有效性矩阵的零空间内运作，直接通过与飞行动力学的交互学习次要目标策略。零空间投影器从构造上保证无论智能体输出如何，主指令跟踪保持不变，从而在经过认证的主控制与自适应次要优化之间提供了原则性的分离。该方法在具有气动推进效应的非线性六自由度分布式电推进飞机模型上，跨多种任务场景进行了演示，相比基线分配实现了可测量的减阻，同时保持了跟踪完整性并满足执行器约束。所提架构为未来向多目标、任务条件化策略扩展奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 针对过驱动飞行器控制分配中零空间自由度难以利用的问题，提出让强化学习智能体仅在控制有效性矩阵零空间内学习次要目标策略的混合架构，从构造上保证主指令跟踪不受影响。

papers.title: f-Divergence Self-Play for Tabular Anomaly Detection via Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Anomaly detection in tabular data poses significant challenges due to heterogeneous feature types-mixing numerical, categorical, and textual attributes, which complicate learning meaningful representations of normality. Recent work has applied large language models (LLMs) to this problem by serializing table rows as text sequences, yet these approaches rely on one-shot supervised fine-tuning that offers limited signal to tighten the model's description of normality. We propose DiSPaT, a self-play fine-tuning framework that strengthens the model's understanding of normal data. Building on the theoretical foundation of f-divergence minimization, we derive a tight approximation connecting our training objective to reducing the distributional gap between real normal data and model-generated samples. DiSPaT operates through an alternating optimization: at each iteration, the current policy generates synthetic samples that serve as pseudo-anomalies, while a critic discriminator learns to distinguish these from real normal samples; this signal drives policy updates that progressively align the model distribution with the true normal-data distribution. Extensive experiments on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DiSPaT consistently outperforms prior LLM-based methods, deep learning approaches, and classical unsupervised detectors for tabular anomaly detection.

translation.title: 基于大语言模型的表格异常检测的 f-散度自博弈
translation.abstract: 表格数据中的异常检测由于异构特征类型——混合数值、类别和文本属性——而面临重大挑战，这使得学习正常性的有意义表示变得复杂。近期工作将大语言模型（LLM）应用于该问题，通过将表格行序列化为文本序列，但这些方法依赖一次性监督微调，所提供的信号有限，难以收紧模型对正常性的描述。我们提出 DiSPaT，一个自博弈微调框架，用以强化模型对正常数据的理解。基于 f-散度最小化的理论基础，我们推导出一个紧致的近似，将我们的训练目标与缩小真实正常数据和模型生成样本之间的分布差距联系起来。DiSPaT 通过交替优化运作：在每次迭代中，当前策略生成作为伪异常的合成样本，同时一个判别器学习将其与真实正常样本区分开；该信号驱动策略更新，逐步将模型分布与真实正常数据分布对齐。在多样化基准上的大量实验表明，DiSPaT 在表格异常检测上持续优于此前基于 LLM 的方法、深度学习方法以及经典无监督检测器。
translation.brief: 针对表格数据异构特征导致异常检测困难的问题，提出基于 f-散度最小化的自博弈微调框架 DiSPaT，通过生成伪异常与判别器交替优化来收紧模型对正常数据分布的刻画。

papers.title: Evaluating Human Sensitivity to Gender Biased AI-Generated Content through Human Assessment of Google's Autocomplete Function
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly present, but their effects on human users remain underexplored. We tested whether AI-attributed information influences views regarding gender-related statements, a domain where biases are pervasive. Spanish-speaking participants recruited through Prolific evaluated biased statements derived from Google's autocomplete function and human-authored, non-biased gender-related facts. Participants were either informed that some of the material was AI-generated or received no information about its origin. AI attribution did not affect reaction times or agreement judgments. This result suggests that AI-generated content does not automatically raise credibility concerns and may be evaluated with less scrutiny compared to human-produced content.

translation.title: 通过人类对 Google 自动补全功能的评估考察人类对性别偏见 AI 生成内容的敏感度
translation.abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）日益普及，但其对人类用户的影响仍未得到充分研究。我们测试了标注为 AI 生成的信息是否会影响人们对性别相关陈述的看法，这是一个偏见普遍存在的领域。通过 Prolific 招募的西班牙语参与者评估了源自 Google 自动补全功能的偏见陈述以及人工撰写的无偏见性别相关事实。部分参与者被告知其中一些材料为 AI 生成，另一些则未获得关于来源的任何信息。AI 归属并未影响反应时间或认同判断。这一结果表明，AI 生成的内容并不会自动引发可信度方面的疑虑，且与人类创作的内容相比，可能受到较少的审视。
translation.brief: 通过让参与者评估 Google 自动补全生成的性别偏见陈述并操纵 AI 来源标注，考察 AI 归属是否影响人们对内容的可信度判断。

papers.title: Voice-Based Conversational Agents as AI Care Assistants: Evaluating Personalization, Intervention Delivery Fidelity, and Privacy Expectations in Older Adults' Care
papers.abstract: Generative AI enables voice-based conversational agents to play more active roles in older adults' care, including personalizing support and operating alongside clinicians and care partners. This shift creates two challenges: how to personalize support while faithfully delivering evidence-based interventions, and how to manage personal-data use and sharing across AI and care stakeholders. We designed and evaluated ARC, a voice-based conversational agent that operationalizes multidomain lifestyle intervention through sessions with predefined goals, participant context, and evidence-based components. In a 3-day remote study, 80 older adults completed 473 sessions across six session types (9,183 turns; averaging 19.4 turns and 6 minutes per session). Participants reported favorable usability, acceptability, and use intentions. System-level analyses showed strong domain-level but modest participant-specific contextual reuse, no significant personalization-fidelity association, and fidelity limitations centered on incomplete delivery of intervention components rather than off-protocol drift. Within care relationships, expectations for personal-data use and sharing varied by data type and recipient. Our findings support feasibility of conversational delivery of multidomain lifestyle intervention, offer methods and system-design insights for longitudinal evaluation, and motivate an evaluation agenda for generative AI health interventions: user-experience and outcome measures should be complemented by evidence of whether intended intervention processes were delivered as designed.

translation.title: 基于语音的对话式智能体作为 AI 护理助手：评估老年人护理中的个性化、干预交付保真度与隐私期望
translation.abstract: 生成式 AI 使基于语音的对话式智能体能够在老年人护理中扮演更积极的角色，包括个性化支持以及与临床医生和护理伙伴协同运作。这一转变带来两个挑战：如何在忠实交付循证干预的同时实现支持个性化，以及如何在 AI 与护理利益相关者之间管理个人数据的使用与共享。我们设计并评估了 ARC，一种基于语音的对话式智能体，通过具有预定目标、参与者情境和循证组件的会话来实施多领域生活方式干预。在一项为期 3 天的远程研究中，80 名老年人完成了跨越六种会话类型的 473 个会话（9,183 轮对话；平均每会话 19.4 轮、6 分钟）。参与者报告了良好的可用性、可接受性和使用意愿。系统层面分析显示领域级情境复用较强而参与者特定的情境复用较弱，个性化与保真度之间无显著关联，且保真度局限主要在于干预组件交付不完整而非偏离既定方案。在护理关系中，对个人数据使用和共享的期望因数据类型和接收方而异。我们的发现支持对话式交付多领域生活方式干预的可行性，为纵向评估提供了方法和系统设计洞见，并推动了生成式 AI 健康干预的评估议程：用户体验和结果测量应辅以预期干预过程是否按设计交付的证据。
translation.brief: 针对 AI 护理智能体如何个性化支持并忠实交付循证干预及管理隐私的问题，设计并评估语音对话智能体 ARC，通过老年人群真实使用分析个性化效果与干预保真度。

papers.title: VelServe: Taming Decode Jitters in LLM Inference with Tail-Calibrated Scheduling
papers.abstract: Interactive LLM services must meet latency service-level objectives (SLOs) for the time to first token (TTFT) and the time between tokens (TBT), as streaming and soft real-time applications require predictable token delivery. We identify decode jitters in both aggregated and disaggregated serving. A jitter delays every request in the batch, and long responses span hundreds of steps, so even rare overruns cause many SLO violations. In aggregated serving, SLO-aware schedulers set each step's prefill budget until its predicted latency just meets the TBT target, leaving no room for mispredictions or host stalls. Disaggregation meets average TBT targets at a cost in capacity, yet the steps that admit new requests still run late. We present \sysname, a scheduler that calibrates how much prefill work each decode step carries using the measured tail of its own iteration latency. The SLO determines how rare a late step must be, and \sysname leaves enough headroom in each iteration to prevent overruns and meet the target decode latency. This headroom slows prefill, so \sysname serves the shortest waiting prompt first. When TTFT deadlines grow with prompt length, the long prompts it delays have the most time to spare. Under disaggregation, it spaces admissions so that no request waits on more slow admission steps than its P99 target allows. On three attention families and varying workloads, \sysname sustains 2.4--2.9$\times$ the SLO goodput of the strongest baseline on Qwen3-8B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, and at least 4.4$\times$ on DeepSeek-V2-Lite. With prefill and decode disaggregated on eight GPUs, \sysname meets the SLO for more than twice as many requests as state-of-the-art baselines.

translation.title: VelServe：利用尾部校准调度抑制LLM推理中的解码抖动
translation.abstract: 交互式LLM服务必须满足首token时间（TTFT）和token间隔时间（TBT）的延迟服务级目标（SLO），因为流式和软实时应用需要可预测的token交付。我们发现在聚合式和分离式服务中都存在解码抖动。一次抖动会延迟批处理中的每个请求，而长响应跨越数百个步骤，因此即使是罕见超时也会导致大量SLO违规。在聚合式服务中，SLO感知调度器为每一步设置prefill预算，使其预测延迟恰好满足TBT目标，没有为预测误差或主机停顿留出余地。分离式服务以容量为代价满足平均TBT目标，但接收新请求的步骤仍然会延迟。我们提出VelServe，这是一种调度器，它使用自身迭代延迟的实测尾部来校准每个解码步骤承载的prefill工作量。SLO决定了延迟步骤必须多么罕见，VelServe在每次迭代中留出足够的余量以防止超时并满足目标解码延迟。这一余量会拖慢prefill，因此VelServe优先服务等待时间最短的提示。当TTFT截止期限随提示长度增长时，被延迟的长提示拥有最多的富余时间。在分离式部署下，它对请求的接入进行间隔控制，使任何请求等待的慢接入步骤数量不超过其P99目标允许的范围。在三种注意力架构和多种工作负载上，VelServe在Qwen3-8B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash上维持了最强基线2.4至2.9倍的SLO goodput，在DeepSeek-V2-Lite上至少为4.4倍。在八块GPU上将prefill与解码分离部署时，VelServe满足SLO的请求数量是最新基线的两倍以上。
translation.brief: 针对LLM推理解码步骤延迟抖动导致的SLO违规问题，提出根据迭代延迟实测尾部为每步prefill工作量留出余量并进行调度校准的VelServe调度器。

papers.title: Smart Home Agents Make Capable but Unpredictable Grid Operators
papers.abstract: AI-enabled smart homes are becoming more common across the grid edge. However, there has not been much work on failure response. This area is critical because smart homes operate on the grid edge where failures can cascade down. If a power outage happens within a smart home, a user has to manually troubleshoot their smart home to include tasks such as power load balance and device recovery. We conduct the first resilience analysis of smart home agents across a full power outage, providing a suite of outage simulations in a live environment that measures resilience before, during, and post power outage. We show that smart home agents can act as grid operators in power outages and identify several new failure categories highlighting the current limitations across all of our models. These findings establish the groundwork for smart home agents as grid operators to increase overall resilience on the grid edge.

translation.title: 智能家居代理是有能力但不可预测的电网操作员
translation.abstract: AI赋能的智能家居在电网边缘日益普及。然而，关于故障响应的研究还很少。这一领域至关重要，因为智能家居运行在电网边缘，故障可能级联扩散。如果智能家居内部发生停电，用户必须手动排查故障，包括电力负载平衡和设备恢复等任务。我们首次对智能家居代理在完全断电情况下的韧性进行分析，提供了一套在真实环境中运行的停电模拟套件，用于衡量停电前、停电中和停电后的韧性。我们证明智能家居代理可以在停电中扮演电网操作员的角色，并识别出若干新的故障类别，揭示了所有模型当前的局限性。这些发现为智能家居代理作为电网操作员以提升电网边缘整体韧性奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 针对智能家居代理在停电场景下的故障响应能力缺乏研究的问题，通过在真实环境中构建停电模拟套件进行首次韧性分析并归纳新的故障类别。

papers.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
papers.abstract: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.

translation.title: Gamer：面向长时程实时游戏代理的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型
translation.abstract: 我们提出Gamer，一个为复杂交互环境中的长时程任务构建的通用代理框架。其端到端架构结合了感知、记忆管理和多步推理。统一的训练与部署流水线支持与传统2D图形界面以及复杂3D模拟世界的交互。我们首先基于数万小时设备级键鼠交互构建的数据集进行继续预训练。这些轨迹涵盖模拟游戏和具身环境，使模型能够学习物理与虚拟领域的环境动态。随后的稀疏思考指令微调在保留复杂决策所需推理的同时大幅减少冗余计算。我们使用稳定的多轮强化学习方法训练长时程交互策略，该方法解决了有限上下文窗口、累积的rollout误差和稀疏奖励问题。为实现实时交互，云边推理引擎可并发服务大量模拟游戏环境，支持无界上下文执行，并保持较低的在线推理延迟。在多款具有挑战性的3D开放世界游戏中，Gamer展现出扎实的泛化能力，操作效率可与熟练玩家媲美。它还在一系列传统2D游戏基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。这些结果表明，即使是重复性的键鼠轨迹也能支撑数据与学习算法规模化带来的显著收益。在这些轨迹上训练帮助Gamer在兼具物理与数字属性的环境中更稳定地学习复杂技能。这一方法为能够在数字与物理世界间交互的通用代理提供了一条路径。
translation.brief: 针对通用代理在长时程实时游戏任务中的能力不足问题，构建融合感知、记忆与多步推理的端到端VLA模型Gamer，并用键鼠轨迹预训练、稀疏思考微调与多轮强化学习训练策略。

papers.title: LECAT: Measuring LLM Category Learning from Pretraining Data
papers.abstract: Humans know that airplanes are fast, that this extends to red airplanes, but that it does not hold for broken airplanes. How do LLMs acquire category knowledge that humans learn and apply effortlessly? We introduce LeCat, a two-part framework to analyze LLM's Learning of Category knowledge. First, we use LeCat to evaluate models on their ability to learn category knowledge, distinguishing between three cases: memorization of in-domain category knowledge, generalization to unseen instances, and ability to flexibly use knowledge in appropriate contexts. Then, we use LeCat to trace how this knowledge can be learned in pretraining from text that may encode category knowledge in various ways, such as verbatim repetition or exceptions, which we refer to as forms of "knowledge expression". We first assess open-source pretrained models using 199 curated category-feature pairs and analyze their training data. Our findings suggest that strengthening context and category-feature co-occurrence likelihood (PMI) improve learning for larger models and verbatim rule-like statements diminish flexible category learning. To systematically isolate these effects, we then train a 68M model from scratch with precise control over the categorical information each sees in their training data, confirming that verbatim repetition reduces flexible learning but mixture of diverse knowledge expressions lead to more robust category learning. Together, our findings highlight that while contextual flexibility is persistently difficult for models, how category knowledge is expressed in pretraining greatly impacts models' acquisition of robust category knowledge.

translation.title: LECAT：衡量LLM从预训练数据中学习类别知识
translation.abstract: 人类知道飞机很快，这一知识可以推广到红色飞机，但不适用于损坏的飞机。LLM如何获得人类能够轻松学习并运用的类别知识？我们提出LeCat，一个由两部分组成的框架，用于分析LLM对类别知识的学习。首先，我们使用LeCat评估模型学习类别知识的能力，区分三种情形：对域内类别知识的记忆、对未见实例的泛化，以及在恰当语境中灵活运用知识的能力。然后，我们使用LeCat追溯这些知识如何在预训练中从可能以各种方式编码类别知识的文本中习得，例如逐字重复或例外情况，我们称之为"知识表达"形式。我们首先使用199个精心整理的类别-特征对评估开源预训练模型并分析其训练数据。发现表明，增强上下文和类别-特征共现可能性（PMI）能提升较大模型的学习效果，而逐字的规则式陈述会削弱灵活的类别学习。为系统性地隔离这些效应，我们随后从零训练一个68M模型，精确控制每个模型在训练数据中看到的类别信息，确认逐字重复会降低灵活学习，而多种知识表达的混合则带来更稳健的类别学习。总之，我们的发现突出表明，尽管语境灵活性对模型始终困难，但类别知识在预训练中的表达方式极大影响模型对稳健类别知识的习得。
translation.brief: 针对LLM类别知识（记忆、泛化与灵活运用）如何从预训练数据中习得尚不清楚的问题，构建LeCat评估框架并通过对68M模型从零训练、精确控制知识表达形式的实验揭示逐字重复损害灵活学习、多样表达促进稳健学习。

papers.title: Efficiency Gains in Social Science Research: A Prospective Silicon Sampling Protocol for Pre-Treatment and Code Optimization
papers.abstract: This study evaluates the methodological potential of using large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic datasets prior to real-world data collection, thereby streamlining subsequent processing and statistical analysis. The approach is applied to a survey conducted within the France Life Imaging (FLI) network, leveraging three distinct LLMs (Sonnet 4.6, GPT 5.3, and Kimi 2.6) to simulate responses and prepare data processing workflows. The findings demonstrate significant time savings in code development (85% to 90% reuse rate) and highlight the conditional validity of this preprocessing method, which depends on the thematic predictability of the models. While synthetic data effectively captures collective perceptions, it struggles with specialized or contextualized practices, reflecting limitations documented in the silicon sampling literature, such as homogenization and reduced variance. This work extends the Phase 0 concept (Trojacka et al. 2025) from instrument validation to a full-fledged methodological preprocessing step, paving the way for scalable applications in survey research.

translation.title: 社会科学研究中的效率提升：用于预处理和代码优化的前瞻性硅采样协议
translation.abstract: 本研究评估了利用大语言模型（LLM）在真实数据收集之前生成合成数据集的方法论潜力，从而简化后续的处理与统计分析。该方法应用于France Life Imaging（FLI）网络内开展的一项调查，利用三个不同的LLM（Sonnet 4.6、GPT 5.3和Kimi 2.6）模拟回答并准备数据处理工作流。研究结果显示代码开发时间显著节省（85%到90%的复用率），并揭示了这种预处理方法的有效性是有条件的，取决于模型的主题可预测性。合成数据能有效捕捉集体认知，但在处理专业化或情境化的实践时表现不佳，反映了硅采样文献中记录的局限性，如同质化和方差降低。这项工作将Phase 0概念（Trojacka et al. 2025）从工具验证扩展为完整的方法论预处理步骤，为调查研究中可扩展的应用铺平了道路。
translation.brief: 针对社会科学调查中数据收集前的代码开发与预处理耗时问题，提出在真实数据收集前用多个LLM生成合成数据（硅采样）以预先构建并验证数据处理流程。

papers.title: CANTraj: Recovering Vehicle Trajectories from CAN Signals in Naturalistic Driving
papers.abstract: Open driving releases and usage-based insurance programs often claim to prevent privacy breaches by omitting GPS records when sharing or collecting vehicle data. However, removing GPS coordinates from driving logs does not erase the location information carried by vehicle signals. While prior route-inference attacks have demonstrated that speed, steering, and driving events can be matched to road networks to reconstruct trajectories, existing studies rely on inconsistent prior assumptions and evaluation metrics and are tested only on small, restricted datasets, making their results difficult to compare and their real-world effectiveness uncertain. We release CANTraj, a naturalistic driving dataset pairing decoded CAN events with time-aligned GNSS trajectories (3,940 drives, 454 drivers), and CANTraj-Bench for evaluating trajectory recovery (3,675 drives, 431 drivers, 1,380 hours, 85,919 km). On 776 evaluation drives from 94 unseen drivers, we compare six re-implemented attacks and benchmark baselines under explicit information-access protocols, paired comparisons, and metrics incorporating failures. Experiments show that combining steering signals with road-network constraints yields the largest gain: With a known start and heading, adding steering to speed raises the online map filter's five-minute route recovery from 56% to 87%, with a median average displacement error of 43 m versus 921 m for map-free dead reckoning. Offline beam search recovers 88% of test routes with the heading and 81% without it. Because methods fail on different windows, we also evaluate an LLM harness that selects among candidate routes on 659 five-minute windows; its best configuration recovers 79% of routes on test and 83% on few-shot, outperforming the best baseline on test and matching it on few-shot. Data and code at this http URL and this http URL.

translation.title: CANTraj：从自然驾驶 CAN 信号中恢复车辆轨迹
translation.abstract: 开放驾驶数据发布和基于用量的保险项目通常声称在共享或收集车辆数据时省略 GPS 记录即可防止隐私泄露。然而，从驾驶日志中删除 GPS 坐标并不能消除车辆信号所携带的位置信息。尽管先前的路线推断攻击已经证明可以将速度、转向和驾驶事件与路网匹配以重建轨迹，但现有研究依赖于不一致的先验假设和评估指标，且仅在小型受限数据集上测试，导致结果难以比较、其实际有效性不确定。我们发布了 CANTraj，一个将解码后的 CAN 事件与时间对齐的 GNSS 轨迹配对的自然驾驶数据集（3,940 次驾驶，454 名驾驶员），以及用于评估轨迹恢复的 CANTraj-Bench（3,675 次驾驶，431 名驾驶员，1,380 小时，85,919 公里）。在来自 94 名未见驾驶员的 776 次评估驾驶中，我们在明确的信息访问协议、配对比较和纳入失败的指标下比较了六种重新实现的攻击并测试基准方法。实验表明，将转向信号与路网约束相结合收益最大：在已知起点和航向的情况下，在速度基础上加入转向可将在线地图滤波器的五分钟路线恢复率从 56% 提升至 87%，中位平均位移误差为 43 米，而无需地图的航位推算为 921 米。离线束搜索在已知航向时恢复 88% 的测试路线，未知航向时恢复 81%。由于不同方法在不同时间窗上失败，我们还在 659 个五分钟窗口上评估了一个在候选路线间进行选择的 LLM 框架；其最佳配置在测试集上恢复 79% 的路线，few-shot 上恢复 83%，在测试集上超越最佳基线，在 few-shot 上与之持平。数据与代码见此 URL 与此 URL。
translation.brief: 研究仅凭 CAN 信号（无 GPS）能否恢复车辆轨迹，通过发布大规模自然驾驶数据集 CANTraj 并系统评测多种轨迹恢复攻击，发现转向信号与路网约束结合效果最佳。

papers.title: HerAgent: A Block-Level Checkpointing Harness for Coding-Agent Environment Setup
papers.abstract: Modern coding agents rely on establishing executable software environments before they can perform software engineering tasks such as testing, debugging, and patch validation. Existing setup agents typically control progress at either single-command or whole-script granularity, making recovery either too local to remove polluted state or too coarse to preserve useful progress. We present HerAgent (Harness EnviRonment Setup Agent), a block-level harness for coding-agent environment setup. HerAgent's main contribution is semantic setup blocks: a single progress-control abstraction used for execution, validation, checkpointing, repair, and rollback. Evaluated against six prior agents on four environment-setup datasets, HerAgent improves setup success in every comparison, achieving the largest gains on Installamatic-Bench (52.0% to 85.0%) and SetupBench (46.3% to 70.4%). It also reduces setup costs by up to 94.5%, showing that block-level progress control improves reliability and efficiency.

translation.title: HerAgent：面向编码智能体环境搭建的块级检查点框架
translation.abstract: 现代编码智能体在执行测试、调试和补丁验证等软件工程任务之前，需要先建立可执行的软件环境。现有的环境搭建智能体通常以单条命令或整个脚本为粒度控制进度，使得恢复要么过于局部而无法清除受污染的状态，要么过于粗糙而无法保留有用进度。我们提出 HerAgent（Harness EnviRonment Setup Agent），一个面向编码智能体环境搭建的块级框架。HerAgent 的主要贡献是语义搭建块（semantic setup blocks）：一个用于执行、验证、检查点、修复和回滚的统一进度控制抽象。在四个环境搭建数据集上与六个已有智能体对比评估，HerAgent 在所有比较中都提升了搭建成功率，在 Installamatic-Bench（52.0% 提升至 85.0%）和 SetupBench（46.3% 提升至 70.4%）上收益最大。它还将搭建成本降低多达 94.5%，表明块级进度控制提高了可靠性和效率。
translation.brief: 针对编码智能体环境搭建中恢复粒度过粗或过细的问题，提出以语义搭建块为统一进度控制单元的块级检查点与回滚框架 HerAgent。

papers.title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
papers.abstract: Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble methods deliver this aleatoric/epistemic decomposition in principle, but are computationally prohibitive at LLM scale and require white-box access. Existing black-box methods, in contrast, summarize to a single scalar that cannot make the distinction. We introduce a two-level ensemble that bridges this gap. Stochastic decoding of a fixed prompt forms the inner ensemble; meaning-preserving semantic perturbations of the prompt form the outer ensemble. Variability is measured in a continuous embedding space, and the law of total covariance gives an exact within-/between-perturbation decomposition to estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty (AU/EU); it requires only black-box sampling access. On top of this estimator, we contribute three theoretical results that ground the framework: (i) a finite-sample bias identity for nested Monte Carlo with a closed-form bias-corrected epistemic estimator; (ii) a Bayesian bridge bounding the gap between perturbation-population AU/EU and Bayesian targets; and (iii) a separation result identifying a class of failure modes that any consistency-only black-box method provably misses while perturbation-based EU detects. Across five short QA benchmarks and four instruction-tuned LLMs spanning two families and two scales, our estimator is competitive with strong white-box baselines, and at a matched generation budget it matches leading black-box methods on error ranking while decomposing AU and EU; controlled paired interventions show that AU and EU respond selectively to distinct, actionable sources of failure: prompt ambiguity and model knowledge gaps; and a long-form pilot on the NQ long-answer split shows the framework extends to claim-level factuality without retraining.

translation.title: 基于集成之集成的大语言模型黑盒不确定性量化
translation.abstract: 可靠地使用大语言模型（LLM）需要能区分提示词固有歧义与真实知识缺口的不确定性估计。贝叶斯与深度集成方法原则上可提供这种偶然/认知不确定性分解，但在 LLM 规模下计算代价过高且需要白盒访问。现有黑盒方法则只能汇总为单一标量，无法做出区分。我们引入一个弥合此差距的两级集成。对固定提示词的随机解码构成内层集成；对提示词的保义语义扰动构成外层集成。变异性在连续嵌入空间中度量，全协方差定律给出精确的扰动内/间分解，以估计偶然与认知不确定性（AU/EU）；它仅需黑盒采样访问。在该估计器之上，我们贡献了三项支撑该框架的理论结果：(i) 嵌套蒙特卡洛的有限样本偏差恒等式及闭式偏差校正认知估计器；(ii) 一个贝叶斯桥梁，约束扰动总体 AU/EU 与贝叶斯目标之间的差距；(iii) 一个分离结果，识别出一类任何仅基于一致性（consistency-only）的黑盒方法可证明无法检测、而基于扰动的 EU 可检测的失败模式。在五个短问答基准和跨越两个家族、两个规模的四个指令微调 LLM 上，我们的估计器与强白盒基线相当，且在相同生成预算下在错误排序上匹配领先的黑盒方法，同时分解 AU 与 EU；受控配对干预表明 AU 和 EU 对不同、可操作的失败来源（提示词歧义与模型知识缺口）有选择性响应；在 NQ 长答案子集上的长文本初步实验表明该框架无需再训练即可扩展至论断级事实性。
translation.brief: 针对黑盒 LLM 无法区分偶然与认知不确定性的问题，提出内外两级集成（随机解码+语义扰动）并在嵌入空间用全协方差定律分解 AU/EU 的估计框架及理论保证。

papers.title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
papers.abstract: Clinical world models expose language-model agents to predicted patient responses, but simulations can be unreliable for poorly supported treatments or unfamiliar hospitals. We introduce Support-Gated World-Model decision support, a lightweight extension of a propose--simulate--refine agent. A recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts short-horizon physiological responses to documented norepinephrine dose categories, while a behavior model estimates observational action support. The interface withholds predictions with insufficient support or excessive ensemble disagreement and abstains when no candidate qualifies. Evaluation on eICU-CRD includes 70 hospitals and 30,700 decision transitions, with 14 hospitals held out for testing. At 62.0% factual-transition coverage, joint gating yields a MAP mean absolute error of 7.3 mmHg, compared with 9.2 mmHg for random selection at the same coverage. The gated agent achieves 60.0% agreement with recorded actions at 81.0% decision coverage, compared with 55.0% agreement and 99.5% coverage for an ungated ensemble agent. Component ablations show lower factual risk with joint gating than with either gate this http URL results characterize a reliability--coverage trade-off in selective clinical simulation; they do not identify individualized treatment effects or establish improved patient outcomes.

translation.title: 何时信任模拟患者响应：面向升压药决策支持的支持门控世界模型
translation.abstract: 临床世界模型让语言模型智能体接触预测的患者响应，但对于支持不足的治疗或不熟悉的医院，模拟可能不可靠。我们提出支持门控世界模型决策支持，这是提出-模拟-精炼智能体的一个轻量扩展。一个循环动力学集成预测对已记录去甲肾上腺素剂量类别的短程生理响应，同时一个行为模型估计观察性动作支持度。该接口对支持不足或集成分歧过大的预测不予提供，并在无候选方案合格时选择弃权。在 eICU-CRD 上的评估涵盖 70 家医院和 30,700 次决策转移，其中 14 家医院留作测试。在 62.0% 的事实转移覆盖率下，联合门控实现 7.3 mmHg 的 MAP 平均绝对误差，而相同覆盖率下随机选择为 9.2 mmHg。门控智能体在 81.0% 决策覆盖率下与记录动作达成 60.0% 的一致性，而无门控集成智能体为 55.0% 一致性和 99.5% 覆盖率。组件消融显示联合门控比任一单独门控具有更低的事实风险。这些结果刻画了选择性临床模拟中的可靠性-覆盖率权衡；它们并不识别个体化治疗效果或证明患者结局的改善。
translation.brief: 针对临床世界模型对支持不足的治疗方案模拟不可靠的问题，提出用行为支持度门控与集成分歧门控来决定何时提供和信任模拟患者响应的决策支持框架。

papers.title: Callo: Serving Cache-Miss Requests with Speculative Decoding on Invalidated KV under Prefill-Decode Disaggregation
papers.abstract: Agent sessions may involve frequent context edits, which effectively invalidate cached KV state and force requests to wait for re-prefill before decoding. We present Callo, a disaggregated serving system that leverages invalidated KV for speculative drafts to reduce this latency, while verifying drafts against the exact KV after prefill before committing tokens. Callo makes effective use of decode resources by scheduling speculations during periods of underutilization and preempting speculations when drafts are likely to not be accepted. We evaluated Callo on a two-GPU testbed using SWE-agent sessions across three model families, observing all-request speedups of 1.05-1.19x over vLLM at moderate load. We demonstrate that these gains are also realized at scale through cluster-level simulations driven by real-world traces.

translation.title: Callo：在 Prefill-Decode 分离架构下基于失效 KV 进行投机解码以服务缓存未命中请求
translation.abstract: 智能体会话可能涉及频繁的上下文编辑，这会使缓存的 KV 状态失效，迫使请求在解码前等待重新 prefill。我们提出 Callo，一个利用失效 KV 生成投机草稿以降低此延迟的分离式服务系统，同时在提交 token 前用 prefill 后的精确 KV 验证草稿。Callo 通过在解码资源利用率低时调度投机、在草稿可能不被接受时抢占投机，高效利用解码资源。我们在双 GPU 测试床上使用三个模型家族的 SWE-agent 会话评估了 Callo，观察到在中等负载下相比 vLLM 所有请求获得 1.05-1.19 倍加速。通过由真实轨迹驱动的集群级模拟，我们证明这些收益在规模化场景下同样成立。
translation.brief: 针对上下文编辑导致 KV 缓存失效后需重新 prefill 而产生高延迟的问题，提出在 prefill-decode 分离架构下利用失效 KV 做投机解码并在 prefill 后验证提交的 Callo 服务系统。

papers.title: Disenfranchisement in Spatial Voting Games
papers.abstract: The questions of voting rights, group membership, and the boundaries of acceptable discourse all involve a recursive, self-stability issue, wherein the voters, group members, and acceptable commentators are often the ultimate arbiters of their own rules for inclusion and exclusion. In order to understand how ideological or issue diversity may impact the stability of such inclusion and exclusion, we introduce franchise elections, where voting members of a group vote to change the electorate. In particular, when agents are positioned inside an ideological or issue space, a social choice function that aggregates agent viewpoints induces a preference for agents over group composition, where agents prefer groups that improve the social choice function outcome for them. We demonstrate that when ideological space is two-dimensional, these franchise elections can generate complex behavior and that this complexity exists for any social choice function. Using the Yolk social choice function from voting theory, we illustrate that franchise elections can predict that agents attempting to introduce a new ideological axis perpendicular to an existing left-right spectrum risk disenfranchisement unless they ally with either side of the spectrum, and that franchise elections can cycle with any period.

translation.title: 空间投票博弈中的选举权剥夺
translation.abstract: 投票权、群体成员资格以及可接受言论边界等问题都涉及一个递归的自稳定性问题：投票者、群体成员和可接受的评论者往往是对自身纳入与排除规则的最终裁决者。为了理解意识形态或议题多样性如何影响这种纳入与排除的稳定性，我们引入了特许选举（franchise elections），即群体的投票成员通过投票来改变选民构成。特别地，当智能体位于意识形态或议题空间中时，聚合智能体观点的社会选择函数会诱导智能体对群体构成的偏好，即智能体偏好能改善社会选择函数结果的群体。我们证明，当意识形态空间是二维的时，这类特许选举可以产生复杂行为，且这种复杂性存在于任何社会选择函数中。借助投票理论中的 Yolk 社会选择函数，我们说明特许选举可以预测：试图在既有左-右光谱上引入一条垂直的新意识形态轴的智能体，除非与光谱的某一方结盟，否则将面临被剥夺选举权的风险；同时特许选举可以以任意周期循环。
translation.brief: 研究意识形态空间中的群体成员纳入与排除的自稳定性问题，通过引入特许选举模型并分析任意社会选择函数下的复杂动力学来刻画选举权剥夺现象。

papers.title: Do Verifier Judgments Survive Abstraction? Measuring Verification Transport for LLM Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract: LLM-based verifiers are increasingly used to evaluate agent executions, but their reliability is typically measured under a single representation of the trajectory. In deployed agent systems, the same execution may be exposed through composed tools, delegation boundaries, or compacted histories, changing what execution evidence is directly observable to the verifier. It therefore remains unclear whether correct verifier judgments persist across such abstraction boundaries. We introduce Verification Transport, a reliability test that measures judgment stability under abstraction-induced changes in execution observability. We construct matched native, abstracted, and restored views of the same frozen executions while holding the task, realized trajectory, outcome, ground truth, evaluation criterion, and verifier fixed. Across four agent-evaluation benchmarks, seven verifier backbones, four verification protocols, and three abstraction boundaries, we find substantial transport failure, reaching about 31% under macro abstraction and delegation. Verification protocols exhibit distinct failure modes: direct verification more often produces incorrect verdicts, whereas evidence-grounded and deliberative protocols tend to abstain under limited observability. This suggests that lower transport failure rates do not necessarily imply greater reliability. Restoring the corresponding execution provenance recovers 85.5% of transport failures, while recovery is lower when provenance is lossy or unavailable. These results show that native-view accuracy alone is insufficient to characterize verifier reliability when execution evidence crosses abstraction boundaries.

translation.title: 验证器判断能在抽象化后幸存吗？度量用于 LLM 智能体评估的验证迁移性
translation.abstract: 基于 LLM 的验证器越来越多地被用于评估智能体执行，但其可靠性通常只在单一轨迹表示下衡量。在部署的智能体系统中，同一执行可能通过组合工具、委派边界或压缩历史来呈现，这改变了验证器可直接观察到的执行证据。因此，正确的验证器判断能否在这些抽象边界之间保持尚不清楚。我们提出验证迁移性（Verification Transport），一种在抽象导致的执行可观察性变化下度量判断稳定性的可靠性测试。我们在保持任务、实际轨迹、结果、真值、评估标准和验证器不变的情况下，构造同一冻结执行的匹配原生、抽象和还原视图。在四个智能体评估基准、七种验证器骨干、四种验证协议和三个抽象边界上，我们发现大量迁移失败，在宏观抽象和委派下达到约 31%。验证协议表现出不同的失败模式：直接验证更常产生错误判定，而基于证据和审议型协议在可观察性受限时倾向于弃权。这表明较低的迁移失败率不一定意味着更高的可靠性。还原相应的执行溯源可恢复 85.5% 的迁移失败，而当溯源有损或不可得时恢复率更低。这些结果表明，当执行证据跨越抽象边界时，仅凭原生视图准确率不足以刻画验证器的可靠性。
translation.brief: 提出 Verification Transport 测试以度量 LLM 验证器判断在抽象边界下的稳定性，通过构造同一执行的原生、抽象与还原视图来量化迁移失败及其与验证协议和执行溯源的关系。

papers.title: Interactive Program Induction with Language Model Priors
papers.abstract: Program induction refers to the process in which a learner aims to recover a program from a few given input-output examples. This paradigm broadens programming access by letting users demonstrate the rule-based behavior they want to apply to unseen data, instead of having to implement it themselves. However, recovering a program from finite input-output examples is fundamentally ambiguous, as a finite set of input-output examples is theoretically consistent with infinitely many programs whose output diverges on unseen inputs. We view this problem from a Bayesian perspective, where, given a prior $p^0$ over programs, identifying the target program means concentrating posterior probability mass on it by observing additional input-output examples. In the interactive program induction setting, the learner chooses maximally informative inputs and queries an oracle, such as the user, for their outputs. We derive a greedy query-selection algorithm and show that it terminates after $\mathcal{O}(\frac{1}{\gamma}\log 1/p^0(f^\star))$ informative oracle queries, and returns the target program $f^\star$ up to approximate equivalence when no other class outweighs it under the prior. The algorithm uses a language model as the prior under a PAC-style relaxation of program equivalence, where the query-selection objective is estimated using importance sampling. On the CodeARC benchmark, the algorithm improves accuracy over the LM only agent by up to 22 percentage points while observing up to 10.5 fewer input-output examples.

translation.title: 基于语言模型先验的交互式程序归纳
translation.abstract: 程序归纳是指学习者试图从少量给定输入输出示例中恢复程序的过程。这一范式通过让用户演示希望应用于未见数据的规则行为，而不是自行实现，拓宽了编程的可达性。然而，从有限的输入输出示例中恢复程序本质上是歧义的，因为有限示例在理论上与无穷多个在未见输入上输出发散的程序相一致。我们从贝叶斯视角看待该问题：给定程序上的先验 $p^0$，识别目标程序意味着通过观察额外的输入输出示例将后验概率质量集中于其上。在交互式程序归纳设定中，学习者选择最大信息量的输入并向预言机（如用户）查询其输出。我们推导了一个贪心查询选择算法，并证明其在 $\mathcal{O}(\frac{1}{\gamma}\log 1/p^0(f^\star))$ 次信息量预言机查询后终止，且当没有其他程序类在先验下超过它时，返回近似等价意义下的目标程序 $f^\star$。该算法在 PAC 风格的程序等价松弛下使用语言模型作为先验，查询选择目标用重要性采样估计。在 CodeARC 基准上，该算法相比仅 LM 的智能体将准确率提升最多 22 个百分点，同时少观察最多 10.5 个输入输出示例。
translation.brief: 研究从有限输入输出示例恢复程序的歧义问题，提出以语言模型为先验的贪心查询选择算法，通过交互式向预言机查询信息量输入来收敛到目标程序。

papers.title: TradeGauntlet: Evaluating Compliance Controls for Autonomous Trading Agents
papers.abstract: Autonomous trading agents need controls that prevent problematic orders without making legitimate tasks impractical. We study this aspect of agentic compliance with TradeGauntlet, a replayable limit-order-book simulator that separates detection, prevention, and execution cost. In 1,680 simulated sessions with Claude Haiku 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, all conduct alerts were self-matches. Gates eliminated those alerts by rejecting self-crossing orders, while the aggregate-gate condition reduced Sonnet's two-sided fills by about 15%. A conduct reminder reduced Sonnet's alert rate but reduced Haiku's fills without a detectable alert benefit. These results show why zero alerts alone do not establish an agent's compliance. Scripted probes and two search methods test weaknesses beyond those observed in the LLM runs. The searches find split-order schedules that evade the implemented conduct rules; a learned baseline catches all 2,400 tested searched episodes but also flags 15% of a large maker's sessions. Aggregate caps reduce the response-dependent gain unevenly, with smaller reductions when only near-touch depth affects prices. A response fitted to five Nasdaq stocks and a separate ABIDES experiment expose the dependence of these estimates on market assumptions. A distinct adversarial prompt elicited refusals from Sonnet in all 240 rounds, yielding no candidate strategies to evaluate. TradeGauntlet provides reproducible tests of controls around trading agents; the experiments do not establish legal compliance or real-market detection accuracy.

translation.title: TradeGauntlet：评估自主交易智能体的合规控制
translation.abstract: 自主交易智能体需要既能阻止问题订单又不让合法任务无法完成的控制措施。我们用 TradeGauntlet 研究智能体合规的这一侧面，这是一个可重放的限价订单簿模拟器，将检测、预防和执行成本分离。在 1,680 次使用 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 Sonnet 5.5 的模拟会话中，所有行为警报均为自成交（self-match）。闸门通过拒绝自交叉订单消除了这些警报，而聚合闸门条件使 Sonnet 的双边成交减少约 15%。行为提醒降低了 Sonnet 的警报率，却减少了 Haiku 的成交且未见警报收益。这些结果表明为何仅凭零警报不能确立智能体的合规性。脚本化探针和两种搜索方法测试了 LLM 运行中未观察到的弱点。搜索发现了规避所实施行为规则的拆单计划；一个学习到的基线捕获了全部 2,400 个被测搜索回合，但也误报了某大做市商会话的 15%。聚合上限对响应依赖收益的削减不均匀，当仅近档深度影响价格时削减更小。基于五只 Nasdaq 股票拟合的响应和独立的 ABIDES 实验表明这些估计依赖于市场假设。一个独特的对抗性提示在全部 240 轮中均使 Sonnet 拒绝响应，未产生可供评估的候选策略。TradeGauntlet 为交易智能体周边的控制提供了可复现的测试；这些实验不确立法律合规或真实市场检测精度。
translation.brief: 研究自主交易智能体的合规控制问题，构建可重放限价订单簿模拟器 TradeGauntlet，分离检测、预防与执行成本并用模拟、探针与搜索方法测试控制措施的有效性与可规避性。

papers.title: Agentic induction of common data elements and information extraction from sarcoma case report abstracts
papers.abstract: Common data elements (CDEs) support clinical data comparability but are usually defined manually. We investigated whether large language model agents could derive a CDE schema from sarcoma case report abstracts and apply it at scale. An agent proposed 72,909 candidate CDEs from 24,588 PubMed abstracts; agentic consolidation yielded 1,570 CDEs. We retained 53 supported by at least 50 abstracts and attempted evidence-linked extraction across the corpus. Processing succeeded for all retained CDEs in 79.2% of abstracts, including responses indicating non-mention. Two human reviewers approved 83.0% of retained CDEs for relevance, 67.9% for clarity, and 56.6% for correctness. In 100 sampled abstracts, exact agreement with the value extracted by the LLM was 94.9% among 1,116 pairs with a non-empty answer (abstract-level bootstrap 95% CI, 93.0-96.4%). Errors concentrated in anatomical and temporal fields. These findings support agent-assisted schema drafting followed by expert curation before large-scale extraction.

translation.title: 智能体驱动的通用数据要素归纳与肉瘤病例报告摘要的信息抽取
translation.abstract: 通用数据要素（CDE）支持临床数据的可比性，但通常需人工定义。我们研究大语言模型智能体能否从肉瘤病例报告摘要中推导 CDE 模式并大规模应用。一个智能体从 24,588 篇 PubMed 摘要中提出了 72,909 个候选 CDE；经智能体整合得到 1,570 个 CDE。我们保留了至少得到 50 篇摘要支持的 53 个，并在整个语料上尝试证据关联的抽取。79.2% 的摘要中全部保留 CDE 的处理成功，包括指示未提及的响应。两名人类评审对保留 CDE 的相关性、清晰性和正确性的认可率分别为 83.0%、67.9% 和 56.6%。在 100 篇抽样摘要中，在 1,116 个非空答案对中与 LLM 抽取值的完全一致率为 94.9%（摘要级 bootstrap 95% CI 为 93.0-96.4%）。错误集中在解剖和时间字段。这些发现支持先由智能体辅助起草模式，再在大规模抽取前由专家进行人工校订。
translation.brief: 研究 CDE 模式依赖人工定义的问题，用 LLM 智能体从肉瘤病例报告摘要自动归纳并整合 CDE，再进行大规模证据关联抽取并由专家校订。

papers.title: MeReader: An Offline, Privacy-Preserving, Progress-Aware AI Assistant for Narrative eBook Reading
papers.abstract: This paper introduces MeReader, a privacy-preserving, offline and progress-aware AI assistant designed to function as a contextual companion for narrative reading on consumer hardware. Unlike conventional Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems that process documents/books online in an all-texts-at-once type of way, thereby risking narrative spoilers, MeReader confines both retrieval and generation to the reader's distinct position in the text. The system integrates a hybrid retrieval architecture, combining vector similarity, BM25, and summary embeddings, to ensure high fidelity to the reader's current context. We evaluate the system across classical English books using both quantitative comprehension metrics and qualitative LLM-based independent judging. The results identify a quality-latency frontier, showing that mid-sized local models (2b-4b) can achieve comprehension parity with larger counterparts (5b+) while maintaining acceptable response quality. Importantly, the proposed progress-aware boundary mechanism is shown to prevent future content leakage without compromising retrieval quality and correctness. These findings suggest that a localized, privacy-centric approach can augment, rather than replace, the digital reading experience, offering a good alternative to cloud-dependent services. Therein, there remains a lack of amalgamate systems which combine progress-aware, privacy-preserving, and narrative eBook reading with AI support. It is in this very gap that the development of MeReader came to be; synthesizing said strands into an offline, book-constrained assistant focused on enhancing comprehension without compromising narrative continuity or user privacy.

translation.title: MeReader：面向叙事类电子书阅读的离线、隐私保护、进度感知 AI 助手
translation.abstract: 本文介绍了 MeReader，一个隐私保护、离线且进度感知的 AI 助手，旨在消费级硬件上充当叙事阅读的情境化伴侣。与传统的大型语言模型（LLM）系统以一次性处理全部文本的在线方式处理文档/书籍、从而冒着剧透风险不同，MeReader 将检索和生成都限制在读者在文本中的当前位置。该系统集成了混合检索架构，结合向量相似度、BM25 和摘要嵌入，以确保对读者当前上下文的高保真度。我们使用定量理解指标和基于 LLM 的定性独立评审，在经典英文书籍上评估了该系统。结果揭示了一条质量-延迟边界，表明中等规模的本地模型（2b-4b）能够实现与更大模型（5b+）相当的理解能力，同时保持可接受的响应质量。重要的是，所提出的进度感知边界机制被证明可以在不损害检索质量和正确性的情况下防止未来内容泄露。这些发现表明，本地化、以隐私为中心的方法可以增强而非取代数字阅读体验，为依赖云的服务提供了良好的替代方案。然而，目前仍缺乏将进度感知、隐私保护与 AI 支持的叙事电子书阅读相结合的整合系统。正是在这一空白中，MeReader 应运而生；它将上述各要素融合为一个离线的、以书籍为约束的助手，专注于增强理解能力而不损害叙事连贯性或用户隐私。
translation.brief: 为解决 AI 辅助电子书阅读中的剧透与隐私问题，提出在本地将检索与生成限制在读者当前阅读进度的 MeReader 系统。

papers.title: Can Mechanistic Interpretability Help Explain LLM Agent Failures? A Case Study on Web Element Hallucination
papers.abstract: Mechanistic Interpretability (MI) has made significant progress in explaining the internal computations of Large Language Models (LLMs); however, these advances have yet to demonstrate comparable success in explaining the decision-making processes of LLM-based agents. This paper examines the challenges MI tools face when applied to realistic agentic failures. We focus on one such failure: web agents hallucinating actions that are not available on a website. We apply a series of mechanistic analyzes to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct as it interacts with live websites. We find that a linear probe trained on the last prompt token can predict hallucinations before generation begins (0.80 AUC) and steering along a probe direction corrects 85\% of hallucinations, but disrupts 7\% of valid actions. However, these results only provide a partial explanation of why the agent hallucinates. The probe direction is sensitive to prompt formatting, losing much of its steering effect after a minor change to how actions are represented. Additionally, circuit identification can be difficult as the computation is distributed across multiple components and positions, and the information the agent relies on varies across examples. We discuss how these observations challenge the assumptions underlying standard MI methods for circuit discovery and feature identification, and outline future directions for making these methods better suited to explain failures in LLM-based agents.

translation.title: 机制可解释性能否帮助解释 LLM 智能体的失败？网页元素幻觉案例研究
translation.abstract: 机制可解释性（MI）在解释大型语言模型（LLM）的内部计算方面已取得显著进展；然而，这些进展尚未在解释基于 LLM 的智能体的决策过程方面展现出同等的成功。本文考察了 MI 工具应用于现实智能体失败时所面临的挑战。我们关注其中一种失败：网页智能体幻觉出网站上并不存在的操作。我们对 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 与真实网站交互的过程进行了系列机制分析。我们发现，在最后一个提示 token 上训练的线性探针可以在生成开始前预测幻觉（0.80 AUC），沿探针方向进行引导可纠正 85% 的幻觉，但会破坏 7% 的有效操作。然而，这些结果只能部分解释智能体为何产生幻觉。探针方向对提示格式敏感，在对操作表示方式进行微小改动后，其引导效果大部分丧失。此外，由于计算分布在多个组件和位置上，且智能体依赖的信息因示例而异，电路识别可能十分困难。我们讨论了这些观察如何挑战标准 MI 方法在电路发现和特征识别方面的底层假设，并概述了使这些方法更适合解释基于 LLM 的智能体失败的未来方向。
translation.brief: 研究机制可解释性工具在解释 LLM 网页智能体幻觉出不存在的网页操作这一失败时的能力与局限，采用线性探针预测与引导并结合电路分析。

papers.title: StreamEmbed: Real-Time Indexing from Pixels for Screenshot Retrieval
papers.abstract: Screen history can serve as searchable visual memory for people and agents, but unlike an offline corpus, it must be encoded and indexed as each screenshot arrives. OCR-based indexing is fast but loses visual information; visual encoding takes over two seconds. Yet screens change incrementally: most pixels repeat within and across screenshots. This raises a question: do visual encoders need to recompute their representations from scratch for every new screenshot? We present StreamEmbed, a system for incremental visual embedding that exploits this redundancy. Guided solely by pixel differences, it combines spatial token pruning, which skips blocks that repeat a neighbor, with temporal KV reuse, which reuses cached keys and values for blocks unchanged across screenshots. A small learned adapter compensates for pruning and reuse to preserve fidelity to full-screenshot embeddings. On ScreenMemEval, our benchmark of 10,426 questions over 184 hours of screen histories from two humans and a computer-use agent, StreamEmbed sets a new accuracy-latency Pareto frontier on an M2 Pro GPU: it encodes up to 3.7x faster than full-screenshot encoding without sacrificing accuracy and improves accuracy over OCR-based indexing by up to 6.3 Recall@10 points at matched latency. A memory-efficient vector index stores a simulated year of screenshots in 0.13 GB of RAM. Together, these results make real-time indexing of screen history in its native visual form practical, laying a foundation for fully local visual assistants.

translation.title: StreamEmbed：从像素出发的实时截图检索索引
translation.abstract: 屏幕历史可以作为人类和智能体可搜索的视觉记忆，但与离线语料库不同，它必须在每张截图到达时即被编码和索引。基于 OCR 的索引速度快但丢失视觉信息；视觉编码则需超过两秒。然而屏幕是渐进变化的：大多数像素在截图内部和截图之间重复。这引出一个问题：视觉编码器是否需要为每张新截图从头重新计算表示？我们提出了 StreamEmbed，一个利用这种冗余的增量视觉嵌入系统。它仅由像素差异驱动，结合了跳过与相邻块重复块的空间 token 剪枝，以及为跨截图未变化块复用缓存键值的时间性 KV 复用。一个小型学习适配器对剪枝和复用进行补偿，以保持与全截图嵌入的一致性。在 ScreenMemEval（我们基于两个人类用户和一个计算机使用智能体共 184 小时屏幕历史构建的 10,426 个问题的基准）上，StreamEmbed 在 M2 Pro GPU 上建立了新的精度-延迟 Pareto 前沿：编码速度最高比全截图编码快 3.7 倍且不损失精度，在相同延迟下相比基于 OCR 的索引最高提升 6.3 个 Recall@10 点。一个内存高效的向量索引仅用 0.13 GB 内存即可存储模拟一年的截图。这些结果共同使以原生视觉形式实时索引屏幕历史成为现实，为完全本地的视觉助手奠定了基础。
translation.brief: 为解决截图流式编码过慢的问题，提出利用像素冗余进行增量 token 剪枝与 KV 复用的 StreamEmbed 增量视觉嵌入系统。

papers.title: OpenLayout: An Open and Agentic-Driven Platform for Holistic VLSI Physical Design and Benchmarking
papers.abstract: Physical design automation of very large-scale integrated circuits (VLSI) has made significant strides, progressing from single-stage placement and routing toward increasingly integrated full-flow implementation. Yet, existing approaches struggle with the vast design space optimization (DSO) arising from diverse technology nodes, circuit designs, and varied constraints. The substantial runtime of physical-design tools further exacerbates this challenge, leaving industrial workflows heavily dependent on experienced engineers to navigate the design space and achieve power, performance, and area (PPA) targets, incurring significant engineering effort. We argue that large language models (LLMs) with strong reasoning capabilities, enriched with distilled human design expertise, offer a promising path toward efficient and automated DSO. Unlike traditional algorithms, LLMs can interpret complex design contexts and naturally incorporate human expertise expressed in natural language for reasoning, acting, observing, and adapting throughout the design process, a capability that conventional optimization methods cannot exploit. To this end, we present OpenLayout, an agentic platform that leverages multi-agent collaboration with embedded design knowledge to enable self-iterative DSO. We further introduce OpenLayout-Bench, a benchmark targeting advanced technology nodes with commercial EDA tools to systematically evaluate physical design automation capabilities of LLMs. Experimental results demonstrate that OpenLayout achieves state-of-the-art performance, with approximately 20% accuracy improvement over baseline methods. Our work is open-sourced at this https URL

translation.title: OpenLayout：面向整体 VLSI 物理设计与基准测试的开放智能体驱动平台
translation.abstract: 超大规模集成电路（VLSI）的物理设计自动化已取得长足进步，从单阶段的布局布线逐步发展为日益集成的全流程实现。然而，现有方法难以应对由多样化工艺节点、电路设计和各种约束带来的庞大设计空间优化（DSO）难题。物理设计工具庞大的运行时间进一步加剧了这一挑战，使工业流程严重依赖经验丰富的工程师来探索设计空间并达成功耗、性能和面积（PPA）目标，耗费大量工程投入。我们认为，具备强大推理能力并融合了人类设计经验知识的大型语言模型（LLM）为实现高效、自动化的 DSO 提供了一条有前景的路径。与传统算法不同，LLM 能够理解复杂的设计上下文，并自然地融入以自然语言表达的人类专业知识，在整个设计过程中进行推理、行动、观察和调整，这是传统优化方法无法利用的能力。为此，我们提出 OpenLayout，一个利用多智能体协作并嵌入设计知识的智能体平台，以实现自迭代的 DSO。我们还引入了 OpenLayout-Bench，一个针对先进工艺节点并使用商业 EDA 工具的基准，以系统性评估 LLM 的物理设计自动化能力。实验结果表明，OpenLayout 达到了最先进的性能，相比基线方法准确率提升约 20%。我们的工作已在 https URL 开源。
translation.brief: 为解决 VLSI 物理设计空间优化困难的问题，提出利用多智能体协作与内嵌设计知识实现自迭代优化的 OpenLayout 智能体平台及配套基准。

papers.title: Mutable Inference: Architecting LLM Accelerators for Inference-Time Learning
papers.abstract: Long-context LLMs must retain growing histories, but full attention makes each new token increasingly expensive. Inference-time learning (ITL) offers another approach. The model keeps training on the context during inference, retaining what it learns in its weights. Recent work shows that ITL can match full-context attention quality while attending only to a recent fixed-size window. This bounds attention costs but adds Learning (backward computation and weight updates) alongside Prediction (the forward pass) costs. Inference accelerators assume fixed weights, while training accelerators target complete training steps. This work identifies two opportunities. Attention's non-matrix operations leave enough idle matrix capacity for Learning, while selected layers can tolerate delayed weight updates with little quality loss. We exploit both with Learning While Serving (LWS), an inference accelerator architecture that shares compute hardware between latency-critical Prediction and deadline-flexible Learning. Hardware-managed per-layer weight versioning allows Learning to publish updates while in-flight computations read older versions. Resumable reduction blocks let Learning kernels span fragmented idle windows and yield to Prediction, while dedicated softmax-gradient units relieve vector contention. On modeled datacenter and edge NPUs, LWS hides Learning within Prediction, sustaining Prediction-only throughput while preserving 99.3% of fully fresh Learning's quality benefit for TTT-E2E 3B at 128K tokens. Across nine models, LWS achieves 1.6x the throughput of serial execution and 1.3x that of the best prior co-execution architecture. RTL synthesis shows that LWS adds 1.5% to NPU core area without another MAC array. By efficiently turning idle inference capacity into learning capacity, LWS establishes inference-time learning as a first-class workload for future LLM accelerators.

translation.title: 可变推理：面向推理时学习的 LLM 加速器架构
translation.abstract: 长上下文 LLM 必须保留不断增长的历史，但全注意力机制使每个新 token 的成本不断增加。推理时学习（ITL）提供了另一种途径：模型在推理期间持续对上下文进行训练，并将所学保留在权重中。近期工作表明，ITL 在只关注最近的固定大小窗口的情况下，可以达到与全上下文注意力相当的质量。这限定了注意力成本，但在预测（前向传播）成本之外增加了学习（反向计算和权重更新）成本。推理加速器假设权重固定，而训练加速器面向完整的训练步骤。本工作识别出两个机会：注意力的非矩阵运算留下足够的空闲矩阵容量供学习使用，同时选定层可以容忍延迟的权重更新而几乎不损失质量。我们通过 Learning While Serving（LWS）同时利用这两个机会，这是一种在延迟关键的预测和截止期灵活的学习之间共享计算硬件的推理加速器架构。硬件管理的逐层权重版本控制允许学习发布更新的同时，进行中的计算读取旧版本。可恢复的归约块让学习内核能够跨越碎片化的空闲窗口并让位于预测，而专用的 softmax 梯度单元缓解了向量资源竞争。在建模的数据中心和边缘 NPU 上，LWS 将学习隐藏在预测之中，在保持仅预测吞吐量的同时，为 128K token 的 TTT-E2E 3B 保留了 99.3% 的完全新鲜学习的质量收益。在九个模型上，LWS 实现了 1.6 倍于串行执行、1.3 倍于最佳先前协同执行架构的吞吐量。RTL 综合表明，LWS 在不增加额外 MAC 阵列的情况下仅增加 1.5% 的 NPU 核心面积。通过高效地将空闲推理容量转化为学习容量，LWS 确立了推理时学习作为未来 LLM 加速器的一等工作负载的地位。
translation.brief: 为解决推理时学习与推理加速器假设权重固定之间的矛盾，提出在预测与学习间共享硬件并支持逐层权重版本控制的 LWS 加速器架构。

papers.title: WaferTetris: Efficient Freeform Mapping on Wafer-Scale Accelerators
papers.abstract: Wafer-scale accelerators offer massive compute capacity through hundreds of thousands of processing elements (PEs) interconnected across a single wafer, but realizing this potential requires efficient application mapping. Their scale makes programming these systems and mapping applications onto them challenging. Existing approaches rely on template-based mappings to maintain productivity, but these templates restrict the mapping design space. In particular, they impose fixed geometric layouts over the PE grid, often leaving compute and memory resources underutilized. In this work, we present WaferTetris, a system that removes these geometric restrictions through freeform mapping. Its Tetris-like strategy flexibly packs computation across the wafer, improving PE utilization and usable memory capacity while preserving PE-task code. We develop a recurrence-based throughput model that captures branch-and-join dependencies to guide spatial parallelism, and an architecture model with per-color gates that enable existing FPGA place-and-route algorithms to enforce WSE routing constraints. We evaluate WaferTetris on Cerebras WSE-3 using LLM decoding and scientific stencil benchmarks. For LLM decoding, it achieves up to $4.42\times$ the system throughput of a template-based automatic mapping baseline on the same fabric size. Compared with the manually optimized WaferLLM, WaferTetris supports $1.8\times$ the context length for LLaMA3.1-8B (80k versus 44k), while delivering equal or higher per-user throughput at matched context lengths, up to $1.10\times$.

translation.title: WaferTetris：晶圆级加速器上的高效自由形态映射
translation.abstract: 晶圆级加速器通过在单片晶圆上互连数十万个处理单元（PE）提供了巨大的算力，但要发挥这一潜力需要高效的应用映射。其规模使得编程和将应用映射到这类系统上充满挑战。现有方法依赖基于模板的映射来保持生产效率，但这些模板限制了映射设计空间，尤其是它们在PE网格上强加固定的几何布局，常常导致计算和内存资源利用不足。本文提出WaferTetris，一个通过自由形态映射消除这些几何限制的系统。其类Tetris策略灵活地在晶圆上打包计算，在保留PE-任务代码的同时提升PE利用率和可用内存容量。我们开发了基于递归的吞吐量模型以刻画分支-汇合依赖并指导空间并行，还开发了带按颜色门控的架构模型，使现有FPGA布局布线算法能够强制执行WSE路由约束。我们在Cerebras WSE-3上用LLM解码和科学stencil基准评估WaferTetris。对于LLM解码，在相同fabric尺寸下它相比基于模板的自动映射基线实现了最高4.42倍的系统吞吐量。与手工优化的WaferLLM相比，WaferTetris对LLaMA3.1-8B支持1.8倍的上下文长度（80k对44k），且在相同上下文长度下单用户吞吐量持平或更高，最高达1.10倍。
translation.brief: 针对晶圆级加速器上模板式映射浪费计算与内存资源的问题，提出WaferTetris自由形态映射系统，用类Tetris打包策略与递归吞吐量模型提升资源利用率。

papers.title: Alignment by Socialization: Learning Tradeoffs Under Selection
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are expected to complete tasks while following rules of conduct, but these objectives can conflict. We study how evolutionary selection shapes an agent's choices between them, and whether experience can make those choices reflect human judgments and withstand subsequent pressures. In our model, copies of an agent face a common uncertain reward state, and only those taking the rewarded action reproduce. We show that long-run growth is maximized when each action is taken as often as the environment rewards it. We compare three policies. A task-only policy thrives in a sandbox rewarding completion alone but fails when conduct matters. A fixed linear policy increasingly favors task completion as its stakes rise, even where humans never reward it. A learned policy instead converges to the tradeoffs rewarded by its environment; when humans supply the rewards, we call this socialization. Accumulated experience makes socialization harder to reverse under subsequent task-only training, although violations can arise before the prevailing disposition changes, and finite memory weakens this protection. When a single violation can end a deployment, a hard prohibition can prevent it, but a mistaken prohibition can also be costly. Experiments with small neural networks illustrate how training targets and memory shape these outcomes. Our results suggest that alignment depends not only on the objectives assigned to agents, but also on the environments that shape and sustain their behavior.

translation.title: 通过社会化实现对齐：选择压力下学习权衡
translation.abstract: 人工智能（AI）智能体被期望在遵守行为规则的同时完成任务，但这些目标可能相互冲突。我们研究进化选择如何塑造智能体在两者之间的取舍，以及经验能否使这些取舍反映人类判断并承受后续压力。在我们的模型中，智能体的多个副本面对共同的不确定奖励状态，只有采取被奖励动作的副本才能繁衍。我们表明，当每个动作被采取的频率与环境对其的奖励相称时，长期增长最大化。我们比较三种策略。仅任务策略在只奖励完成度的沙盒中繁荣，但在行为规范重要时失败。固定的线性策略随着任务完成度的利害上升而越来越偏向任务完成，即使人类从不奖励它也是如此。学习型策略则收敛到环境所奖励的权衡；当奖励由人类提供时，我们称之为社会化。累积经验使社会化在后续仅任务训练下更难被逆转，尽管违规可能在主导倾向改变之前发生，且有限记忆会削弱这种保护。当单次违规就可能终止部署时，硬性禁令可以阻止它，但错误的禁令也可能代价高昂。小型神经网络的实验展示了训练目标和记忆如何影响这些结果。我们的结果表明，对齐不仅取决于分配给智能体的目标，还取决于塑造和维持其行为的环境。
translation.brief: 研究进化选择如何塑造智能体在任务完成与行为规范间的权衡，提出通过人类奖励塑造的社会化机制使行为对齐并抵御后续训练压力。

papers.title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
papers.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on a harness, the scaffold around the model that decides what it sees of its own interaction and what guidance it receives. Most existing approaches train under a hand-written harness that stays fixed throughout. However, an effective harness depends on the domain, the data and the model, and keeps changing as the model trains. We introduce ModHarness-RL, which recasts the harness as programs that are learned from data and evolve as the model trains with RL. ModHarness-RL records the interaction as structured State, a set of typed blocks, and two core components of the harness are programs over these blocks, a Compression program that assembles the accumulated history into the model's context and a Steering program that supplies guidance when behavior deviates. During RL training, candidate programs are proposed from recent trajectories, verified by execution, and replayed over past trajectories, so the harness tracks how the model's behavior shifts. We study CodeSearch in depth and further analyze ALFWorld and BIRD SQL, with models from 1.5B to 8B. The proposed Compression and Steering mechanisms improve held-out performance over the fixed-harness baseline in most settings. These results suggest that a harness for agentic RL can be learned from the task's data and evolved with the model.

translation.title: ModHarness-RL：将Harness重塑为可学习、可演化的程序以支持Agentic RL
translation.abstract: Agentic强化学习（RL）越来越依赖harness——模型周围的脚手架，决定模型能看到自身交互的哪些内容以及获得何种引导。现有大多数方法在手写且整个训练过程固定不变的harness下训练。然而，有效的harness取决于领域、数据和模型，并随模型训练不断变化。我们提出ModHarness-RL，将harness重塑为从数据中学习、并随RL训练演化的程序。ModHarness-RL将交互记录为结构化State（一组带类型的块），harness的两个核心组件是基于这些块的程序：一个Compression程序将累积历史组装进模型上下文，一个Steering程序在行为偏离时提供引导。在RL训练期间，从近期轨迹中提出候选程序，经执行验证，并在历史轨迹上重放，使harness能跟踪模型行为的变化。我们深入研究CodeSearch，并进一步分析ALFWorld和BIRD SQL，模型规模从1.5B到8B。所提出的Compression与Steering机制在多数设置下优于固定harness基线的held-out性能。这些结果表明，agentic RL的harness可以从任务数据中学习并随模型演化。
translation.brief: 针对固定手写harness难以适应模型与任务变化的问题，提出将harness表示为可学习的Compression与Steering程序，在RL训练中随模型共同演化。

papers.title: Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Demonstrations are an effective way to accelerate single-agent reinforcement learning (RL), but extending this idea to multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is non-trivial as it is difficult and often impossible for a single person to teleoperate multiple agents simultaneously. Round-Robin Behavior Cloning (R2BC) addresses this by letting a single demonstrator control one agent at a time while the others execute their current policies. However, the resulting imitation policies are limited by the quality of the demonstrations. We propose Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (IBMARL), a framework that extends Imitation Bootstrapped Reinforcement Learning (IBRL) to cooperative teams and uses R2BC to train the imitation policies. At each time step, every agent receives one action proposal from its imitation policy and one from its RL policy, and an ensemble of centralized critics selects among the per-agent combinations of the two. A gated imitation penalty, a soft Q-filtered behavior cloning loss, regularizes each RL policy toward its imitation policy only where the critics value the imitation action more, so that after training each agent executes its RL policy alone, without the centralized critics. On four cooperative multi-agent RL benchmarks, IBMARL surpasses its imitation policies $2.6$-$4.2\times$ faster than demonstration-based baselines on two tasks, is the only method to surpass it on the other two, and exceeds the demonstrator itself on two of the four. With real human demonstrations IBMARL still surpasses imitation learning alone, and does so more than twice as fast as the best baseline.

translation.title: 模仿引导的多智能体强化学习
translation.abstract: 示范是加速单智能体强化学习（RL）的有效方式，但将这一思想扩展到多智能体强化学习（MARL）并非易事，因为让一个人同时遥操作多个智能体很困难甚至不可行。Round-Robin Behavior Cloning（R2BC）通过让单个示范者一次控制一个智能体、其余智能体执行当前策略来解决这一问题。然而，所得的模仿策略受示范质量限制。我们提出Imitation Bootstrapped Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning（IBMARL），将Imitation Bootstrapped Reinforcement Learning（IBRL）扩展到合作团队，并用R2BC训练模仿策略。在每个时间步，每个智能体从其模仿策略和RL策略各收到一个动作提议，由集中式critic集成在两个策略的各智能体组合之间进行选择。门控模仿惩罚——一种软Q过滤的行为克隆损失——仅在critic更看重模仿动作时将RL策略向模仿策略正则化，从而训练后每个智能体可单独执行其RL策略，无需集中式critic。在四个合作式多智能体RL基准上，IBMARL在两个任务上超过其模仿策略的速度比基于示范的基线快2.6-4.2倍，是唯一在另外两个任务上超越模仿策略的方法，并在四个任务中的两个上超过示范者本身。使用真实人类示范时IBMARL仍超越单纯模仿学习，且速度超过最佳基线两倍以上。
translation.brief: 针对多智能体示范难以单人采集且模仿策略质量受限的问题，提出IBMARL框架，用R2BC训练模仿策略并通过集中式critic选择与门控模仿惩罚引导RL策略提升超越模仿水平。

papers.title: WeightBench: Evaluating Language Models as Weight-Space Programmers
papers.abstract: Recent work shows that large language models (LLMs) can operate directly on the parameters of other neural networks. They can read what a network was trained to do, fix a network that fails, and write working networks from scratch, all without gradient descent. This capability has been termed Weight-Space Programming (WSP). Exploring this new paradigm systematically requires a robust benchmark. We introduce WEIGHTBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs of increasing capability on 42 WSP tasks across five tracks: reading, fixing and writing weights, recognizing edits that are impossible, and data-free compression. The networks whose weights the LLMs read and edit range from 2K-parameter control policies to 7B-parameter language models. Experimental benchmark results show that frontier agents can already read small networks and write working control policies without ever running them, but cannot yet patch language models, compress them without data, or tell an impossible edit from a hard one. On all 42 tasks, Claude Opus 5.5 reaches a macro score of 0.535 (Sonnet 5.5 0.466, Haiku 5.5 0.402, DeepSeek v4-flash 0.215); on the 38 tasks it was run on, GPT-6.1-sol reaches 0.568 against Opus's 0.546. Code, the task registry, our OS-level sandbox harness, and the live leaderboard are publicly available at this https URL.

translation.title: WeightBench：将语言模型评测为权重空间程序员
translation.abstract: 近期工作表明，大语言模型（LLM）可以直接操作其他神经网络的参数：它们能读取一个网络被训练来做什么、修复一个失效的网络、并从零写出可用的网络，全程无需梯度下降。这一能力被称为权重空间编程（Weight-Space Programming，WSP）。系统性地探索这一新范式需要稳健的基准。我们提出WEIGHTBENCH，一个在42个WSP任务上评估能力递增的LLM的基准，涵盖五个赛道：读取、修复和写入权重，识别不可能的编辑，以及无数据压缩。LLM读取和编辑权重的网络范围从2K参数的控制策略到7B参数的语言模型。实验基准结果显示，前沿智能体已经可以在不运行网络的情况下读取小网络并写出可用的控制策略，但尚不能修补语言模型、无数据压缩模型，或区分不可能的编辑与困难的编辑。在全部42个任务上，Claude Opus 5.5取得0.535的macro分数（Sonnet 5.5为0.466，Haiku 5.5为0.402，DeepSeek v4-flash为0.215）；在其运行的38个任务上，GPT-6.1-sol达到0.568，而Opus为0.546。代码、任务注册表、我们的OS级沙盒harness和实时排行榜均在此 https URL 公开。
translation.brief: 针对LLM直接操作神经网络参数（权重空间编程）缺乏系统评测的问题，构建包含42个任务的WEIGHTBENCH基准，从读取、修复、写入权重等五个赛道评估模型能力。
